item.description:
Scuba Equipment Technician & Inventory Manager

Utila Dive Center is seeking a detail-oriented, highly organized, and certified Scuba Equipment Technician & Inventory Manager to oversee our facility’s equipment department. 

As a world-renowned PADI Career Development Center (CDC), we maintain a massive inventory of rental gear, student kits, and technical diving equipment. The ideal candidate will ensure our gear remains in pristine, safe condition while keeping our workshop and inventory seamlessly organized.

Key Responsibilities

Equipment Maintenance & Repair

  • Service and overhaul our fleet of rental regulators, BCDs, and cylinder valves.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot gear malfunctions quickly to keep courses running smoothly.
  • Maintain the compressor room, including air quality testing, filter changes, and routine maintenance on our high-pressure systems.
  • Manage hydrostatic testing and visual inspections (VIP) for scuba cylinders.

Inventory & Logistics

  • Conduct regular inventory audits of all rental gear, rental stock, and spare parts.
  • Track gear requirements across dive boats, student groups, and professional-level courses.
  • Organize and optimize the gear room and technician workshop for maximum efficiency.

Procurement & Vendor Relations

  • Anticipate and manage ordering cycles for spare parts, new equipment, and workshop consumables.
  • Maintain relationships with major scuba manufacturers and local distributors.

 

Requirements & Qualifications

Essential

  • Certified Scuba Service Technician with active credentials from major manufacturers (e.g., Scubapro, Aqua Lung, Cressi, or Apeks).
  • Proven experience managing inventory, ideally within a high-volume dive center, resort, or retail environment.
  • Strong computer literacy, with experience using inventory management software and spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets).
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken).
  • Exceptional organizational skills and a proactive approach to preventative maintenance.

Desirable (Plus Factors)

  • Tech Savvy. Ability to set-up and monitor networks and security cameras.
  • Gas Blender or Compressor Technician certifications.
  • PADI Divemaster or Instructor rating (to assist with boat logistics or guest relations if needed).
  • Conversational Spanish, which is highly beneficial for coordinating with local staff and logistics handling in Honduras.
  • Prior experience living and working on an island or in a remote tropical location.

What We Offer

  • A competitive monthly salary (commensurate with experience).
  • One-day off per week with a flexible schedule
  • Performance-based bonuses or retail commission opportunities.
  • Diving perks, including free fun diving and access to continuing professional education (e.g., tech diving, specialty ratings).
  • The opportunity to work with a fun, passionate, international team at one of the world’s premier dive destinations.

How to Apply

If you are a meticulous technician who loves the island lifestyle, we want to hear from you! Please send your CV/Resume, copies of your tech certifications, and a brief cover letter explaining why you are the perfect fit for Utila Dive Center to:

josiah@utiladivecenter.com

item.description:
About the role

We are seeking a USCG licensed 100 Ton Captain for our busy South Florida location.  The position requires a high level of customer service and communication skills, and exceptional boat handling skills.  Experience with Newton Dive Vessels and drift diving environments preferred.  Duties to include: captaining daily charters (daytime and night), vessel maintenance, customer check-in, prioritization of vessel, customer and crew safety.  Must be a US citizen to apply.

About Pura Vida Divers 

Founded in 2002, Pura Vida Divers is a PADI 5 Star IDC dive center on Singer Island in South Florida.  We offer daily scuba charters aboard two dive vessels, scuba instruction from beginner to professional, and a full service shop featuring retail sales, equipment service, rentals, and a complete fill station.  Our love of diving, the ocean, conservation, education, and community inspires us every day to offer the best possible experience to our guests.

item.description:
Overview

Join our vibrant SCUBA Dive Store team as a dedicated and enthusiastic Store Staff member! In this role, you will be the face of our store, providing expert guidance and exceptional customer service to diving enthusiasts and newcomers alike. Your energy, knowledge, and passion for diving will help create memorable experiences for our customers while ensuring smooth store operations. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to grow within the diving industry, share your expertise, and promote a love for underwater exploration.

Responsibilities

  • Assist customers with product selection, providing detailed product demos and explaining features of diving equipment and accessories
  • Manage retail sales transactions accurately using POS (Point of Sale) systems, including cash register operations and cash handling
  • Maintain organized stock levels through stocking, merchandising, and inventory management to ensure the store is well-presented and fully stocked
  • Conduct product demonstrations to educate customers on proper equipment use and safety procedures
  • Upsell complementary products and accessories to enhance customer experience and increase sales opportunities
  • Provide excellent customer service by addressing inquiries via phone etiquette and in-person interactions, ensuring a welcoming environment
  • Supervise or assist with retail store operations as needed, including supervising staff or interns in a supervisory capacity

Skills

  • Proven experience in retail sales, cashiering, or grocery store environments with strong retail math skills
  • Familiarity with POS systems, cash register operations, and basic math for cash handling and transactions
  • Excellent communication skills in English; bilingual abilities are a plus for serving diverse customers
  • Demonstrated supervisory experience or leadership skills within retail or service settings
  • Knowledge of retail store product knowledge, merchandising techniques, and inventory management practices
  • Strong customer service orientation with professional phone etiquette and effective communication skills
  • Experience with upselling techniques to maximize sales opportunities while maintaining customer satisfaction

Join us if you’re passionate about diving, eager to share your knowledge, and excited to deliver outstanding service in a dynamic retail environment!

Benefits:

  • 401(k)
  • 401(k) matching
  • Employee discount
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off

 

Work Location: In person

item.description:
Blue Marlin Komodo is one of the most established and respected dive centers in Indonesia.

Located in the heart of Labuan Bajo, we operate daily inside the Komodo National Park, offering high‑quality PADI courses, guided dives, and professional-level training.

Our team is international, experienced, and passionate about teaching, safety, and creating unforgettable experiences for divers from all over the world. We value real training, teamwork, and a positive work environment where instructors and students grow together.

If you’re looking for a professional dive center, a supportive team, and the chance to work in one of the most iconic marine environments on the planet, Blue Marlin Komodo is the place to be.

 

Position: PADI Instructor – Chinese & English Speaking

We are looking for a Mandarin‑speaking PADI Instructor who can also communicate confidently in English to join our team in Komodo.

Candidate Requirements

  • Active PADI OWSI or higher
  • Fluent Mandarin (spoken and written)
  • Good English communication skills
  • Strong teaching ability and customer service mindset
  • Professional, reliable, and safety‑focused
  • Positive attitude and ability to work in a fast‑paced, multicultural environment
  • Willingness to relocate to Labuan Bajo
  • Preferred: experience teaching Chinese students or working in multilingual dive centers

What We Offer

  • Professional and friendly work environment
  • Daily access to Komodo National Park
  • Opportunities for professional development (specialties, IDC Staff, etc.)
  • Supportive international team
  • Real teaching opportunities with diverse students

How to Apply

Please send your CV, certifications, and a short introduction to: info@bluemarlinkomodo.com

BlueTribe at Constance Moofushi is a 5-Star IDC Centre located on the island of Constance Moofushi in Ari Atoll, Maldives.

https://youtu.be/U2cmy7nZN1k?si=lRqXfn01mhSQ_mJj

We are currently looking for a passionate and professional PADI Instructor or Instructor couple  to join our team, with a start in October 2026

The applicant/s must be able to teach in English, Italian. Additional languages are considered a strong advantage.

Moofushi is one of the premier dive destinations in the Maldives, renowned for its incredible shark channels, manta points, and excellent dive sites. Combined with outstanding logistics and training facilities, it is an ideal location for diver education at all levels and guided diving.

We are seeking  team members with a genuine passion for teaching diving, Previous experience working in the Maldives is essential. Applicants should demonstrate strong communication skills, professionalism, and the ability to work effectively within a busy team and 5  star hotel environment.

BlueTribe is an active PADI Education Centre offering training from beginner through to Instructor level, and is consistently one of the top-certifying PADI centres in the Maldives. For the right candidate, BlueTribe offers an excellent opportunity to further develop dive credentials and build a long-term professional career within the industry.

Documented diver training experience will needed for  the application ( padi student count )

As Constance Moofushi is a 5-Star luxury resort, applicants should also demonstrate previous experience working within a similar high-standard hospitality environment. A positive work ethic, proactive attitude, flexibility during busy operational periods, and strong teamwork skills are all essential.

Position Benefits:
• Competitive salary
• Service charge and commissions
• Flight allowance and  Uniform provided

Staff Facilities Include:
• Gym
• Football ground
• Laundry facilities

Staff Accommodation Includes:
• Air conditioning
• Wi-Fi
• Television
• En-suite bathroom

Additional Staff Benefits:
• Access to guest restaurant facilities
• Access to hotel bar
• 30 days paid annual leave
• 1 day off per week
• 12-month contract

Personal Requirements:
• Full personal dive equipment
• Dive computer
• Non-smoker
• No visible tattoos

If you are interested in the above position, please send the following to:

info@bluetribemoofushi.com

Required Documents:
• CV
• Recent photograph
• Two references
• Copy of PADI credentials and DAN/PADI Insurance
• Full PADI certification history downloaded from the PADI Pro website

Kind regards,

BlueTribe Management Team

item.description:
Euro-Divers Vilamendhoo is recruiting an experienced, motivated, and independent Water Sports Guide to manage our Water Sports Centre.

As Vilamendhoo is a resort known for its House Reef and attracts many guests for diving and snorkeling, actively promoting our activities and engaging with guests is an important part of this position.

This position is open to Maldivian nationals only.

You are:

  • Experienced in water sports and hospitality
  • Able to work independently and take responsibility for the daily operation
  • Friendly, outgoing, and confident with guests
  • Fluent in English with good verbal communication skills
  • Proactive, flexible, and service-minded
  • Confident in promoting and selling water sports and marine activities
  • Comfortable approaching guests and creating sales opportunities
  • Previous resort experience is an advantage
  • Diving experience or Divemaster certification is an advantage
  • VDWS or other relevant water sports qualifications are an advantage

Your responsibilities:

  • Manage the daily operation of the Water Sports Centre independently
  • Welcome and assist guests and provide information about our activities
  • Promote and sell water sports activities, diving, night snorkeling, and other services offered by Euro-Divers
  • Handle guest bookings and activity arrangements
  • Guide night snorkeling activities
  • Support the Dive Centre team with daily operational tasks
  • Carry out other duties as required by the operation

We offer:

  • One-year contract
  • Paid annual leave
  • Full board accommodation
  • Attractive salary package
  • Opportunity to develop your skills and responsibilities within the operation
  • For candidates with diving experience, opportunities to join recreational dives on days off
  • Professional diving training and progression opportunities may be considered based on performance, commitment, and operational requirements

Please note: Diving courses and professional training are not automatically included from the beginning of the contract. Further diving development may be offered after demonstrating good performance and commitment to the position.

How to apply:

Please send your CV with recent photo, short cover letter, reference letter, and any relevant licenses or certificates to:

vilamendhoo@euro-divers.com

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

item.description:
Looking to live in one of the best cities in the world and continue with your passion of being a PADI Professional?

Dive Centre Manly is situated closest to some of Sydney’s best dive sites, including Cabbage Tree Bay. Being a multi-award winning PADI 5 Star Instructor training facility, we offer a complete range of dive courses from beginner level Introduction to Snorkelling & Discover Scuba up to Instructor level and beyond – including Sydney’s most talked about Learn to Dive course.

Our facilities include:

  • Award winning retail & equipment rental store
  • PADI 5 Star Instructor training facility
  • 3 meter-deep heated and floodlight diver training pool
  • 2 air-conditioned classrooms
  • Our very own Dive Boat, Sea Dragon II
  • Scuba equipment servicing workshop

 

Ideally, we are looking for a PADI MSDT with a few years of experience to join our team! We are also open to discussions with new Instructors and Divemasters.

Responsibilities include performing all kinds of logistical tasks and daily preparation of the dive centre, and equipment, conducting Discover Scuba Dives, diving courses from basic level to professional training, PADI program sales, and guiding local dives.

 

Applicants who apply should be:

  • Passionate about the ocean and have knowledge of scuba diving
  • Punctual, polite, customer focused and keen to help in every detail
  • Have working rights in Australia
  • Certified as a PADI OWSI or greater
  • 1+ years of teaching experience
  • Hold a full driver’s license (desired)

Perks:

  • The chance to work with some of Australia’s most experienced divers
  • Access to outstanding employee discounts on gear purchases & servicing
  • Free use of tank fills & weights
  • Friends & Family Discount
  • Discounted boat diving
  • Opportunities for professional development / Speciality Ratings
  • Flexible working conditions
  • Discounted local, interstate & international travel

 

Salary is negotiable with contractor/freelance or full-time employment available for the right candidate (Monday to Sunday).

 

To join the team submit your expression of interest with a cover letter and current CV to: michael@divesydney.com

item.title: Full-time job opportunity for a dedicated dive professional
item.excerpt: We are PADI 5* dive center located in Campbell River, BC, Canada and are looking for a dive professional to join our team. We offer dive charters, training, servicing and dive equipment rental. We operate our own custom made dive charter boat the Ocean Guardian with a hydraulic ramp and lift for safe and easy...
item.description:
We are PADI 5* dive center located in Campbell River, BC, Canada and are looking for a dive professional to join our team. We offer dive charters, training, servicing and dive equipment rental. We operate our own custom made dive charter boat the Ocean Guardian with a hydraulic ramp and lift for safe and easy boat exit and entry.

Campbell River and the Discovery Passage is home to world-class cold-water diving. Our local and international clientele consider Oceanfix as one of best dive centers in British Columbia.

We are looking for a permanent full-time staff member. The ideal candidate is a passionate and dedicated individual who can thrive in a fast-paced, customer-oriented environment and is looking for a long-term job in the dive industry as a professional. As a small business you will have the opportunity taken on various roles and the chance to develop your diving know-how and business skills.

In this position, you will be responsible for:

  • Managing shop sales
  • Daily shop operations including rentals
  • Maintaining the store’s visual display & establishing/expanding clientele.
  • Preparing Social Media posts, dive charter announcements using mailing tools
  • Taking on Divemaster tasks on our own state of the art charter boat the Ocean Guardian
  • Teaching PADI Open water and other courses

Qualifications

  • Strong sales skills and experience with customer service related to diving
  • Knowledge and passion for scuba diving and the underwater world
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Experience in retail sales (ideally a dive shop) and POS
  • Scuba diving certifications ideally as a Dive master or Dive instructor

Interested? Then just send us an email with your resume and cover letter to: stephen@oceanfix.ca

Addition – **Must be able to work in the US legally without our sponsorship, No exceptions.**

We are a busy 5 star PADI IDC resort offering guided boat dives, all levels of dive courses, discover scuba experiences, guided snorkeling, and private dive and snorkeling charters.

We’re looking for a dependable, mature, outgoing, instructor to join our dive family. Paid weekly based on hours plus incentive pay (weekly and quarterly)

10 month commitment Nov 2026 – July 2027 – starting date negotiable, longer stay always a plus!

**Must be a US citizen or duel citizen – NO EXCEPTIONS**

item.title: Experienced Dive Instructors or Dive Masters – with min. Coxswains NC1 – Great Keppel Island – Australia
item.excerpt: Keppel Dive & Water Sports is seeking experienced Dive Instructors or Dive Masters (with minimum Coxswain NC1) to join our team and live on Great Keppel Island, Queensland. This is a casual position that offers the perfect opportunity to share your passion for diving and vessel operation whilst working in one of Australia’s most stunning...
item.description:
Keppel Dive & Water Sports is seeking experienced Dive Instructors or Dive Masters (with minimum Coxswain NC1) to join our team and live on Great Keppel Island, Queensland. This is a casual position that offers the perfect opportunity to share your passion for diving and vessel operation whilst working in one of Australia’s most stunning marine environments. As a Dive Instructor or Dive Master and Coxswain, you will be responsible for leading and guiding groups of divers, ensuring their safety, and delivering unforgettable underwater experiences. This role is pivotal to our operation, as we pride ourselves on providing exceptional diving and island adventures to our guests. You will be working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where your expertise and enthusiasm directly contribute to guest satisfaction and safety.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead and conduct diving expeditions for guests of varying experience levels, from beginners to advanced divers
  • Provide comprehensive pre-dive briefings covering safety procedures, dive sites, marine life and emergency protocols
  • Ensure all diving equipment is properly maintained, inspected and in safe working order before each dive
  • Monitor guest wellbeing throughout diving activities and respond promptly to any concerns or emergencies
  • Conduct post-dive debriefings and provide constructive feedback to improve guest experience and diving skills
  • Maintain accurate dive logs and records for all participants and dives conducted
  • Conduct boat operations, and tours as required with Coxswains NC1 certification
  • Educate guests about marine conservation, local marine life and sustainable diving practices
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure smooth operations and exceptional guest experiences
  • Adhere to all relevant maritime, diving and health and safety regulations

What we’re looking for

  • Current Dive Instructor or Dive Master PADI certification
  • Minimum Coxswains NC1 certification with approved hours & experience
  • Relevant and Current First Aid and CPR certification
  • Demonstrated knowledge of marine environments, and marine life behaviour
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex diving concepts in an accessible manner
  • Excellent customer service ethos with a genuine passion for creating memorable experiences
  • Ability to remain calm and make sound decisions in emergency situations
  • Physical fitness and ability to work in demanding marine conditions
  • Current working with Children Check (or willingness to obtain) if working with under-18s
  • Preferred experience with recreational diving guiding on the Great Barrier Reef or similar coral reef environments
  • Preferred knowledge of tropical marine ecosystems and coral conservation

What we offer

At Keppel Dive & Water Sports, we are committed to providing a rewarding work environment where our team members can thrive. You will have the opportunity to work in a breathtaking island location whilst doing what you love. Our team enjoys a collaborative, supportive culture where your expertise is valued and your passion for diving and boats is shared by colleagues and guests alike. We provide ongoing professional development opportunities to help you advance your diving qualifications and expand your skills. Additionally, you will benefit from subsidised on island accommodation & ferries, team discounts, access to world-class diving experiences, and the satisfaction of introducing people to the wonders of the underwater world. We foster a workplace culture that prioritises your health, safety and wellbeing.

About us

Keppel Dive & Water Sports is a leading tourism operator specialising in delivering exceptional marine and diving experiences on and around Great Keppel Island. With a commitment to excellence, safety and environmental stewardship, we have built a reputation for creating unforgettable adventures for guests from around the world. Our team is passionate about showcasing the natural beauty and biodiversity of the Great Barrier Reef region whilst promoting responsible and sustainable tourism practices. We pride ourselves on our professional standards, expert knowledge and dedication to guest satisfaction. At Keppel Dive & Water Sports our staff can excel whilst contributing to conservation and education efforts within the marine tourism industry.

Apply now

If you are an experienced Dive Instructor or Dive Master with current Coxswains NC1 certification and a passion for delivering exceptional diving experiences, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV, diving certifications, maritime qualifications and a cover letter explaining why you are the ideal candidate for this role to Funtastic Cruises. Join our team and make a difference in the lives of our guests whilst working in one of Australia’s most spectacular diving destinations.

item.description:
Job Description

Euro-Divers Vilamendhoo | South Ari Atoll

Euro-Divers Vilamendhoo is recruiting a German-speaking PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor or higher to join our international team for the reopening of Vilamendhoo Island Resort & Spa in November 2026.

We are looking for a professional, safety-focused and guest-oriented instructor who enjoys working in an international resort environment and shares our “Diving with Friends” philosophy.

Requirements

  • Current PADI OWSI or higher
  • EFR Instructor
  • EANx / Nitrox Specialty Instructor
  • Minimum DAN Pro Bronze insurance or equivalent
  • Teaching-level English and German
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills
  • Professional, safety-focused and team-oriented
  • Complete and well-maintained personal scuba diving equipment, including a dive torch
  • Previous Maldives experience is an advantage
  • Previous professional work experience outside diving is an advantage

What we offer

  • 1-year contract
  • Competitive salary & flight allowance
  • Paid annual leave
  • Work permit & visa
  • Full board
  • Opportunity to enjoy diving activities during free time
  • International and professional working environment

Accommodation

Due to our current staff accommodation capacity, this position is for an individual instructor. Shared staff accommodation will be provided, with the successful candidate sharing a room with another team member. We are currently unable to accommodate couples for this position.

How to apply

Please send your CV with recent photo, short cover letter, screenshot of PADI Instructor Ratings & Student Counts from your PADI Pro account to:

vilamendhoo@euro-divers.com

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

DIVE INSTRUCTOR MANAGEMENT COUPLE (GERMAN/ENGLISH SPEAKING)

item.description:
Management Couple Fiji Island Resort

Start ASAP with this dream job!  Coconut Beach Resort is a small boutique island resort located in the picturesque turquoise waters of the Yasawa Group of Islands in Fiji.  The resort has 11 guest bures/villas and approximately 35 members of staff www.coconutbeachfiji.com

We are seeking an experienced management couple with the necessary passion and commitment to help continue to drive the present success and excellent reputation the resort enjoys.  Ideally, both will be qualified dive instructors with the ability to maintain dive equipment, and both will also have extensive experience in managing the day-to-day operations of a remote island resort.

We need a management couple with a strong commitment to live on a small remote island with the ability to provide exceptional personal guest service. You will have strong leadership skills whilst working in a hands-on role, setting constant examples and mentoring our close-knit team of local employees.

We need someone who understands aspects of construction, maintenance and repair, and the ability to troubleshoot or oversee plant, equipment and operational requirements.  The remote location of the resort means that forward planning, advanced problem solving and a keen eye on day-to-day operations are essential skills and a prerequisite.

Applicants must be fluent English and have at least 5 years management experience in a similar role running a minimum 4-star hotel or higher, or a remote island resort or lodge in an isolated location.

Candidates with the following skills or experience will be highly regarded – managing properties with their own generator power supply and water treatment plants, managing and overseeing the service of boats, excellent dive instruction and marine conservation credentials.

Contract is 3 years, private accommodation, all meals and boat transfers to and from mainland Fiji will be provided.  Attractive remuneration package will be discussed with shortlisted applicants.

If you have the passion and commitment and are ready to enter the next phase in your career, please submit your covering letter with CV attached detailing the above experiences in the respective role to coconutjobs@gmail.com

Do you want to live and work on a dream island in the Maldives, but are not a dive pro? Prodivers Hurawalhi is looking for you!

We are looking for female office / front desk staff to complete our team in Hurawalhi, Maldives for the 26/27 season. (Must be female due to accommodation sharing) Start date latest November 26 and 1 year contract is required.


Minimum requirements:

Fluent in English

Experience in retail / administration / reception or dive centre

Customer service focused with a big smile

A love for being in the water – preferably a diver

Organised, professional and tidy

Good work ethic and ability to work in a big team


What we’d love:

Extra languages – German, Japanese, Chinese and Russian all an advantage

Experience in remote areas

Experience in a 5* resort environment


Your day-to-day would involve:

Enquiries & guest check-ins at the Dive Centre

Retail sales

Office admin including billing, scheduling and email enquiries

General cleaning and preparation of equipment


What we offer:

Work permit, visa, local transfers and medical insurance

Return home flight reimbursement

Basic salary, service charge, equal share of team tips

6 day working week (flexibility needed)

1/2 day paid FUN diving/snorkelling per week

Twin share room with A/C, fridge & private bathroom

item.description:
Aquatics Technician
Technician
On-call Position

Apply with link below (copy and paste into browser if unable to click)

https://jobs.cirquedusoleil.com/en/job-detail/oncall-aquatics-technician-o-las-vegas-nv-1-eff425d1-5039-4061-b3f5-b70d2a1dfb7c

We are looking for our next Aquatics Technician to join our Technical Production Services team. The main objective of this role is to be responsible for the safety of our artists and technicians while in the water.

Why join us as an Aquatics Technician?
The Aquatics Technician will have the opportunity to:
–        Ensure all departmental designs, equipment, systems, functions, procedures, show tracks, maintenance and inspection logs, special projects, etc. are properly and adequately documented;
–        Work with the Aquatics Supervisor and Artistic & Stage Management staff to support their needs during rehearsals, trainings, and performances;
–        Develop a thorough knowledge of all department equipment specific to the production in order to operate equipment safely;
–        Adhere to and promote all Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) regulations as they pertain to the safe operation of all elements related to the show; participate in all required health and safety classes and emergency rescue procedure training;
–        Take active role in Rescue Scenarios and Contingency Plans throughout theatre with regards to water safety;
–        Remain underwater for a period of 90 minutes or more, twice a night, during the running of the shows and perform the designated pre-determined set of activities in accordance with the “Aquatics Cue Track Book”;
–        Safeguard both technicians and artists during both the running of the performance, as well as during training and maintenance periods, as well as on-stage while acting as “Deck Safety Officer”;
–        Perform maintenance duties that include, but are not be limited to, operating the “Scuba Tank Air Filling Station”, servicing and repairing all scuba gear used in the theatre, vacuuming of the theatre pool and assisting all other theatre departments with their cue tracks, maintenance projects, installations and repairs as needed;
–        Complete all other job-related duties as assigned.
 
What does it take for this role? The following hard skills are the basics of what’s needed to be successful in this position:
–        High School diploma and or GED required;
–        Working knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook);
–        Possess a current “Professional Scuba Diving Divemaster Certification,” (or higher) with a known accredited certification agency, as well as valid CPR, first aid, AED certifications;
–        Ability to obtain OSHA 10 course completion card;
–        Possess a state of health that facilitates the extensive scuba diving and essential functions of the job; Comfortable with wearing a “Full Face Scuba Diving Mask” and be able to lift, push or pull heavy loads (50 lbs or more), including pulling Performing Artists through the water column;
–        Ability to perform the essential functions of the job including, but not limited to: crouching, kneeling, standing, lifting things under water, and the ability to hold breath, sometimes for extended amounts of time; lifting at least 50lbs unassisted, etc.; Full list of essential functions will be sent in the offer. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions;
–        Fluent in English, both written and spoken;
–        Verification of the right to work in the United States for Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group, as demonstrated by completion of the Form I-9 upon hire and the submission of acceptable documentation (as noted on the Form I-9) verifying one’s identity and work authorization.
When you think of your ideal workplace, what comes to mind? For us, it looks (and really is) like this:
–        Teamwork – we thrive with collaborative teams, regardless of titles or departments;
–        Respect – when we ask someone to join our team, it’s because we trust and respect you;
–        Integrity – whether you work behind-the-scenes or in the office, you’re being counted on. We are a team and integrity goes a long way here, and like we mentioned previously, trust is important;
–        Authenticity – we want you to bring your full self to work, this is a place where you don’t need to fit into a box to belong; diverse perspectives foster even more creativity in the workplace. We embrace the human behind the employee number;
–        Being heard – you have access to everyone in the organization, use your voice on development questions or suggestions on how to improve the experience. We value open and transparent communication, and we want you to be heard!
Come create with us and let us show you what a “circus family” feels like!
 
 
Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against applicants or employees because of their race, creed, color, age, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military status, national origin or ancestry.

 

Apply with link below (copy and paste into browser if unable to click)

https://jobs.cirquedusoleil.com/en/job-detail/oncall-aquatics-technician-o-las-vegas-nv-1-eff425d1-5039-4061-b3f5-b70d2a1dfb7c

item.description:
About Us

Bermuda Diving Center is Dubai’s premier 5-Star PADI IDC Facility, welcoming over 70,000+ happy divers and certifying 22,000+ students worldwide. With the largest and most luxurious dive boat fleet in the UAE and a team of 8+ multilingual instructors, we pride ourselves on providing safe, professional, and unforgettable scuba diving experiences.

Role Overview

We are looking for a passionate and motivated PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor (OWSI) to join our dynamic team. You will deliver high-quality training, guide recreational dives, and help create lifelong memories for our students and guests.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct PADI Open Water, Advanced Open Water, and Discover Scuba Diving programs.

  • Teach and supervise students in a safe, professional, and fun environment.

  • Lead guided dives (shore and boat trips) for certified divers.

  • Support dive center operations including equipment setup, briefings, and customer care.

  • Promote dive courses, specialties, and gear to students and guests.

Requirements

  • Minimum PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor (OWSI) certification.

  • Active teaching status with PADI.

  • Previous experience in teaching and guiding (preferred in the Middle East/UAE).

  • Professional, safety-minded, and customer-oriented approach.

  • Fluency in English (additional languages such as Arabic, Russian, German, French, Italian, or Chinese are a big plus).

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary package + commission opportunities.

  • Professional development and continuing education opportunities.

  • A multicultural, friendly, and supportive work environment.

  • Chance to work with one of the leading dive centers in the UAE.

How to Apply

If you’re ready to inspire new divers and grow with a world-class team, send your CV, photo, and diving credentials to:
📧 info@scubadiving.ae

Thresher Shark Divers is looking for a creative and reliable Social Media Manager who is also a certified scuba diving instructor. (we do take Divemasters in consideration)

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Create and schedule engaging posts, reels and stories
• Capture and edit underwater photos and short videos

• Reply promptly and professionally to comments and messages
• Promote dive packages, courses and special offers

• Maintain the TSD brand style and voice
• Teaching courses and guiding dives when required

• Certified scuba diving instructor with active teaching status (divemaster will be considered)
• Valid First Aid and CPR certification
• Social media management or content creation experience
• Photography and video-editing skills
• Ability to create quality underwater content
• Clear written and spoken English
• Organized, dependable and proactive
• Comfortable appearing in photos and videos
• Able to work independently and meet deadlines

AN ADVANTAGE

• Experience diving around Malapascua
• Knowledge of thresher sharks and responsible shark diving
• Experience using Canva, CapCut or Adobe software
• Experience managing social media advertising
• Additional languages
• Own camera, laptop or underwater photography equipment

TO APPLY, PLEASE SEND

• A short introduction
• Your CV or work history
• Your instructor certification, number and current teaching status
• Your number of logged dives and teaching experience
• Links to social media accounts you have managed
• Examples of posts, reels, videos or campaigns
• Your current location
• Your earliest available starting date

📍 Malapascua Island, Cebu, Philippines

Join Thresher Shark Divers and help us tell the story of one of the world’s most remarkable diving destinations.

item.description:
Vancouver, BC | Full-Time
$75,000–$85,000/year + Benefits

Diving Sports Canada is looking for an experienced Store & Operations Manager to take ownership of the day-to-day operations of our busy scuba diving retail and training centre in Vancouver.

We’re looking for someone who naturally sees what needs to be done, leads a team confidently, solves problems independently, and is constantly looking for ways to make a business operate better.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Day-to-day operation of the store
  • Leadership, scheduling and accountability of the retail team
  • Delegating work and ensuring it actually gets completed
  • Maintaining high standards for customer service and store presentation
  • Inventory organization, receiving and replenishment
  • Merchandising and improving the customer experience
  • Coordinating operational needs between retail, courses, rentals and service
  • Handling customer issues and making sound decisions independently
  • Identifying inefficiencies and implementing better processes
  • Developing systems and procedures as the company grows
  • Supporting hiring, onboarding and training of staff
  • Working with ownership on sales growth and business-development initiatives

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

You are someone who:

  • Has previous retail management, operations management or comparable leadership experience
  • Has successfully managed employees
  • Is organized and able to prioritize in a busy environment
  • Doesn’t become overwhelmed when several things need attention at once
  • Communicates clearly and holds people accountable
  • Has strong commercial judgment
  • Takes initiative instead of waiting for instructions
  • Notices problems and comes forward with solutions
  • Enjoys improving systems and finding better ways of doing things
  • Is comfortable making decisions and taking responsibility for them
  • Can move comfortably between managing people, helping customers and solving operational problems

Experience in scuba diving is an asset, but it is not required.

Experience managing a specialty retail, outdoor, sporting goods, cycling, ski, marine or similar business would be particularly valuable.

We’re looking for someone who can walk into the store, understand the priorities, organize the team, identify what needs attention and make things happen.

Compensation: CAD$75,000–$85,000/year, depending on experience
Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week
Benefits: Extended health and dental benefits

To apply, please send your resume and a short introduction to admin@divingsports.ca explaining your management experience and why you believe you’d be a strong fit for this role.

item.description:
x1 INSTRUCTOR REQUIRED, ABERDEEN, SCOTLAND, UK

SCUBA DIVING SCOTLAND is Scotland’s largest PADI 5* IDC dive centre and one of the largest in the UK. We are currently looking for an ambitious, motivated staff member to join our team based in Aberdeen.  The applicants must be able to work in the UK with a clean drivers license.  Above all else, the candidate should have the right attitude and work ethic, as well as a sociable, friendly approach.

JOB INFORMATION

– 30 hours a week, full-time, permanent position.

– Working a mixture of weekends, weekday and evening shifts.

– The position requires a great deal of flexibility with working hours as shifts can change weekly.

– Job role will include training as a H.U.E.T Diver (Helicopter Underwater Escape Training Diver) – All H.U.E.T Diver Training will be provided.

– Industry competitive monthly salary – £14.50 per hour.  Paid monthly.  Holiday pay included.

 

APPLICANTS MUST HAVE OR BE ABLE TO GET:

– A valid UK working Visa – Essential

– An HSE Dive Medical – Essential

– Your own dive equipment

– Your own transportation

– PADI Drysuit Speciality (If not already qualified)

 

BENEFICIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

– Previous retail or dive shop experience.

– RLSS Lifeguard Qualification

– Managerial or leadership role experience.

– Servicing qualifications.

– Cold water diving experience.

– Any commercial or media diver qualifications.

– Computer, website and social media skills.

– Local dive knowledge.

 

If you are interested please email your CV to  chris@scubadivingscotland.co.uk with ‘SDS Job Application’ in the title.  For more information on SCUBA DIVING SCOTLAND please follow the link: www.scubadivingscotland.co.uk

 

Thank you for your time.

Kind Regards

Chris McKendry

SCUBA DIVING SCOTLAND

Email –  chris@scubadivingscotland.co.uk.

Website –  www.scubadivingscotland.co.uk

item.description:
Maui Dreams Dive Co. | Kihei, Maui, Hawaii

Maui Dreams Dive Co. is looking for an enthusiastic, professional PADI Scuba Instructor to join our team in Kihei, Maui.

For decades, Maui Dreams has helped divers of all experience levels explore Maui’s underwater world. We specialize in small groups, personalized attention, quality instruction, and exceptional diving experiences, from a guest’s first breath underwater through advanced training and professional-level development.

We are looking for a versatile instructor who is equally comfortable in the water and working in our retail dive shop. This is an important part of the position. Our instructors may teach or guide one day and work with customers in the shop the next. This versatility provides more consistent work opportunities when ocean conditions affect scheduled diving and makes you a more valuable part of our overall operation.

We want someone who is passionate about diving, enjoys working with people, takes pride in providing excellent customer experiences, and is interested in becoming a valued part of our team.

What You’ll Do

Responsibilities may include:

  • Teaching PADI courses from introductory experiences and Open Water through continuing education
  • Leading certified divers on guided Maui shore dives
  • Working with small groups and providing personalized instruction
  • Assisting with boat diving operations and trips
  • Working shifts in our retail dive shop
  • Helping customers select and purchase scuba and snorkeling equipment
  • Assisting customers with equipment rentals, dive bookings, trip planning, and general diving questions
  • Preparing, issuing, receiving, and organizing rental equipment
  • Supporting the day-to-day operation, organization, and upkeep of the dive shop
  • Maintaining high standards for diver safety, customer service, and professionalism
  • Helping create the fun, welcoming atmosphere Maui Dreams is known for

Who We’re Looking For

Our ideal candidate:

  • Is a current PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor or higher
  • Loves teaching and sharing scuba diving with others
  • Is confident working with both brand-new and experienced divers
  • Is comfortable working both in the water and in a customer-facing retail environment
  • Has strong interpersonal and customer-service skills
  • Is willing to learn our products and help customers make appropriate equipment choices
  • Places a high priority on safety, professionalism, and customer service
  • Is reliable, organized, and able to work effectively as part of a team
  • Is comfortable with shore diving and working in an active, hands-on environment
  • Is willing to take on a variety of responsibilities based on the needs of the operation
  • Wants to continue developing professionally within the dive industry
  • Is interested in making Maui home rather than simply working a short-term seasonal position

Previous dive shop, retail, equipment sales, or customer-service experience is a plus. Additional PADI specialties and professional-level experience are also valuable.

Why Maui Dreams?

Maui Dreams offers instructors the opportunity to develop a broader range of professional dive-industry skills rather than simply teaching or guiding the same dives every day.

Our operation includes:

  • PADI scuba instruction and continuing education
  • Introductory scuba experiences
  • Guided shore diving
  • Boat diving
  • Scuba equipment retail and customer service
  • Equipment rentals
  • Divemaster and professional-level training
  • Small student-to-instructor ratios with an emphasis on quality rather than volume

Being able to work both in-water and retail/shop shifts also gives our team greater scheduling flexibility and provides instructors with opportunities for more consistent hours when ocean conditions impact diving.

You’ll have the opportunity to teach, guide, work directly with customers, expand your knowledge of dive equipment, and continue developing into a well-rounded dive professional.

Employment Eligibility
Applicants must already be legally authorized to work in the United States and meet the requirements necessary to work and be insured as a dive professional in the U.S.

We are unable to sponsor work visas for international applicants.

Interested?
If you’re a PADI Instructor looking for a professional dive operation where you can teach, guide, work in retail, develop your skills, and become part of a close-knit team, we’d like to hear from you.

Please send your resume, PADI professional information, diving/instruction experience, retail or customer-service experience, availability, and a brief introduction about yourself to:

Maui Dreams Dive Co.
Email: info@bestmauidives.com
Phone/Text: (808) 874-5332

item.excerpt: Scuba Divers – Atlantis Dubai Atlantis Dubai is part of Kerzner International, and home to two extraordinary resorts: the world-renowned Atlantis, The Palm and the ultra-luxury Atlantis The Royal. Together, they represent world-class service, bold innovation, and unforgettable experiences brought to life. With over 6,000 colleagues from 129 nationalities, Atlantis Dubai operates as one team,...
item.description:
Scuba Divers – Atlantis Dubai

Atlantis Dubai is part of Kerzner International, and home to two extraordinary resorts: the world-renowned Atlantis, The Palm and the ultra-luxury Atlantis The Royal. Together, they represent world-class service, bold innovation, and unforgettable experiences brought to life.

With over 6,000 colleagues from 129 nationalities, Atlantis Dubai operates as one team, with many departments and back-of-house functions seamlessly supporting both resorts. Across every role and department, our shared purpose is the same: to create amazing experiences and everlasting memories – not only for our guests, but for our colleagues too.

About The Role

  • Follows all policies and procedures set in the Atlantis Dubai Dive Operations Manual.
  • Maintains exhibits, lagoons, and pools both above, and below the surface of the water.
  • Maintains Scuba equipment in good working order.
  • Conducts dive training for colleagues when required.
  • Logs and reports all equipment malfunctions to supervisor immediately.
  • Maintains dive logs and records of own dives, and those of guests/ colleagues having received any dive instruction.
  • Perform the duties of a surface dive tender for other in water divers, and acts as a first responder in case of an emergency.
  • Perform auxiliary dive activities outside of normal maintenance and guest programs; including, but not limited to sign holdings, underwater feedings, gating procedures.
  • Delivers educational and informative safety briefings, relaying conservation messaging and product knowledge of the resort.
  • Provides articulate and clear instructions to guests, which are fun, safe, engaging and positive; whereby Quality Assurance surveys and standards are met consistently.
  • Ensures a complete understanding and adheres to policies of all division / department policies.
  • Maintains a safe, secure, and healthy work environment for both people and animals.
  • Keeps current in regular training for self and for guests, as it pertains to first aid, rescue scenario drills and PADI standards.
  • Attends meetings and trainings as requested and required.
  • Maintains a sound knowledge of the Company’s facilities and related services.
  • Maintains confidentiality of information always received.
  • Performs other reasonable duties throughout the Division as requested by management.

About You

  • Renewed PADI Dive Master with DSD leader or above.
  • First Aid Certified.
  • Excellent health and physical condition; Passes annual Dive Medical.
  • Must demonstrate swim skills by successfully passing annual departmental swim test.
  • Positive attitude and strong work ethics.
  • Must be articulate and confident in written and spoken English.
  • Must be comfortable performing assigned duties in close proximity to all animals in our collection.
  • Must be able to perform diving duties involving heavy lifting of all dive and cleaning equipment.
  • Demonstrates mature responsible behavior in duties.

We offer a competitive, tax-free salary paid in UAE Dirhams (AED), alongside a wealth of benefits. These include generous food and beverage privileges, exclusive discounted rates at all Kerzner properties worldwide, comprehensive health insurance (with dental coverage), annual flights home, life insurance, an incentive programme, and a variety of colleague wellness and social initiatives.

With a strong emphasis on learning and development, colleagues at Atlantis enjoy access to world-class training, career mobility, and internal growth opportunities across the Kerzner portfolio – making this an ideal environment for ambitious individuals seeking a long-term, fulfilling career in luxury hospitality. Join the A-Team and discover the extraordinary.

If you are interested in joining our dynamic team, then please send your CV including your cover letter https://jobs.kerzner.com/job-invite/20336/

item.description:
Dive Instructor
Low Key Watersports | St. John, U.S. Virgin Islands

Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S.

Set your soul free.

Love diving, being on the water, and sharing that passion with others? Join Low Key Watersports! We’re looking for enthusiastic, safety-minded PADI Dive Instructors to lead daily dive trips and teach everyone from first-time Discover Scuba Divers to Divemaster candidates. Experienced instructors and newly certified pros alike are welcome to apply.

Responsibilities

  • Guide certified divers and snorkelers on daily boat trips (gear prep, guest assistance, equipment cleaning, tank fills)
  • Teach Discover Scuba, Open Water, Advanced Open Water, Refresher, Rescue Diver, and other PADI courses
  • Run dive-site, safety, and conservation briefings and post-dive debriefs
  • Prepare paperwork/course materials and process students through PADI
  • Review waivers and medical forms
  • Perform first-mate duties (docking, mooring, anchoring, emergency procedures)
  • Fill tanks and assist with equipment rentals
  • Safely guide divers to and from stationary dive sites
  • Help maintain boats, equipment, and dive areas

Schedule & Lifestyle
Open 365 days/year; holidays are peak season. Typical day: ~7:30 AM–5:30 PM, with occasional half days. Trips are mostly two-tank dives, plus weekly night dives and three-tank wreck trips. Full-time crew work 40–50 hrs/week depending on season.

Qualifications

  • Current PADI OWSI certification (active)
  • Current First Aid & CPR certification
  • Able to pass random drug screenings (Coast Guard compliance)
  • Able to stand for long periods outdoors in a marine environment
  • Able to lift/carry up to 50 lbs
  • Able to bend, squat, climb ladders, and move safely around boats/docks
  • Strong customer service and communication skills
  • Self-motivated, dependable team player
  • Legally authorized to work in the U.S.

No instruction experience? No problem — if you’re a newly certified OWSI with the right attitude, we’ll train you. Instructors cover their own annual PADI membership and drug consortium fees.

Benefits
Health/vision/dental (full-time), free diving, at-cost courses, reduced charter rates, discounted diving for friends/family, paid training, year-round work, competitive wages, bonuses, retail discounts, and a supportive team in a beautiful place to live and work.

About Us
Low Key Watersports has served the St. John diving community for 30+ years, offering dive charters, instruction, snorkeling, and retail, plus boat rentals via our sister company, Ocean Runner Powerboat Rentals. We work hard, prioritize safety, and love what we do.

“Set Your Soul Free.”

How to Apply
Reply with your current resume and a brief intro about yourself and your diving experience. Our Dive Program Manager will contact qualified candidates.

Please do not apply if seeking a visa/work permit.

item.description:
PADI 5* INSTRUCTOR DEVELOPMENT DIVE RESORT

Epic Ocean Adventures is a PADI 5* ​IDC Dive Resort located in Trincomalee, east coast of Sri Lanka, which has been operating locally for 9 years. We are a medium sized, family run operation and recently moved into a new place. We are the only local ​certified​ PADI5* ​IDC Dive Resort in Trincomalee.

 

Location:
We dive in Dutch Bay of Trincomalee. This place offers some of the best diving spots in the entire Sri Lanka. The crystal-clear waters, good visibility, 29 degrees of water. Rock formations, caves, swim through, temple debris, underwater museum, shipwrecks and marine life makes this place the top voted diving destination for this part of the world.

 

Candidate requirements:

If you are a friendly, helpful and service oriented personality who is looking for serious, high-quality training and diving in small groups whilst willing to improve and learn about the diving industry, join our team!

 

– 21 – 40 years old

– Available for a min ​3-4 month period

– PADI Rescue Diver or PADI Master Scuba Diver (or equivalent)

– Responsible, self-contained and serious about diving

– Prepared for long days during high season and have a more flexible schedule in low season.

– Excellent swimming skills

– Fluent in English + one additional language (Spanish/German​/Russian/Dutch)

– Enjoy socializing with clients

– Adept at social media

– Have a health medical statement (not exceeding 6 months)

– Well presented, honest & polite

*Non-smokers are preferable

 

Responsibilities:

– Assist certified instructors with dive courses (guiding dives, briefings, etc.).

– Assist with customer service (bookings etc.).

– Maintain and prepare dive gear.

– Assist with dive center operations (marketing, social media, etc.).

– Assist with Introduction dives, certified divers

 

Period:
We are looking for a candidate to join our team from ​April 2026 until October 202​6

We offer:

  • Accommodation​ (basic room at the dive center)
  • Participation to all diving shop activities
  • Free training (all PADI eLearning, materials and fees are paid by the candidate)
  • Opportunity to gain day to day experience in the work environment of the diving industry
  • Your part of tips

 

If you are interested in joining our hardworking team, please send a message to our W/A +94 777 00 97 76 together with a recent photo and information which languages you can speak.

http://instagram.com/epic_ocean

 

*We do only reply to applications which fulfil the requirements stated above

item.description:
Divemaster in Training

Location: Tobermory, Ontario
Company: Dive Life
Position: Seasonal

About the Role

Dive Life is looking for an enthusiastic Divemaster in Training to join our team in Tobermory.

This is a hands-on role designed for someone working toward their PADI Divemaster certification who wants to gain real-world experience within a busy dive operation.

You’ll work alongside Dive Life’s instructors, captains, Divemasters, and shop team while developing the practical skills required to become a confident and professional dive leader.

Key Responsibilities

Discover Scuba Diving (DSD) Support

Assist PADI Instructors with Discover Scuba Diving programs, including:

  • Preparing and organizing student equipment
  • Properly sizing and fitting BCDs, wetsuits, masks, fins, regulators, and weights
  • Setting up and breaking down scuba equipment
  • Helping participants get into and out of their equipment
  • Transporting equipment to and from training locations
  • Assisting instructors with organization and logistics
  • Providing surface support as directed by the supervising instructor
  • Cleaning, rinsing, inspecting, and properly storing equipment after programs
  • Preparing equipment for the next group

The Divemaster in Training does not replace the supervising PADI Instructor and will only participate in instructional activities within the limits of their current PADI certification and training.

Dive Charter Support

Assist with Dive Life’s daily charter operations, including:

  • Preparing rental equipment and customer gear
  • Loading and unloading boats
  • Helping customers transport and organize equipment
  • Assisting divers with gearing up
  • Helping maintain an organized and safe boat deck
  • Assisting with mooring and dock operations as directed by the captain
  • Providing surface support for divers
  • Helping divers enter and exit the water
  • Tracking and organizing rental equipment
  • Unloading, rinsing, and storing equipment following charters
  • Helping prepare boats and equipment for the next departure

As experience and training progress, opportunities may be available to assist Divemasters and Instructors with additional dive activities within PADI standards.

Snorkel Tours

Assist with Dive Life’s snorkel tours and private snorkel charters, including:

  • Preparing masks, snorkels, fins, wetsuits, and flotation equipment
  • Properly fitting guests with rental equipment
  • Helping guests understand basic equipment use
  • Loading and unloading snorkel equipment
  • Assisting guests entering and exiting the boat and water
  • Providing in-water support where appropriate
  • Helping maintain a fun, professional, and welcoming experience
  • Cleaning and organizing equipment after each tour

Dive Shop & Daily Operations

As part of the Dive Life team, you’ll also help with the everyday work required to keep a busy dive operation running smoothly.

This may include:

  • Preparing rental equipment
  • Filling and moving cylinders as permitted by training and company procedures
  • Cleaning and organizing equipment
  • Maintaining rental areas and gear storage
  • Assisting customers around the shop
  • Helping with general cleaning and facility organization
  • Preparing equipment for courses, charters, and snorkel tours
  • Helping with dock and boat operations
  • Assisting instructors, Divemasters, captains, and other team members as needed

Who We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is:

  • Currently working toward becoming a PADI Divemaster
  • Passionate about scuba diving and interested in becoming a dive professional
  • Reliable, punctual, and willing to work hard
  • Friendly and comfortable interacting with customers
  • Safety-conscious and able to follow direction
  • Comfortable working around boats and water

What You’ll Learn

Our goal is to help develop someone who understands not only how to become a Divemaster, but what it takes to be a valuable member of a professional dive operation.

Join Dive Life

This is much more than a traditional dive instructor position. item.description:
About the Role

Dive Life is seeking an experienced PADI Master Scuba Diver Trainer (MSDT) for a unique, hands-on leadership role in Tobermory, Ontario.

This is much more than a traditional dive instructor position. We are looking for a highly capable individual who can contribute across the entire operation—from teaching and guiding dives to equipment servicing, compressor operations, purchasing, retail, e-commerce, facility improvements, technology, and business development.

The ideal candidate knows Tobermory, understands the dive industry, is mechanically inclined, takes initiative, and enjoys making things work better.

Required Qualifications

  • Current PADI Master Scuba Diver Trainer (MSDT) in active teaching status
  • Proven experience teaching PADI courses in Tobermory
  • Strong knowledge of Tobermory\’s wrecks, dive sites, conditions, and Fathom Five National Marine Park
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and customer service skills
  • Valid driver\’s licence and legal authorization to work in Canada

Equipment Service Certifications

Applicants must have manufacturer technician certifications and servicing experience with:

  • Scubapro regulators
  • Zeagle regulators
  • Hollis regulators
  • Sherwood regulators

Strong mechanical knowledge of high-pressure compressors, breathing-air systems, filtration, fill stations, and safe cylinder filling procedures is also required.

Responsibilities

Diving & Instruction

  • Teach PADI recreational scuba courses
  • Conduct Discover Scuba Diving experiences
  • Lead guided dives and charter activities
  • Provide knowledgeable briefings on Tobermory wrecks and local diving conditions
  • Maintain high standards of safety, professionalism, and customer service
  • Mentor divers and promote continuing education

Equipment Service & Fill Operations

  • Service regulators and scuba equipment to manufacturer specifications
  • Maintain customer and rental equipment
  • Maintain accurate service records
  • Operate and maintain compressors and fill stations
  • Troubleshoot compressor, filtration, and fill-system issues
  • Maintain an organized and professional service workshop
  • Assist with preventative maintenance and technical improvements throughout the operation

Purchasing, Retail & Vendor Relationships

A significant part of this position involves helping grow Dive Life\’s retail business.

Responsibilities include:

  • Act as a buyer for the dive centre
  • Develop strong relationships with manufacturers, wholesalers, and distributors
  • Establish and maintain authorized dealership relationships
  • Negotiate wholesale pricing, purchasing terms, programs, and opportunities
  • Identify new brands and products that fit Dive Life\’s customers and business
  • Forecast seasonal inventory requirements
  • Purchase inventory and maintain appropriate stock levels
  • Monitor sales, inventory turnover, margins, and customer demand
  • Coordinate special orders and customer equipment packages
  • Maintain accurate retail inventory
  • Help develop promotions and sales strategies
  • Attend dealer events and industry trade shows when appropriate

Online Store, Website & Marketing

  • Manage and grow the Dive Life online store
  • Create and maintain product listings, descriptions, specifications, images, and pricing
  • Ensure online inventory and product information remain accurate
  • Improve product merchandising and the online customer experience
  • Assist with website development and maintenance
  • Apply SEO best practices to improve organic search visibility
  • Support Google Business Profile, digital advertising, email, and social media initiatives
  • Identify opportunities to increase online sales and expand Dive Life\’s reach

A background in web development, e-commerce, SEO, or digital marketing is a strong asset.

Facilities, Technology & Improvements

We want someone who is comfortable picking up tools and making improvements rather than always calling someone else.

This may include:

  • Building benches, shelving, storage, displays, and workstations
  • Repairing and upgrading aging shop infrastructure
  • General carpentry and facility maintenance
  • Installing and maintaining computers, internet, Wi-Fi, networking, printers, and related systems
  • Troubleshooting operational and mechanical problems
  • Developing practical solutions that make the shop safer, more efficient, and more professional

Who We\’re Looking For

We\’re looking for someone with an unusually broad skill set who enjoys being involved in all aspects of a dive operation.

One day you may be teaching a PADI course or guiding a Tobermory wreck. The next you may be servicing regulators, troubleshooting a compressor, meeting with a supplier, placing a seasonal equipment order, building a new workbench, improving the shop network, or adding products to the online store.

You are mechanically minded, comfortable with technology, commercially aware, and capable of working independently.

Most importantly, you take ownership. You notice what needs to be done, find solutions, and take pride in continually improving the operation.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.
    • Hourly wage between $24 – $32 per hour
  • Performance incentives
  • Opportunity for long-term/year-round employment
  • Significant responsibility and autonomy
  • Opportunity to help shape the growth of Dive Life
  • Work in one of Canada\’s premier freshwater diving destinations

This is an opportunity for the right person to become a key part of Dive Life—not simply as an instructor, but as someone who helps operate, improve, and grow the business.

Apply

Please submit your résumé, PADI Professional Number, relevant manufacturer service certifications, references, and a brief introduction outlining your experience in Tobermory and the skills you would bring to Dive Life.

Only applicants meeting the PADI MSDT and Tobermory experience requirements will be considered.

Blue Season Bali is looking for a Japanese-speaking PADI Instructor to join our team in Bali, Indonesia.

Established in 2001, Blue Season Bali is a well-established PADI 5 Star Career Development Center (CDC) based in Bali. We are proud to celebrate our 25th anniversary in 2026 and have been providing professional diving services to divers from Japan and around the world for many years.

We are looking for a Japanese-speaking PADI Instructor who is passionate about diving, enjoys working with people, and is committed to providing safe, professional and high-quality diving experiences.

Position

Japanese-Speaking PADI Instructor

Main Responsibilities

  • Conduct PADI courses from Discover Scuba Diving and Open Water Diver to advanced-level courses
  • Conduct fun diving and private dive trips
  • Provide professional briefings and dive guidance in Japanese and English
  • Assist Japanese-speaking customers throughout their diving experience
  • Maintain a high standard of diving safety and customer service
  • Complete all required dive center and PADI administrative work
  • Assist with equipment preparation, maintenance and dive operations
  • Work together with our international team of instructors, divemasters and operations staff
  • Support customer communication and follow-up when necessary

Requirements

Essential:

  • Valid PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor (or higher)
  • Current PADI membership and teaching status
  • Japanese native speaker
  • Good communication skills in English
  • Professional attitude and strong commitment to safety
  • Ability to work effectively as part of an international team
  • Physically fit and comfortable conducting multiple dives during busy periods

Preferred:

  • Experience teaching Japanese-speaking customers
  • Additional PADI Instructor ratings
  • Experience working in a busy dive center or resort environment
  • Knowledge of Bali’s dive sites
  • Experience with private diving, dive trips or dive travel
  • Other language skills are a plus

What We Offer

  • Work with an established and respected PADI 5 Star CDC in Bali
  • A friendly and international working environment
  • Opportunities to teach Japanese-speaking customers as well as international divers
  • Access to a wide range of Bali dive sites, including Nusa Penida, Padang Bai, Tulamben, Amed and Menjangan
  • Opportunities to conduct PADI courses, fun diving and private dive trips
  • Support from an experienced local and international team
  • Opportunities for professional development and additional PADI training
  • A chance to live and work in Bali while developing your career in the diving industry

About Blue Season Bali

Our philosophy is based on three core values:

Safety – Professionalism – Environmental Awareness

We believe that a great dive experience starts with safety and professional service. We are committed to maintaining high standards while creating enjoyable and memorable experiences for our customers.

Our team welcomes divers from Japan, Indonesia and many other countries, and we are looking for someone who can help us strengthen our Japanese-speaking diving operations.

Bali, Indonesia

Our main operations are based in Sanur, with diving activities conducted at various locations throughout Bali.

  • Your expected working period in Bali

Blue Season Bali

item.excerpt: Job Title: Marine Biologist – Go Eco Marine Biology Program Location: Utila, Bay Islands, Honduras Company: Utila Dive Centre About Us: Utila Dive Centre is a leading dive shop located on the beautiful island of Utila in the Bay Islands of Honduras. We are dedicated to promoting marine conservation and sustainable practices in the Caribbean....
item.description:
Job Title: Marine Biologist – Go Eco Marine Biology Program

Location: Utila, Bay Islands, Honduras

Company: Utila Dive Centre

About Us:

Utila Dive Centre is a leading dive shop located on the beautiful island of Utila in the Bay Islands of Honduras. We are dedicated to promoting marine conservation and sustainable practices in the Caribbean. Our Go Eco Marine Biology Program offers participants a hands-on, educational experience where they can immerse themselves in the wonders of marine life while contributing to conservation efforts.

We are seeking an enthusiastic, passionate, and experienced Marine Biologist to lead and run the Go Eco Marine Biology Program. This is an incredible opportunity to work in one of the most biodiverse marine environments in the world while fostering a greater appreciation for marine ecosystems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Program Leadership: Manage and lead the Go Eco Marine Biology Program, overseeing daily activities and ensuring all aspects of the program run smoothly.
  • Education & Training: Provide engaging lectures and guided dives to program participants, teaching them about marine ecosystems, coral reefs, fish species, marine conservation, and sustainable diving practices.
  • Fieldwork & Research: Conduct and supervise research and data collection related to marine biology, coral health, marine species, and the local ecosystem.
  • Conservation Projects: Coordinate with local conservation organizations to implement hands-on projects such as reef restoration, turtle monitoring, and marine debris clean-ups.
  • Diving and Snorkeling: Lead participants on dives and snorkeling trips to explore Utila’s coral reefs and other marine habitats, ensuring safety and providing educational commentary.
  • Team Collaboration: Work closely with the Utila Dive Centre team, including instructors, dive masters, and support staff, to ensure seamless integration of marine biology education into the center’s broader dive operations.
  • Guest Engagement: Inspire, educate, and motivate program participants by sharing your passion for marine biology and the importance of ocean conservation.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Marine Biology, Environmental Science, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 1 year of field experience in marine biology, preferably in tropical reef ecosystems.
  • Scuba diving certification (PADI Instructor or higher is preferred).
  • Experience in marine conservation, eco-tourism, or environmental education.
  • Strong public speaking and teaching skills, with the ability to communicate complex topics to a diverse audience.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish
  • Passion for marine life and conservation with a hands-on approach.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

What We Offer:

  • Salary and commissions.
  • Opportunity to live and work in a beautiful tropical environment.
  • Access to some of the world’s most biodiverse marine ecosystems.
  • Professional development opportunities and diving-related certifications.
  • A chance to make a direct impact on marine conservation efforts while inspiring others to do the same.

How to Apply:

If you are ready to make a difference and lead a unique marine biology program in one of the world’s most stunning underwater environments, we want to hear from you! Please send your CV, a cover letter detailing your experience and passion for marine biology, and any relevant certifications to josiah@utiladivecenter.com.

Utila Dive Centre is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all qualified individuals.

Join us in the beautiful Bay Islands of Honduras, and help shape the future of marine conservation while creating unforgettable experiences for eco-conscious travelers!

item.title: Dive instructor couple to operate dive school on award winning island in the Maldives
item.excerpt: We are looking for a responsible, genuine and flexible instructor couple to independently operate a small dive school on a beautiful, tiny, exclusive island in the Maldives. The island possesses just 30 luxury villas and can be circumnavigated in less than 10 minutes. A healthy reef encircles its green interior and white beaches and the...
item.description:
We are looking for a responsible, genuine and flexible instructor couple to
independently operate a small dive school on a beautiful, tiny, exclusive island in the
Maldives. The island possesses just 30 luxury villas and can be circumnavigated in less
than 10 minutes. A healthy reef encircles its green interior and white beaches and the
island is famous for diving and snorkeling both on the house reef and on the spectacular
dive sites in the vicinity. You would be running the complete dive school operation on a
daily basis so you would not only be guiding dives and teaching courses, but greeting
diving guests, filling tanks, maintaining and cleaning the dive school and dive
equipment, creating sales, billing, e-mail replies and administration. The resort operates
with a small team of expatriates and local staff and you would work as an integral part
of the management team.

The island has won many awards in recent years. The dive
school and watersports/excursion centre share one location on the island, so you would
work particularly closely with the friendly local watersports and excursions team.
Due to the small size of the island, it is essential that any interested couples would enjoy
working and living together in this intimate environment. You would also need to
possess enough experience to manage the operation successfully and our guests like a
friendly personality with excellent customer service skills. The initial contract would be
for a period of 6 months beginning in early October 2026 which is the start of our high
season. Ideally you would be able to teach in German and English and any other
languages such as Spanish or French, etc. would be useful. We would prefer if you were
both PADI and SSI instructors, but at least one of you must be both and the second just
an SSI instructor. We teach principally SSI, but also PADI. Any other qualifications or
skills you may possess involving equipment maintenance, compressor operation, Marine
biology, videography, etc. would be useful as well.

Please have a look at the resort and the diving pages at www.kandolhu.com where you
should be able to get a good idea about the island, the diving in the area, our exclusive
clientele and the dive service we offer. If you are interested, then please mail us your
recent CV, photo, some references and the date you would be available to start to:
pureaquatickand@gmail.com and we will reply to suitable individuals with a detailed job
description with the good conditions and an explanation of what this interesting
position involves. We look forward to hearing from you!
