item.description:
Open Water Scuba Instructor & Trip Leader
Broadreach hosts summer liveaboard marine biology trips for Middle and High School students. Currently hiring PADI Open Water Scuba Instructors for our sailing and diving programs for our summer 2027 season in the Caribbean. 

To be considered for this position, please complete the full application on our website. https://www.gobroadreach.com/broadreach-summer-jobs/

Background on Broadreach: Our mission is to challenge and inspire students to learn, grow, build skills and become better global citizens through hands-on discovery, travel and interaction with the world’s oceans, ecosystems and wildlife.

The Position:
Dive instructors work alongside marine biologists, skippers, or other dive instructors to successfully lead summer programs. 

Broadreach leads programs in multiple locations. Our biggest hub of activity is our liveaboard sailing programs, based out of Saint Martin. Instructors and students live aboard 45 foot catamarans for the duration of programs as they travel throughout the Leeward and Windward Islands. Each group is coed and will have 8-12 students with two to three instructors.

Instructors are expected to be flexible team players that foster a fun, safe environment for students to thrive and explore new places, cultures and activities. Instructors will teach Open Water, Advanced Open Water and specialities including, underwater naturalist, boat diver, AWARE-coral reef conservation, night diver, wreck diver, deep diver.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Guide students in developing safe diving habits through teaching Open Water and Advanced Open water courses.
  • Monitor mental health and physical well being of students while supervising a group in a 24/7 setting.
  • Facilitate positive group dynamics and address interpersonal conflicts while supporting students socially as they form connections with other members of the group.
  • Support students in new and unfamiliar circumstances and help them overcome challenges like homesickness, uncertainty, and navigating new cultural experiences while they travel internationally.
  • Participate in hiking, snorkeling, service projects, and other non-diving activities. Assist with field research, and marine science activities as appropriate to the program.
  • Communicate regularly with the Broadreach team regarding student needs, program logistics, and emerging issues.
  • Manage program budgets, expenses, receipts, and other program finances.
  • Assist with meal planning and supervise students cooking meals. 
  • Live and work alongside students and staff in close quarters aboard catamaran sailing vessels.

Qualifications:

  • PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor certification with active teaching status.
  • Previous experience working with teens or young adults, preferably in a camp or 24/7 setting.
  • Previous experience sailing or on a liveaboard program is encouraged but not required.

Contracts:

  • Food and accommodations are provided for instructors for the duration of their contract.
  • Contracts start the last week of May and will run through Mid August, 2027. Priority given to instructors who can work the full summer.

Dates: Early June to Mid August, 2027

Location: Saint Martin & the Leeward Islands

Our office is headquartered in Raleigh, NC and all our programs take place outside the US.

To apply: please complete the full application on our website https://www.gobroadreach.com/broadreach-summer-jobs/

item.description:
PADI Dive Instructor – Dive Center Pietermaai, Curaçao

Location: Pietermaai, Curaçao
Additional Location: Lagun, Curaçao
Start Date: As soon as possible
Employment: Full-time

About Dive Center Pietermaai

Dive Center Pietermaai is looking for an enthusiastic and professional PADI Dive Instructor to join our team at our 5-Star PADI Instructor Development Center (IDC) resort in Curaçao.

Located in the heart of Pietermaai, our dive center offers an exciting and varied working environment, with the opportunity to work at both our Pietermaai and Lagun locations.

We are an all-round dive operation where no two days are exactly the same. From teaching a wide range of PADI courses to guiding shore and boat dives, our instructors enjoy a diverse schedule and the opportunity to share Curaçao’s incredible underwater world with divers from all over the world.

We keep our diving personal and high-quality, with small groups of a maximum of six divers per instructor.

The Position

As a Dive Instructor, you will be responsible for providing safe, professional and enjoyable diving experiences to our guests and students.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Teaching a wide range of PADI courses, from beginner to professional level where qualified.
  • Conducting guided shore and boat dives.
  • Leading dives while maintaining the highest standards of safety and customer service.
  • Conducting dive briefings and debriefings.
  • Preparing and maintaining dive equipment and ensuring equipment is used safely.
  • Completing student paperwork and course administration accurately.
  • Providing excellent customer service and creating memorable experiences for our guests.
  • Working closely with the rest of our dive team.
  • Helping maintain a positive, professional and fun atmosphere within the dive center.
  • Working at both our Pietermaai and Lagun locations when required.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

  • A PADI-certified Dive Instructor in good standing.
  • Passionate about diving and enjoys sharing that passion with others.
  • Professional, reliable and safety-conscious.
  • Comfortable teaching a variety of courses and working with divers of different experience levels.
  • Friendly, outgoing and confident working with international guests.
  • A strong team player who enjoys working in a dynamic environment.
  • Flexible and willing to work at different locations around the island.
  • Able to work independently while also contributing positively to the team.

Additional PADI certifications and experience are an advantage.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work and live in beautiful Curaçao.
  • A position within a 5-Star PADI IDC resort.
  • The opportunity to work at both Pietermaai and Lagun.
  • A varied job combining teaching, guided dives, shore diving and boat diving.
  • Small-group diving with a maximum of six divers per instructor.
  • Salary in line with industry standards.
  • Housing is possible, making your move to Curaçao easier.
  • Additional employee benefits.
  • Insurance.
  • A friendly, international and professional working environment.
  • The opportunity to develop your diving and teaching experience in a tropical Caribbean environment.

Important Visa Requirement

Due to local island employment regulations, applicants must hold either a Dutch passport or a US passport to be eligible for this position.

Start Date

We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible.

How to Apply

Interested in joining us in Curaçao?

Please send your CV and a short introduction to:

daan@scubalodge.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

Join Dive Center Pietermaai and make your next dive adventure your career.

Coral Beach Diving Center in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, is seeking a qualified PADI Scuba Instructor with experience in scuba equipment maintenance and cylinder filling operations.

Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct PADI scuba diving courses and introductory diving experiences in accordance with PADI standards.

• Perform pre-fill inspections and maintain accurate cylinder-filling and compressor operation records.

• Carry out routine inspection, cleaning, testing and maintenance of scuba equipment, including regulators, BCDs, gauges, cylinder valves and rental equipment.

• Prepare, organize and inspect diving equipment before and after training sessions and diving trips.

• Wash, dry and store diving equipment correctly after use.

• Follow the center’s safety procedures and maintain a clean and organized equipment service area and compressor room.

Required Qualifications:

• Active PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor or higher.

• Valid First Aid and CPR certification.

• Certification or documented training in scuba equipment servicing and maintenance.

• Training or practical experience in operating a high-pressure breathing-air compressor and filling scuba cylinders.

• Good knowledge of scuba equipment, cylinder handling and diving safety procedures.

• Ability to communicate effectively in English. An additional language is preferred.

• Applicant must not be older than 29 years.

• Free accommodation provided by the company.

• Medical insurance provided.

• One annual round-trip airline ticket.

• Full-time employment in Dammam, Saudi Arabia.

Applicants must submit copies of their PADI credentials, equipment-maintenance certificates, compressor or fill-station training certificates, CV and relevant experience records.

item.description:
Dive Center Manager & Assistant Dive Center Manager Wanted!
The positions are open to couples applying for Dive Center Manager in combination with the Assistant Dive Center Manager role, or to the right individual applicants.

Papua Paradise Eco Resort & Gangga Divers in Raja Ampat – in the Heart of the Coral Triangle

We are looking for a passionate, experienced, and hands-on Dive Center Manager & Assistant Dive Center Manager to lead our PADI 5 Star dive operations at Papua Paradise Eco Resort & Gangga Divers, one of Raja Ampat’s premier eco-resorts. If you thrive in a dynamic high-volume remote environment, love delivering exceptional guest experiences, and want to contribute to marine conservation in one of the planet’s richest biodiversity hotspots, this is your opportunity.

Brief Position Overview
As Dive Center Manager (DCM), you will work closely with the Resort Manager and with the support of the Assistant Dive center manager to run the dive operation. Being responsible for the day-to-day management of the dive centre, its team, boats, equipment, and all diving/snorkelling/land excursion activities. You will ensure smooth, safe, sustainable and profitable operations while maintaining the highest PADI standards and delivering unforgettable tailored experiences for our guests.

The selected candidate will have following requirements, personal qualities and skills:

  • Minimum 3 years of professional dive industry experience, including at least 2 years in managing a busy dive operation in remote environment.
  • Active PADI MSDT or OWSI with at least Nitrox and Deep specialty instructor qualification.

item.description:
Are you our next Training manager?

We are looking for a multi-talented person to complete our management team at Purple Dive. You will be working closely alongside our General Manager, our Dive Ops manager and our Director.

 

 

Who we are:

We are a PADI CDC located in Nusa Penida, Bali. We have been operating since 2019. We are one of the leading dive centers in the area, with a recurring IDC program and a stellar reputation.

This is likely one of the nicest environments you will ever work with in terms of team work, support and general family vibe. Most of our staff members have been with us for years and we pride ourselves in our team.

Your future job as Training Manager:

  • Organise our IDC program (5 to 6 courses a year) and teach IDCs.
  • Lead the sales and communications relating to our professional training programs (answering emails, doing calls, and generating sales).
  • Supervise Divemaster training and carry out portions of their training.
  • Teach other PADI courses as required
  • Train up to admin and dive ops duties, with a goal to assist the management team and grow into a more managerial position

Certification level :

  • A PADI Course Director. We will consider also IDC Staff on a path to CD, with proven teaching experience, meaning you can teach IDC segments independently. Please DO NOT apply if you do not match these qualifications.

Other skills:

  • A team worker ready to lend a hand for other diving activities
  • A dive mentor who is willing to teach Divemasters and spend time growing them
  • A person with organisation skills and a good understanding of dive shop management, that can take over dive operations management to replace others when needed
  • Someone willing to grow their skills as a future general manager (meaning management, admin, accounting and such)

Languages:

  • Excellent English is required – bonus points for French, Mandarin, Indonesian or a combination of those.

 

What we offer:

  • Base salary and commissions, very good package
  • All income taxes paid by the company
  • Paid local health insurance
  • Paid PADI fees yearly
  • 5 weeks paid leave per year and one day off a week
  • The best team work you ever had

What we are looking for:

  • Someone willing to commit for at least a couple of years to grow into this job and their career
  • Someone willing to learn from our team and bring in their experience
  • Happy to work in a multicultural team
  • We strongly encourage women to apply if you feel this could be you!

Apply by email only – hel@purpledivepenida.com

Please include some references in your application.

item.description:
Dive Center & Watersports Assistant Manager (Base Leader) – German Speaking

Location: Robinson Noonu, Maldives
Department: Diving, Watersports & Excursions
Position: Assistant Manager / Base Leader
Language Requirement: German & English

About the Position

We are looking for an experienced, motivated, and hands-on Assistant Manager / Base Leader to support the Director of Operations (DOO) in the daily management and operation of the Diving, Watersports, and Excursions Department.

The Assistant Manager / Base Leader will work directly under the Director of Operations, assisting with the daily operational responsibilities, team coordination, guest service, activity planning, safety, and overall performance of the department.

In the absence of the Director of Operations, the Assistant Manager / Base Leader will be responsible for acting on behalf of the DOO and taking full responsibility for the daily operational duties and decision-making within the department, ensuring continuity of service and smooth business operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist and work directly with the Director of Operations on a daily basis.
  • Support the DOO in the overall management of Diving, Watersports, and Excursions.
  • Act as the designated operational lead in the absence of the Director of Operations.
  • Take responsibility for the daily operation and decision-making during the DOO’s absence.
  • Lead, motivate, and coordinate the Diving, Watersports, and Excursions teams.
  • Assist with daily planning, staff allocation, activity schedules, and operational briefings.
  • Ensure all activities are operated safely, professionally, and according to company standards.
  • Monitor guest satisfaction and ensure a consistently high level of service.
  • Support sales and revenue generation across diving, watersports, fishing, excursions, and other activities.
  • Coordinate boat operations, equipment preparation, maintenance, and activity readiness.
  • Handle guest requests, complaints, and operational challenges professionally.
  • Support staff training, coaching, and performance development.
  • Ensure compliance with PADI standards, safety procedures, resort policies, and local regulations.
  • Maintain effective communication with Resort Management and other departments.
  • Assist with daily reports, revenue monitoring, operational planning, and administration.
  • Ensure the department continues to operate efficiently and professionally in the absence of the DOO.

Requirements

  • PADI Instructor certification MSDT.
  • Minimum 3 years of professional diving, watersports, or marine industry experience.
  • Previous experience in a leadership, supervisory, or management position.
  • Strong knowledge of dive center, watersports, excursion, and boat operations.
  • Fluent German and good English communication skills are required.
  • Strong leadership, organizational, and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent guest-service and communication abilities.
  • Experience in a luxury resort or liveaboard environment is an advantage.
  • Valid first-aid/CPR certification and appropriate professional insurance.
  • Ability to work independently, take responsibility, and lead a multicultural team.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work in a beautiful Maldivian island resort environment.
  • Direct involvement in the daily management and operation of a diverse marine activities department.
  • International and professional working environment.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Single accommodation and meals in Guest Restaurant.
  • Professional development and career progression opportunities.

If you are an experienced marine professional with strong leadership skills, excellent guest-service standards, and fluent German, we would love to hear from you.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are invited to send their updated CV and relevant certifications directly to:

Musto Shaban
Director of Operations
Deep & Breeze Noonu
Email: doo@deepandbreezenoonu.com

 

Join our team and take an active leadership role in the Diving, Watersports & Excursions operation at Robinson Noonu, Maldives.

item.description:
DIVEMASTER INTERNSHIP – DUNE MEXICO | PLAYA DEL CARMEN

DUNE Mexico recherche 2 candidats Divemaster souhaitant rejoindre notre équipe à Playa del Carmen et acquérir une véritable première expérience dans le monde professionnel de la plongée.

 Période : entre novembre 2026 et mars 2027
 Durée : 2 à 4 mois
 2 places disponibles

 L’INTERNSHIP

L’objectif n’est pas simplement d’obtenir une certification Divemaster.

Pendant 2 à 4 mois, tu seras intégré à la vie quotidienne de notre centre de plongée et accompagné par notre équipe d’instructeurs afin de développer progressivement les compétences, l’autonomie et l’expérience nécessaires à ton futur rôle de professionnel de la plongée.

Tu participeras à la préparation et à l’organisation des activités, à l’accueil des plongeurs, aux briefings, à la logistique et aux différentes opérations quotidiennes du centre, tout en réalisant ta formation PADI Divemaster.

 CE QUE DUNE MEXICO PREND EN CHARGE

• Formation complète PADI Divemaster
• Plongées nécessaires à la formation
• Encadrement par notre équipe d’instructeurs
• Plongées d’expérience à Playa del Carmen pendant l’internship
• Intégration aux opérations quotidiennes du centre

Tu n’as pas encore le nombre de plongées nécessaire pour commencer ton Divemaster ?

 Selon ton niveau et ton expérience, DUNE Mexico pourra également prendre en charge les plongées manquantes afin de te permettre d’atteindre les prérequis nécessaires.

 RESTE À TA CHARGE

Le PADI Divemaster eLearning / Crewpack ainsi que les frais PADI applicables restent à ta charge.

Ils sont proposés au prix coûtant PADI, sans marge appliquée par DUNE Mexico.

Le transport jusqu’au Mexique, le logement, les repas, les assurances et les dépenses personnelles restent également à la charge du candidat.

 PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

• 18 ans minimum
• Rescue Diver PADI ou équivalent
• EFR / premiers secours à jour
• Français conversationnel
• Une deuxième langue : anglais ou espagnol
• Disponible au minimum 2 mois
• Sérieux, dynamique et autonome
• À l’aise avec la clientèle et le travail en équipe
• Envie de découvrir réellement le métier de Divemaster

Nous recherchons avant tout deux personnes souhaitant s’investir dans la vie d’un centre et acquérir une véritable expérience professionnelle, et pas uniquement obtenir une certification.

 CANDIDATURE

Envoie-nous :

• Ton CV
• Tes certifications actuelles
• Ton nombre de plongées
• Les langues que tu parles
• Tes disponibilités entre novembre 2026 et mars 2027
• Quelques lignes sur ton parcours, tes motivations et ton projet dans la plongée

 antoine.asso@dune-world.com

 Seulement 2 places disponibles

 DUNE Mexico – Playa del Carmen

Prefer sales experience/fill station experience for a busy South Florida CDC Center. **Must be US citizen or have US work VISA.** About Pura Vida Divers Founded in 2002, Pura Vida Divers is a...
item.description:
Job Description

About the role

We are seeking Divemasters with a passion for ocean conservation and a high level of customer service.  Prefer sales experience/fill station experience for a busy South Florida CDC Center.  **Must be US citizen or have US work VISA.**

About Pura Vida Divers 

Founded in 2002, Pura Vida Divers is a PADI 5 Star CDC dive center on Singer Island in South Florida.  We offer daily scuba charters aboard two dive vessels, scuba instruction from beginner to professional, and a full service shop featuring retail sales, equipment service, rentals, and a complete fill station.  Our love of diving, the ocean, conservation, education, and community inspires us every day to offer the best possible experience to our guests.

Job Description:  Participate in Pura Vida Divers programs, events and activities.  Generate sales of diver education programs, dive equipment, accessories and other merchandise through excellent customer service.  Operate a busy tank fill station.  Guide groups of divers along the local reefs and wrecks.

Location & Commitments

  • Ability to commute / relocate to the Palm Beaches area, South Florida…Must be legally eligible to work in the United States.
  • Permanent full time position
  • Weekend shifts required
  • Support of the dive equipment sold through the shop required
  • Pass a pre-employment drug screening

Candidate requirements

  • Customer service focused with excellent interpersonal skills.  Must be willing and able to work in a collaborative team environment with a diverse group of customers and team members.
  • High degree of self-motivation and the ability to work independently and as a team member.
  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule
  • Organizational ability in order to set priorities, organize workload, handle multiple responsibilities.
  • Overall understanding of computer operations and internet applications
  • Must be currently insured and renewed with PADI
  • Must be a PADI Divemaster or equivalent and current in CPR/First Aid
  • Physical Requirements: work in various physical environments and conditions and ability to carry scuba tanks and equipment repeatedly.

Benefits

  • Employee 401k
  • Vacation
  • Free charters, tank fills, and rentals
  • Employee Discounts on store merchandise and access to keyman programs
  • Continuing Dive Education Assistance

Contact us to apply

Contact Shana Phelan
info.pvd@puravidadivers.com

item.excerpt: 【募集要項】 ・インストラクターライセンスを所持していること ・EANxなど、スペシャルティ・インストラクターは有利な条件となります（持っているスペシャルティ・インストラクターの資格を明記してください） 肉体的･精神的に健康であること 明るく、向上心がある方、多国籍スタッフとチームワークで働ける方。 仕事に責任とやりがいを持てる方。 日常英会話ができる方。 泳ぐことができる方。 ポジティブで楽しく体を動かすことが好きな方。 清潔感があり、外見に刺青がないこと。 【お仕事内容】 インストラクターとしてガイド、講習を担当。日本人対応が主ですが、英語で世界各国から５スターリゾートに宿泊のお客様への接客。また他のマリンスポーツの 来客されるお客様への接客。それに伴う業務全般。メールの返信、通訳、和訳、ブログ、ツイッター更新等。 【応募資格】 一番大切なのは、経験よりも、あなた自身の人柄パーソナリティー。 募集要項にもありますが、明るく、多国籍スタッフとチームワークで働ける人、仕事に責任とやりがいを持てる人を探しています。 ・日本人として、日本人のお客様に接客ができる人を探していますが、世界各国からのお客様への接客も含まれます。 ・５スターリゾート内にある５スターマリンスポーツセンターでの勤務となります。それに従うサービスを提供できるスタッフを募集。楽しい仕事ですが、遊び心での勤務はご遠慮下さい。 ・重要な責任ある仕事を担当できる方。 【勤務地】 ●セブマクタン島、 シャングリラマクタンリゾート＆スパ内、デュシタニ・マクタン、シェラトンホテル、モーベンピック 【勤務期間】 3カ月の試用期間の後、約1年契約(労働ビザの期間による) 【給与】 経験、資格保持等により異なります。お問い合わせ下さい。 【待遇】 労働ビザ支給（取得・更新費用は会社負担です）契約以内に退職される場合は、一部個人負担となります。 賞与有り(給料１カ月分のボーナス) 毎月の基本給＋インセンティブ（コミッション）＋チップ 14か月以上の勤務終了後、手当有り。 14か月以上の勤務後、年に有給5日間、長期休暇2週間以上可能。 格安にてダイビングライセンスの取得。 住居：一部会社負担、（水道代、電気代は個人負担） 【問い合わせ方法】 興味がありましたら、まず、Eメールに日本語と英語(全身と顔写真付）、両方の履歴書を添付してお送り下さい。 楽しい職場で、一日を楽しく笑いながら、海がとってもきれいな場所で、過ごしてみませんか？目の前の海は、海洋保護区です。 mika@divescotty.com

一番大切なのは、経験よりも、あなた自身の人柄パーソナリティー。
募集要項にもありますが、明るく、多国籍スタッフとチームワークで働ける人、仕事に責任とやりがいを持てる人を探しています。
・日本人として、日本人のお客様に接客ができる人を探していますが、世界各国からのお客様への接客も含まれます。
・５スターリゾート内にある５スターマリンスポーツセンターでの勤務となります。それに従うサービスを提供できるスタッフを募集。楽しい仕事ですが、遊び心での勤務はご遠慮下さい。
・重要な責任ある仕事を担当できる方。

【勤務地】
●セブマクタン島、　シャングリラマクタンリゾート＆スパ内、デュシタニ・マクタン、シェラトンホテル、モーベンピック
【勤務期間】
3カ月の試用期間の後、約1年契約(労働ビザの期間による)
【給与】
経験、資格保持等により異なります。お問い合わせ下さい。

【待遇】
労働ビザ支給（取得・更新費用は会社負担です）契約以内に退職される場合は、一部個人負担となります。
賞与有り(給料１カ月分のボーナス)
毎月の基本給＋インセンティブ（コミッション）＋チップ
14か月以上の勤務終了後、手当有り。
14か月以上の勤務後、年に有給5日間、長期休暇2週間以上可能。
格安にてダイビングライセンスの取得。
住居：一部会社負担、（水道代、電気代は個人負担）

【問い合わせ方法】
興味がありましたら、まず、Eメールに日本語と英語(全身と顔写真付）、両方の履歴書を添付してお送り下さい。
楽しい職場で、一日を楽しく笑いながら、海がとってもきれいな場所で、過ごしてみませんか？目の前の海は、海洋保護区です。

Since 1983 Pro Dive Cairns has developed and maintained an international reputation as the premier dive company in Cairns. We offer the highest quality and best value liveaboard trips to the outer Great Barrier Reef. Our 3 multi million dollar purpose built dive vessels provide the very best outer reef liveaboard experience in Cairns.

  • Clear communicator and strong team player
  • Experience in dive or holiday destination operations
  • Genuinely customer-focused with an outgoing, personable nature
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently
  • Additional languages (German, French, Italian or others) highly regarded

 

Our selection process will involve a formal interview held in Cairns as well a 5 Day training/orientation trip to assess each candidate’s suitability to our organisation.

If you are a PADI diving professional looking for a position in the diving industry and have the necessary qualifications, skills and personal attributes we are seeking please apply today!

item.description:
Internship Type 1 (1)

The Maldives Manta Conservation Programme (MMCP) is excited to offer a Research & Guest Engagement Internship within our Raa Atoll project base.

This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of marine science, conservation, and luxury hospitality within a 5★ resort environment. The role combines hands-on research and conservation activities with engaging, guest-facing experiences in one of the world’s most iconic marine tourism destinations.

As a resort-based programme, guest engagement is a key part of this role. We therefore particularly welcome candidates who are fluent in English and additionally speak Mandarin or Russian, as these languages greatly enhance our ability to engage with key visitor demographics. We also strongly encourage applications from Maldivian nationals, with fluency in Dhivehi considered a valuable asset for supporting community engagement. However, we welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates, and language skills are just one part of the broader skill set we are looking for.

This internship is designed for individuals seeking hands-on experience in marine conservation within a luxury resort environment, combining guest engagement, education, research support, and data management. While rooted in manta ray science, the role places a strong emphasis on delivering high-quality guest experiences, communicating marine science to a diverse audience, supporting outreach initiatives, and contributing to ongoing research and conservation efforts.

The position also offers a unique opportunity to live and work within a world-class resort environment, while contributing to globally significant manta ray research and conservation.

We are looking for a confident, adaptable, and proactive marine conservationist who thrives in a dynamic, guest-focused environment and is excited to develop both their fieldwork and communication skills.

Location: Raa Atoll, Maldives (Resort-based)
Position Type: Internship
Availability: Minimum October 2026 to December 2026

It’s designed to build confident, safe dive pros while giving a solid overview of marine biology concepts and projects. Once certified, the candidates can proudly work as PADI SCUBA professionals, equipped with a deeper...
item.description:
Divemaster & Marine Biology Training Program South Africa

This program combines the PADI Divemaster training with an intro to marine biology. It’s designed to build confident, safe dive pros while giving a solid overview of marine biology concepts and projects.

Once certified, the candidates can proudly work as PADI SCUBA professionals, equipped with a deeper understanding of the marine environment and may even choose to further their education and pursue careers in Marine Science.Moreover, it will provide a unique and diverse skill set that can be applied to any future job and best of all it all happens right here in the heart of the White shark capital of the world! Program runs monthly from the 1st of the month.

Program Highlights:

  • ELMO Elasmobranch Egg Case Collection, rehydration and Analysis
  • Sea Fishing – Tag and Release – Boat shift, ORI catch & release
  • B.R.U.V. (Baited Remote Underwater Video) Analysis through PADI Project Aware Coral Reef ConservationProgram
  • Intertidal Transect Studies
  • Microplastics sampling (local beach sample collections)& processing via Density Separation
  • Seabird and Penguin Rehabilitation Centre (SAPREC)
  • Skippers training & Seamanship Orientation
  • PRE-SEA: Small Vessel Safety Induction Training & certification (required by law to work on any commercial vessel)
  • PADI Aware Dive Against Debris® specialty–  Beach Cleanup & Cleanup Dives with Data Collection…PIC Cert optional.
  • PADI Nudibranch Research Diver specialty –and related sea slug dives with data collection to determine reef health…PIC Cert optional.
  • SCUBA Diver Training and qualification via the sought after PADI SCUBA diver training courses at our 5-star Instructor Development Centre
  • Emergency First Responder (EFR) First Aid Training – you will become a certified First Aid Provider.
  • We run 2 shifts per day of 3 to 4 hours per shift, with some days off to relax and explore the beautiful Mossel Bay and surroundings.

  • Shark Week Program Highlights: (included in the 2 Month option)

  • PADI Aware Shark Conservation specialty – “Sharks in Peril and why should we care”
    • Classroom session, Learn about the challenges sharks face and what we can do to protect them. PADI AWARE Shark Conservation Diver Specialty certification optional extra.
  • Discover Scuba Diving Experience (for non-certified divers), Complete the PADI Discover Scuba Diver program & learn scuba basics and dive under the direct supervision of a qualified PADI Instructor. (Baited shark dive for qualified divers)
  • Shark Tagging with ORI (Oceanographic Research Institute), Head out aboard deep sea vessel “Salt Life Fishing” , Learn hands-on how to catch, handle, measure, tag, and safely release sharks, Participate in a citizen science tagging initiative.
  • Baited Shark Dive + B.R.U.V. Operation, Scuba dive with shy sharks and deploy and retrieve a Baited Remote Underwater Video (B.R.U.V.). Learn how to set up and operate this tool used to observe shark behaviour.
  • Video Review + E.L.M.O Egg Case Session,  Review your B.R.U.V. video,lLearn how to identify species and understand shark presence in local waters.  ELMO: Elasmobranch Egg Case Collection and Analysis, collect, rehydrate, measure and document shark egg cases.
  • White Shark Cage Diving with White Shark Africa. Depart on shark cage dive vessel “First Strike” & experience Mossel Bay’s Great White Sharks from a cage.

Additional Activities:

Beyond marine research and diving, participants can engage in a variety of optional activities, including horse riding safaris, game drives, lighthouse hiking trails, skydiving, sailing trips, and wine tasting at local vineyards.

Accommodation: Accommodation and airport transfers are available upon request, ensuring a seamless experience throughout your training. Accomodation can be arranged for you at about R6000 per month. (About $340) *subject to availability 

OPTION 1 – 1 Month:

Padi Open Water Diver + Advanced Diver + Rescue Diver + SAMSA Skippers Training and Seamanship Orientation + Emergency First Responder (EFR) + Program highlights as set out above. $2350 – R41900 (subject to change and exchange rate dependent)

OPTION 2 – 2 Months: (Divemaster option) – Recommended

Padi Open Water Diver + Advanced Diver + Rescue Diver + SAMSA Skippers Training and Seamanship Orientation + Emergency First Responder (EFR) + PADI DIVEMASTER + Program highlights as set out above + Shark Week Program highlights !

$4230 – R75900 (subject to change and exchange rate dependent)

gardenroutescuba@gmail.com,more info on www.gardenroutescuba.co.za/marinebio

item.description:
Job Description

Bali Diving Academy — a PADI 5-Star CDC established in 1991 — is looking for a Dive Centre Leader to run our Nusa Lembongan location. English and Mandarin Speaking will be prioritized.

This is a management role first.

You run the shop, lead the team and drive the sales — and you teach when the schedule needs you to.

THE ROLE

  • Managing bookings, reservations and the daily dive schedule
  • Handling walk-ins and turning enquiries into sales
  • Greeting and looking after customers — instructors are teaching, divemasters are on the boat, so the shop experience is yours to own
  • Collecting and reconciling payments
  • Completing all paperwork: certification checks, medical questionnaires, course documentation
  • Leading and supervising the local team, and stepping in wherever help is needed
  • Making sure equipment and facilities are maintained and used correctly
  • Retail: stock, displays, merchandising and upselling
  • Teaching PADI courses when needed
  • Daily planning, problem solving, reporting and basic accounting
  • Socialising with divers — before, between and after dives

WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • PADI MSDT or above, with solid experience
  • Proven managerial experience
  • Strong sales ability, and the initiative to come up with new ideas to grow business on location
  • A team leader by nature, who works well with local staff
  • Excellent customer-oriented attitude, consistently
  • Fluent English; other languages a plus (Chinese especially)
  • Social media, digital marketing or photography skills are a big plus
  • Minimum 12-month commitment

WE OFFER

  • Base salary, housing allowance, revenue-based commission and teaching commission
  • Full-year work permit and taxes covered
  • Great diving

HOW TO APPLY

Start date: ASAP

If you think you’re the right person, send your CV to hrd@scubali.com.

oceanmanta33@gmail.com

item.description:
TITLE: RETAIL & MARKETING ASSISTANT

Are you ready to take the plunge into the ultimate job opportunity with a multi-award-winning PADI Dive Centre located in one of the best cities in the world? Then, Dive Centre Manly wants you to join our team!

Located in the heart of Sydney’s stunning Northern Beaches (Australia) and just a quick 24-minute ferry ride away from bustling city life, Dive Centre Manly is your gateway to a world of underwater adventure!

We offer a complete range of premium snorkel & dive gear, dive courses from beginner level Introduction to Snorkelling & Discover Scuba up to Instructor level and beyond – including Sydney’s most talked about Learn to Dive course.

PRIME OBJECTIVE OF THE ROLE:

To enhance customer engagement and drive sales with exceptional in-store customer service and reservation handling.

MAIN PERFORMANCE INDICATORS:

  • Customer inquiries & bookings
  • Retail sales
  • Store presentation
  • Divemaster Duties

TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES: (Each task is important. The order they appear does not indicate priorities.)

  • Manage and create engaging content for social media platforms
  • Assist customers with retail sales, providing product knowledge and recommendations
  • Handle reservations and customer inquiries
  • Maintain a clean and organised retail space
  • Opportunities to lead in water activities

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE:

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Experience with social media and email marketing
  • Customer service or retail experience is a plus
  • Passion for scuba diving and the marine environment
  • Driving licence
  • PADI Divemaster or above

PERKS & BENEFITS:

  • The chance to work with some of Australia’s most experienced divers
  • Access to outstanding employee discounts on gear purchases & servicing
  • Free use of tank fills & weights
  • Friends & family discount
  • Opportunities for professional development / speciality ratings
  • Flexible working conditions
  • Discounted local, interstate & international travel

item.description:
PADI Instructor Wanted – Dragon Dive Komodo, Indonesia

Start: ASAP
Duration: 6–12 months

Are you looking for the opportunity to work in one of the world’s most iconic dive destinations?

Dragon Dive Komodo is currently looking for a PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor (MSDT rating minimum with 2 years of teaching experience) to join our international team as soon as possible. We are looking for someone available to cover the low season, with the possibility of staying through the high season and beyond.

We are especially looking for French- or Spanish-speaking instructors, as these languages are currently needed within our team.

What We Offer

  • Full-time instructor position (6 working days per week, 1 day off)
  • Competitive salary
  • Daily diving in the world-famous Komodo National Park
  • Professional and friendly international team
  • Opportunity for long-term employment based on performance
  • Some trips as Dive guide on our Liveaboard
  • A chance to teach and guide divers in one of the best dive destinations on the planet

Why Komodo?

Komodo National Park is renowned for its breathtaking underwater landscapes, thrilling drift dives, and exceptional marine biodiversity.

You’ll regularly encounter:

  • Manta rays
  • Reef sharks
  • Sea turtles
  • Schools of trevallies, tuna and barracuda

Preferred (but not essential)

  • Previous experience in a busy dive centre
  • Additional languages
  • Experience guiding / teaching certified divers in  “real” current conditions

Accommodation

We can help you find affordable accommodation in Labuan Bajo before your arrival.

If you’re looking for an exciting opportunity to develop your career while diving every day in one of the world’s most spectacular marine environments, we’d love to hear from you.

item.excerpt: Are you dreaming of turning your passion for diving into a professional career while living on a tropical island surrounded by incredible marine life? item.description:
Are you dreaming of turning your passion for diving into a professional career while living on a tropical island surrounded by incredible marine life? Join Dune Sakalav Diving in beautiful Nosy Be for an exciting Divemaster Internship and take the next step toward becoming a dive professional!

We are looking for a motivated French or English speaking candidate to join our friendly international team as soon as possible, in preparation for the upcoming high season.

What We Offer:

  • A hands-on 3–6 month Divemaster Internship
  • Real experience working in a busy tropical dive centre
  • Training in all aspects of dive centre operations
  • Daily diving in one of the most biodiverse marine environments in the Indian Ocean
  • A fun, supportive, and professional atmosphere
  • The chance to encounter:
    • Whale sharks during the October-November season
    • Humpback whales August – September
    • Sea turtles, rays, guitar sharks, vibrant coral reefs, and abundant tropical fish
    • Many rare species of nudibranch, frogfish and ghost pipefish

Why Nosy Be?

Nosy Be is a true paradise island, famous for its warm waters, stunning beaches, and exceptional terrestrial and marine biodiversity. Every day here feels like an adventure both above and below the surface. On your days off, you can explore the surrounding islands and nature reserves, where you will see wild lemurs and chameleons and maybe nesting sea turtles.

Requirements:

  • PADI Rescue Diver
  • Minimum 40 logged dives
  • Valid EFR (Emergency First Response) certification completed within the last 24 months
  • French or English speaking
  • Dive medical within the last 12 months
  • Motivated, positive, and eager to learn
  • Preferably you have your own dive equipment, although rental equipment is available at the dive centre if needed

Accommodation:

We can offer a very good deal on accommodation for candidates who prefer not to arrange their own housing. It is easy to find affordable places to rent on Facebook or by word-of-mouth on the island.

Future Opportunities:

For the right candidate, there may be:

  • The opportunity to progress to PADI Instructor and complete your PADI IDC
  • Potential employment with Dune Sakalav Diving after the internship

If you are ready for an unforgettable experience combining professional growth, adventure, and ocean life in Madagascar, we would love to hear from you!

📩 Apply now with your CV and a short introduction about yourself.

Dive Centre Manly is looking for an experienced and motivated Assistant Dive Centre Manager to join our leadership team.

Located on Sydney’s Northern Beaches, we are a leading PADI Dive Centre offering diver training, guided diving, dive travel, equipment servicing and retail sales. Starting in October 2026, this full-time position has been created to support our busy summer season, eventually transitioning into the Dive Centre Manager Role.

This is a hands-on leadership role supporting the day-to-day operation of the dive centre, customer enquiries, bookings, retail sales and marketing support.

Key Responsibilities

• Assisting with the daily operation of the dive centre
• Managing customer enquiries via phone, email and in person
• Retail and equipment rental sales
• Inventory organisation and presentation
• Supporting marketing and social media initiatives
• Maintaining high standards of customer service and operational excellence

Essential

• Minimum 2 years’ experience working as a PADI Dive Professional
• Previous experience working in a busy retail environment
• Excellent customer service and communication skills
• Strong written and spoken English
• Full and current driver’s licence
• Current Australian working rights

Highly Desirable

• PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor or higher certification
• Previous dive centre management experience
• Experience using Rezdy or similar reservation systems
• Experience creating social media content and marketing campaigns

 

What We Offer

• A full-time leadership position with one of Australia’s leading PADI Dive Centres
• A diverse role combining retail operations, customer service, diving and leadership
• Ongoing professional development opportunities
• Staff discounts on diving travel and equipment
• The opportunity to work alongside a passionate team in one of Sydney’s most iconic beachside locations

If you feel you meet most, if not all, of the selection criteria, we’d love to hear from you.

Please send your CV and covering letter to:

info@divesydney.com

Please note: Applicants must already hold unrestricted Australian working rights. Applicants requiring sponsorship or without current Australian working rights will not be considered.

item.title: 🌊 PADI DIVEMASTER INTERNSHIP – FUERTEVENTURA
item.excerpt: Turn your passion for diving into your profession 🤿 Are you thinking about making diving more than just a hobby? Fuerteventura Buceo is looking for a motivated and dynamic Divemaster Trainee who wants to take their first real step into the professional diving world. We offer you the opportunity to complete your PADI Divemaster course...
item.description:
Turn your passion for diving into your profession 🤿

Are you thinking about making diving more than just a hobby?

Fuerteventura Buceo is looking for a motivated and dynamic Divemaster Trainee who wants to take their first real step into the professional diving world.

We offer you the opportunity to complete your PADI Divemaster course in exchange for approximately two months of work and practical training with our dive centre.

During this time, you will become part of our team, learn how a professional dive centre operates and gain real hands-on experience in the diving industry.

And if you’re coming from outside Fuerteventura, don’t worry about finding somewhere to live: accommodation is available in our shared house during your internship. 🏠

More than just a Divemaster course

The PADI Divemaster is your first professional-level certification in diving.

For us, becoming a Divemaster is not simply about completing exercises and getting a certification. We believe that if you want to work professionally in diving, you need to learn how the job really works.

That’s exactly what we want to teach you.

During your internship, you will work alongside our team and take part in the daily operation of the dive centre.

You’ll learn how to prepare and organise diving activities, assist our dive professionals, prepare and care for equipment, help with tanks and daily logistics, welcome and look after customers and understand everything that happens behind the scenes to make a diving day run smoothly.

We operate mainly from our dive boat, Diving My Life, so you’ll also gain valuable experience in the organisation and daily operation of boat diving.

Our way of working ❤️

Customer care is extremely important to us.

We like our divers to feel welcome, comfortable and genuinely looked after from the moment they arrive.

We also take great pride in looking after our equipment, our boat and our dive centre. We believe that being a good dive professional also means paying attention to the small details, taking responsibility and caring for everything around you.

We’re looking for someone who shares that attitude.

Who are we looking for?

We’re looking for someone dynamic, proactive, responsible and enthusiastic, with a genuine desire to learn and work.

Someone who isn’t afraid to get involved, help wherever needed and become part of the daily life of the centre.

You should be friendly, practical, comfortable working with people and willing to work hard.

Most importantly, we’re looking for someone who is seriously interested in developing a professional career in the diving industry.

We don’t expect you to arrive as a dive professional.

We want to help you become one.

What we offer

🤿 PADI Divemaster training in exchange for your work and commitment

🗓️ Approximately 2 months of training and practical experience with our team

🏠 Accommodation available in our shared house during the internship

🛥️ Real experience in a professional, boat-based dive operation

🌊 Practical experience both underwater and behind the scenes

👥 Experience working with customers and organising diving groups

🔧 Hands-on experience with equipment, tanks and daily dive-centre logistics

❤️ A friendly environment where customer care and attention to detail really matter

🎓 The opportunity to earn your first professional diving certification while gaining real-world experience in the profession

This opportunity is ideal for someone who has decided that diving could become their future profession and wants much more than simply completing a certification.

You’ll earn your Divemaster certification while learning what it really means to work as a dive professional.

Interested? 🌊

📍 Fuerteventura Buceo – Fuerteventura, Canary Islands, Spain

📲 WhatsApp: +34 622 196 610

Send us a message telling us a little about yourself, your current diving certification and experience, the languages you speak, your availability and, most importantly:

Why do you want to become a dive professional?

Come to Fuerteventura, join our team, train with us and take your first real step into the professional diving world. 🤿🌊

item.title: Dive Center Manager / Operations Coordinator – Fuerteventura, Canary Islands
item.excerpt: Fuerteventura Buceo is looking for a responsible, dynamic and highly organised person to take an important role within our team in Fuerteventura, Canary Islands. We are not simply looking for another diver or instructor. We are looking for someone capable of taking responsibility for the day-to-day organisation and operation of a busy dive centre, coordinating...
item.description:
Fuerteventura Buceo is looking for a responsible, dynamic and highly organised person to take an important role within our team in Fuerteventura, Canary Islands.

We are not simply looking for another diver or instructor. We are looking for someone capable of taking responsibility for the day-to-day organisation and operation of a busy dive centre, coordinating diving groups, staff and daily activities.

Our way of working is very important to us.

We operate mainly from our dive boat, Diving My Life, and we strongly believe that a great diving experience is about much more than just the dive itself.

We genuinely enjoy taking care of our guests. We want every diver who joins us to feel welcome, comfortable, safe and well looked after from the moment they arrive until the end of their diving day.

The same philosophy applies to our dive centre, boat and equipment. We pay close attention to maintenance, organisation and small details, and we are looking for someone who shares these standards and takes pride in keeping everything running properly.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for someone with strong organisational and leadership skills, who is confident coordinating groups of divers and managing the daily logistics of a dive operation.

You should be proactive, practical and able to make decisions when necessary. We need someone who can recognise what needs to be done and take the initiative, rather than waiting to be told what to do.

German language skills are essential, as a significant part of our clientele is German-speaking. Additional languages are highly valued.

Accommodation

For candidates relocating to Fuerteventura, we can provide accommodation in our shared staff house, making it easier to settle on the island and become part of the team.

We want the right person to be able to focus on the job and enjoy the experience of living and working in Fuerteventura without having to worry about finding accommodation on the island.

Experience within the diving industry is a strong advantage. However, it is important to understand that this is primarily a management and operations position, not simply an instructor position.

We are looking for someone who wants to become genuinely involved in the project and who shares the three principles that define the way we work:

Organisation. Care. Great customer service.

If you are responsible, energetic, organised, comfortable leading people and confident taking charge of the daily operation of a dive centre, we would be very happy to hear from you.

📍 Fuerteventura Buceo – Fuerteventura, Canary Islands, Spain

📲 WhatsApp: +34 622 196 610

Please contact us and tell us a little about yourself, your previous experience, the languages you speak and why you think you would be a good fit for our team.

The position combines marine biology, conservation and guest education with water-based activities in one of the most pristine marine environments in the Maldives. The role is approximately 70% focused on the Ocean Lab and marine...
item.description:
We are looking for a passionate and guest-focused Chinese-Speaking Marine Biologist to join our team at Park Hyatt Maldives Hadahaa.

The position combines marine biology, conservation and guest education with water-based activities in one of the most pristine marine environments in the Maldives.

The role is approximately 70% focused on the Ocean Lab and marine biology activities, and 30% on water activities through the Marine Experience Center.

Main Responsibilities – Ocean Lab & Marine Biology (70%)

– Support the daily operations and initiatives of the Ocean Lab.
– Conduct marine biology presentations, educational activities and guest experiences.
– Educate guests about Maldivian marine ecosystems, coral reefs, marine species and conservation.
– Participate in marine conservation, monitoring and research initiatives.
– Support data collection and documentation related to marine life and reef health.
– Engage with international guests, making marine science accessible, interesting and enjoyable.
– Promote responsible interaction with the marine environment and sustainable practices.
– Collaborate with other resort departments on environmental and educational initiatives.

Water Activities – Marine Experience Center (30%)

– Lead guided snorkeling experiences.
– Conduct marine biology and snorkeling excursions.
– Participate in boat excursions and other marine activities.
– Assist with scuba diving activities within the limits of your diving certification.
– Provide marine-life interpretation during snorkeling, diving and boat excursions.
– Support the Marine Experience Center team with water activities when operationally required.
– Maintain the highest standards of guest service and water safety.

Minimum Requirements

– English B2 level or above
– PADI Rescue Diver certification or equivalent Instructor is a plus
– Degree or relevant educational qualification in Marine Biology, Marine Science, Environmental Science or a related field
– Strong swimming and snorkeling skills
– Good knowledge of marine ecosystems and marine conservation
– Confident and engaging communication skills
– Comfortable interacting with guests in a luxury hospitality environment
– Ability to work effectively within a multicultural team
– Willingness to live and work on a remote island
– Minimum 12-month commitment

Preferred Qualifications

– PADI Divemaster or higher
– Previous experience in the Maldives or another tropical marine environment
– Experience with coral reef monitoring, marine conservation or research projects
– Experience leading guided snorkeling or marine biology excursions
– Previous luxury resort or hospitality experience

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is genuinely passionate about marine science and conservation but who also enjoys being in the water and interacting with guests.

The ideal candidate will be equally comfortable discussing coral reef ecology in the Ocean Lab, guiding guests on a snorkeling excursion, or supporting the team during a scuba diving or boat experience.

If you are passionate about the ocean, marine conservation and sharing your knowledge with guests from around the world, we would love to hear from you.

item.excerpt: We are looking for a few parttime PADI Scuba Instructor with a few years of experience to join our team! The salary will be negotiated individually. Other benefits may include obtaining new professional ratings, either through co-teaching or a seminar with a special discount. Further we are looking for people with the following skills and...
item.description:
We are looking for a few parttime PADI Scuba Instructor with a few years of experience to join our team!

The salary will be negotiated individually. Other benefits may include obtaining new professional ratings, either through co-teaching or a seminar with a special discount.

Further we are looking for people with the following skills and personal attributes:

  1. Professional presentation
  2. Good knowledge of all PADI courses and standards
  3. Excellent communication skills
  4. Excellent team worker
  5. Very Customer orientated
  6. Outgoing but not overbearing
  7. Ability to use own initiative and work unsupervised

Requirements:

  • One or more years prior experience as a Dive Instructor.
  • Actively certified as a PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor. Specialty Instructor a plus
  • Current resident of Connecticut.
  • Currently certified in First Aid & CPR, as defined by PADI specifications.
  • Must be in good standing (no recorded ethics violations or quality assurance issues) with PADI; must have established safety record
  • Must be eligible for required insurance or presently insured and renewed.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills
  • Must be able to work weeknights and weekends.
  • Have valid Connecticut diver license and own transportation, to transport scuba equipment.
  • Be a current resident of Connecticut.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to work in various physical environments & conditions, including in the classrooms, pools, lakes, on the boats, in the ocean, etc.
  • Ability to maintain control of a group of at least 6 students and perform rescues in-or-out of water as necessary

item.description:
Sindbad Dive Club

We are a PADI 5-star IDC Resort located inside the Berenice Beach Club in South Beach, Aqaba-Jordan. We are right in the heart of the marine park with our in-house dive site.

We are looking for a couple PADI Scuba Instructors …

We are looking for highly motivated individuals, with the ability to work in teams, with a strong sense of security, with high-risk management and customer satisfaction, assiduous and punctual, and flexible in the tasks to be performed, as well as flexible in working hours.

Requirements:

  • Couple instructors in active status.
  • Professional + medical dive insurance.
  • Fluent in English (other languages a plus specially Germany, Spanish or French).
  • Instructor specialties preferable.
  • Own Dive Equipment is mandatory.

Responsibilities:

As a team we carry on the day-to-day responsibilities and all kinds of common logistical tasks to ensure the smoothest running of the operations.

Such responsibilities include but are not be limited to:

  • Leading certified divers, teaching PADI, DSDs and courses, carrying on all occasional and supervising snorkelers.
  • Welcome customers and help with registration and orientation.
  • General routine cleaning and maintenance of the dive center.
  • General day-to-day set up of the dive center and filling tanks.
  • The complete information will be sent to those who apply.
  • Refill Tanks & Maintenance.

Benefits:

Fixed/basic monthly salary of 550USD (390JOD)
commissions on PADI courses, DSD program and certified night dives
Transportation to/from Aqaba downtown to work and back. Lunch at the staff cantien.
Private room in shared accommodation with another instructor (or max 3 instructors).

Note: Flights are not reimbursed. The complete information will be sent to those who apply.

 

If interested please send your resume, the screenshot of your student count page, a photo and your expected availability to divingmanager@sindbadjo.com

PLEASE NOTE: Short listed candidates will be contacted within 7 days. However, we strive to keep other CVs in file for possible future use.  

We wish you a good day and we look forward to hearing from you.

Thank you,
Sindbad Dive Club team.

Position: Experienced Dive Instructor with Coxswain...
item.description:
Experienced Dive Instructor(s) w/ Coxswains (or Masters)

Job Description

We have exciting opportunities for experienced Dive Instructors with minimum Coxswains NC1 qualifications (or Master 5’s for Coxswains class vessels) to join our expanding Dive Team at Keppel Dive & Water Sports located on the beautiful Great Keppel Island, Yeppoon, Queensland.

Position: Experienced Dive Instructor with Coxswain NC1 or greater. Will also consider Dive Masters with Coxswain and stand-alone Coxswains NC1 or greater.

Location: Great Keppel Island, 4703, Yeppoon, Queensland 4703, Australia

Great Keppel Island is located just 30mins from Yeppoon on the magical Capricorn Coast on the Southern Great Barrier Reef. As a PADI accredited Dive Resort, Keppel Dive & Water Sports provides everything from Introductory & Certified Boat Dives to PADI accredited dive courses including Open Water, Advanced Open Water and Rescue Dive Courses.

We offer diverse, small group experiences to ensure your Diving & Charter Tourism career is full of variation and your time on the island and mainland is both enjoyable and educational. Keppel Dive & Water Sports work on a number of scientific and Traditional Owner contracts, so you’ll also be part of the protection and preservation of the Great Barrier Reef and its cultural heritage.

Funtastic Cruises is the Capricorn Coast’s premier sailing and cruising charter experience. Including sailing and tourist power boat adventures, Funtastic Cruises offers full day and sunset charters for public and private hire around the Keppel Islands.

We are seeking Dive Instructors/Dive Masters with Coxswain NC1 Certification (minimum) for short- and long-term positions. The successful candidates must have a strong understanding of water safety protocols including operating commercial vessels, snorkelling and scuba diving. Higher preference given to those with Coxswains NC1 or Master 5 with strong Maintenance/mechanical experience. Dive Masters with a Coxswains NC1/Master 5 or above ticket will also be seriously considered.

Pay: Competitive hourly/annual packages plus benefits available for the right candidate.

Skills/Qualifications required:

  • PADI Dive Instructor (or Master)
  • Experienced Coxswain NC1 or Master 5 for Coxswain class vessels
  • Mechanical and Maintenance experience highly regarded
  • Dive Medical Clearance: AS/NZ 2299.1
  • O2 certification
  • Advance CPR: 02 HLTAID 009/015
  • First Aid: HLTAID 009/010/011
  • Australian Working rights
  • Great customer service skills

The Duties of the Dive Instructor / Coxswain include:

  • Guest & Class orientations on arrival
  • Conducting dive courses (Open Water, Advanced, Rescue, and Discover Scuba dives)
  • Skipper of commercial vessels
  • Deckhand responsibilities
  • Previous marine experiences: sailing and power boat charters, scuba diving, snorkelling, kayaks.
  • Island tours: Full day & Sunset charters, Snorkelling, Boat tours, Island Water Taxi
  • Occasional operations of the on-island dive hut
  • Conduct Great Barrier Reef studies & surveys
  • Equipment and vessel maintenance

What’s Included:

  • Dive Insurance
  • Subsidised On-Island Accommodation
  • On island & Ferry Staff Discounts
  • Market competitive remuneration
  • Diverse role with opportunities to grow your Tourism & Hospitality career.

The Dive position is a ‘live on island’ role in your own room at heavily reduced rates. You must have ability to work unrestricted within Australia.

If you are looking for a once in a lifetime opportunity to live and work on a beautiful island archipelago on the Great Barrier Reef and would like to become a member of a Best of Queensland, Eco-Accredited and GBRMPA High Standard Tourism Operator, then please attach your resume and cover letter here or send a brief cover letter and your resume to Funtasticcruises@outlook.com or call us on 0438733632 for more information.

item.description:
Bayplay Adventure Tours & PADI 5 Star Dive Resort.

We run a range of activities including sea kayaking, snorkel, paddleboarding, bike riding as well as our dive programs plus marine education camps and programs. We also have a retail store and accommodation.

We are a highly professional organisation with sound structure and high standards of diving education & customer service which is proved by our excellent track record. Bayplay is the State Tourism Award Winner for Adventure Tourism and has also won awards for innovation and environmental sustainability.  We are located in a pristine holiday location surrounded by national parks and beaches.

About you…  

We are looking for an enthusiastic, outgoing and self-motivated dive professional for our dive operations based in Portsea on the Mornington Peninsula in Victoria. Skills in Dive Operations, Office Administration, Sales & Dive Equipment Sales Essential.

You will be guiding and running marine education programs both in the classroom as well as in the water. You will run courses, guided dives and snorkel tours for individuals and groups. Groups are a major component of our business including school groups, so experience in these areas is an advantage. We pride ourselves on personalized service and going that extra mile.

Our store sells snorkel equipment, clothing, water activities and holiday accommodation.

Position requirements

  • Fluent in English
  • Drivers licence (capable of driving a vehicle with trailer an advantage)
  • Australian and New Zealand Resident or those with appropriate Australian working visa
  • Work with children check (can be done on arrival)
  • Current First Aid (can be updated in Australia)
  • Marine Biology Knowledge is an advantage

Send an email with current resume to manager@bayplay.com.au

item.description:
Full-Time PADI Instructor & Retail Store Specialist — Vancouver, BC

Location: 2865 West Broadway, Vancouver, BC
Position Type: Full-Time (Year-Round)
Start Date: Immediate

About Us

With over 30 years of teaching excellence in the Lower Mainland, International Diving Centre is a PADI 5 Star Dive Center dedicated to training confident divers and supporting our local diving community. Located in Vancouver, we offer complete dive training, high-end retail equipment, and access to local Pacific Northwest diving.

We are currently looking for a full-time PADI Instructor & Store Specialist to join our team immediately.

Key Responsibilities

  • Instruction & Guiding: Teach PADI courses from Open Water through Specialties, lead local group dives, and maintain safe, high-quality instruction standards.
  • Store Operations: Assist retail customers with gear selection, sales, course enrollments, and equipment rentals.
  • Shop Maintenance: Assist with tank fills (air and nitrox), gear inspections, inventory management, and day-to-day shop tasks.
  • Logistics: Transport gear, tanks, and students to local Lower Mainland dive sites as needed.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • PADI Membership: Must be a PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor (OWSI) or higher in active, good standing with current teaching status.
  • Legal Authorization to Work in Canada: Applicants must already be legally eligible to work in Canada (Canadian Citizen, Permanent Resident, or active Open Work Permit). Please note: We are unable to sponsor or assist with work visas.
  • Valid Driver’s License: Required for site transport and shop errands.
  • English Fluency: Strong verbal and written English communication skills are required.
  • Cold Water Experience: Preferred, but not required. We are happy to mentor warm-water instructors and assist with drysuit orientation and local site transitions.

What We Offer

  • Paid Teaching Insurance: We cover your professional teaching liability insurance.
  • Compensation: Hourly base rate for shop/retail shifts plus competitive instruction pay.
  • Mentorship: On-site training for local Pacific Northwest diving and site orientation.
  • Staff Discounts: Discounts on equipment purchases, gear servicing, and continuing education.

How to Apply

If you meet the work eligibility and PADI membership requirements, please send your CV/resume, PADI Pro number, and a short introduction to
royse.jackson@diveidc.com or apply directly through the PADI Job Board.

item.description:
PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF YOU DO NOT HOLD A VALID AUSTRALIAN WORKING VISA.

Join our Marine Centre team and help deliver exceptional diving experiences on the Great Barrier Reef. As a Dive Instructor, you will conduct guided dives, snorkel tours and dive training while ensuring the highest standards of safety, guest service and environmental stewardship. You will be responsible for maintaining dive equipment, supporting daily marine operations, responding to emergencies when required, and contributing to a safe, professional and memorable experience for every guest.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct guided dives, snorkel tours and PADI training programs.
  • Deliver outstanding customer service and create memorable guest experiences.
  • Maintain dive equipment and ensure compliance with safety and operational standards.
  • Promote and follow all Work Health & Safety, environmental and marine regulations.
  • Assist with emergency response procedures and incident reporting.
  • Support the development of new marine activities and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Resolve guest enquiries and concerns professionally.
  • Participate in daily operational tasks, stock management and equipment care.
  • Work collaboratively with the Marine Centre team and contribute to a positive workplace culture.

Essential Requirements:

  • Current PADI Divemaster or Instructor certification (Instructor preferred).
  • Current First Aid, CPR and Oxygen Provider certifications.
  • Current AS 2299 Commercial Diving Medical.
  • Elements of Shipboard Safety (ESS) qualification.
  • Relevant dive industry experience and a strong understanding of Great Barrier Reef marine environments.
  • Excellent communication, organisation and customer service skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends, public holidays and on-call duties when required.

Desirable Qualifications:

  • Aqualung Regulator Technician certification.
  • Marine radio operator certificate (ROCP).
  • Experience working in a remote island or resort environment.

This role is ideal for a passionate dive professional who enjoys working in a dynamic team, prioritises safety, and is committed to delivering exceptional marine experiences in one of the world’s most iconic reef environments.

Please email through CV and cover letter to mcmanager@heronisland.com

item.description:
Waikiki Dive Center Now Hiring: Instructors – Full-Time or Part-Time (Immediate Start)

📍 Waikiki Dive Center – Honolulu, Oahu, Hawaii

🔗 WaikikiDiveCenter.com | WaikikiDiving.com

Join the most iconic and longest-standing PADI 5-Star IDC in Hawaii. With over 45 years of experience, Waikiki Dive Center is more than a dive shop—it’s a mission-driven ohana dedicated to excellence in dive education, safety, and ocean stewardship.

We are actively seeking a PADI IDC Staff Instructor (Full-time or Part-time) with strong leadership, professionalism, and a passion for teaching and mentoring. You’ll be joining a legacy dive team with a global reputation and the highest pay scale in the Hawaiian islands.

❗ POSITION REQUIREMENTS

  • Must be a U.S. citizen or hold a valid U.S. work visa (We do not sponsor visas)
  • 1-year minimum commitment
  • Minimum 2 years Instructor professional experience
  • Must hold active PADI Teaching Status
  • Valid EFR, AED, O2 Instructor credentials (within last 2 years)
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation
  • Must be available for Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year holidays

🧭 WHO WE ARE

Waikiki Dive Center is Hawaii’s oldest and most awarded dive shop, recognized by PADI Scuba Diving Magazine in all 7 “Best of the Pacific” categories. We’ve logged over 4 million safe dives and issued 35,000+ certifications. We are also a VA-approved vocational dive training provider for military veterans and eligible dependents.

Our mission: I.D.E.A. – Inspire, Discover, Empower, Advance.

We lead with humility, discipline, professionalism, and teamwork. Our culture is rooted in accountability, service excellence, and environmental respect. We support each other, push for growth, and believe leadership begins with the small things—like showing up on time, prepared, and focused.

💼 COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

W2:

  • Instructor or higher: $24+/hr (upon experience, credentials and performance)

Employee Benefits:

  • Medical & EAP
  • 401(k) (Full-time only, after 1 year)
  • Flexible scheduling
  • Spot bonuses for excellence and Aloha Spirit
  • Teaching opportunities in PADI and VA-approved vocational programs
  • Free diving & boat seats, staff gear discounts

We’re proud to offer the highest pay scale among Hawaiian dive operators—with room to grow. This team recognizes commitment, effort, caring, and consistency.

🔧 RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead PADI courses: DSD, OW, AOW, Rescue, Specialties such as Deep, Wreck, Nav, Rescue, EFR, Divemaster, and assist IDC as applicable
  • Mentor and coach dive staff in professionalism, safety, and guest interaction
  • Audit course paperwork, uphold training standards, and maintain accurate records
  • Conduct daily dive charters, including setup, briefings, in-water leadership, and cleanup
  • Be a workflow-proficient instructor, able to manage mixed groups (certified divers, students, DSDs)
  • Support customer service both in-shop and on vessels
  • Participate in safety drills, weekly staff meetings, and operational planning
  • Represent Waikiki Dive Center’s values and aloha spirit at all times

🔍 WHO YOU ARE

  • A disciplined, emotionally mature leader who leads by example and elevates the team
  • Comfortable working with diverse guests, multicultural backgrounds, and group dynamics
  • Excellent communication and conflict resolution skills—direct, respectful, and clear
  • Committed to safety, quality, and professionalism in every aspect of dive operations
  • Able to manage high-volume schedules during holidays and peak tourism months
  • Passionate about marine conservation and responsible tourism
  • Able to remain calm and focused in purpose and the bigger picture of the mission
  • Bilingual or multilingual is a strong plus (Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Spanish, French, etc.)

🌎 DIVERSITY & GLOBAL OUTREACH

At Waikiki Dive Center, we proudly serve a global customer base. Our strength lies in our diversity—of background, culture, and thought. We believe inclusivity drives creativity, safety, and service quality.

We strongly encourage bilingual professionals and instructors with international experience to apply.

💬 WHAT OUR TEAM SAYS

“Woah!!! That is awesome. And so rare for scuba instructors to be paid in the way they deserve.”

— Avalon, IDC Staff Instructor

“You can be a guide or an Instructor.   We are Instructors.”

– Kevin, Course Director

📝 APPLY TODAY

Email your resume and brief cover letter to:

📧 info@waikikidivecenter.com

📌 Subject line: Application – IDC Staff Instructor

Or apply directly via WaikikiDiveCenter.com

🌊 READY TO DIVE IN?

If you’re looking to be more than just an instructor—if you want to be part of a team that values integrity, excellence, humility, and heart—then this is your opportunity.

Show up with purpose. Dive with heart. Lead with aloha.

Be part of something life-changing.

Aloha,

The Waikiki Diving Center Team

item.description:
Our diving centre is a leading PADI 5 Star IDC Centre dedicated to providing exceptional diving
experiences and education, maintaining high safety standards, and preserving our oceanic environment.

It is part of the Latchi Watersports Group, the largest watersports company in Cyprus.
We are looking for a certified PADI Open Water Instructor passionate about diving and eager to share your expertise with others? Our premier dive centre is seeking a dynamic, skilled, and enthusiastic individual to join our team and help students embark on their diving adventures.

If you possess a deep understanding of scuba diving, outstanding teaching skills, and a commitment to safety and environmental conservation, this is your chance to turn your passion for diving into a rewarding career.

The Opportunity:

As a PADI Open Water Instructor, you will play a crucial role in our dive team, providing top-notch dive instruction, fostering a safe and supportive learning environment, and inspiring a new generation of divers to explore and respect the underwater world.

Key Responsibilities Include:

  • Conducting PADI Open Water Diver courses and other PADI certification courses.
    ● Ensuring all diving activities comply with PADI standards and safety regulations.
    ● Assessing and monitoring students’ progress and proficiency in diving skills.
    ● Maintaining diving equipment in optimal condition.
    ● Promoting environmental awareness and conservation practices among students.
    ● Organising and leading diving excursions for certified divers.

Who We’re Looking For:

  • A certified PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor with experience working in a busy dive centre.
    ● Has experience in teaching and guiding divers of all skill levels and is able to operate independently within PADI standards.
    ● Has experience in providing excellent customer service and promoting and communicating
    the dive courses we offer.
    ● Knowledgeable about dive theory, underwater navigation, and emergency procedures.
    ● Skilled in the use of dive equipment.
    ● Highly communicative, patient, and possesses excellent interpersonal skills.
    ● Passionate about marine conservation and eager to contribute to our conservation projects.
    ● Has previous experience in operating boats and is open to providing support in this area
    during peak times throughout the working day.
    ● Someone who is able to work in hot climates for extended periods of time.
    ● Is capable of readily adjusting to a flexible work schedule to meet the needs of the
    business

Essential Qualifications and Skills:

  • Active status as a PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor.
    ● First Aid and CPR certification within the last 24 months.
    ● Demonstrable experience in teaching various PADI courses.
    ● Proficiency in English and German would be a plus
    ● Right to work in the Cyprus

Why Dive with Us?

  • Our dive centre is known for its commitment to safety, quality instruction, and environmental
    stewardship.
    ● Work in some of the most beautiful diving locations in Cyprus.
    ● Be part of a supportive team that values professional development and growth.
    ● Make a difference by educating and inspiring responsible diving practices.

Salary: Competitive, based on experience
Job Type: Full-time, Seasonal
Start Date: Immediately

Apply Now:

If you’re ready to dive into this exciting opportunity and meet the qualifications listed, we would love to hear from you. For any enquiries about the position, please contact John Dugan at manager@latchidivecentre.com

We’re looking forward to welcoming you to our team and exploring the depths together. Dive into your dream career today!
