item.description:
PADI Divemaster (Indonesian) – Full Time

Location: Nusa Lembongan, Bali, Indonesia
Please note: This position is open to Indonesian nationals only, in accordance with Indonesian employment and work permit regulations.

 

Mantascape Diving is looking for a passionate and motivated Indonesian PADI Divemaster to join our growing team in Nusa Lembongan.

We are a modern PADI Dive Center established in 2024, committed to delivering high-quality diving experiences through small dive groups, excellent customer service, and professional dive operations. We conduct daily fun dives and PADI courses around the world-renowned dive sites of Nusa Lembongan and Nusa Penida, including Manta Point, Crystal Bay, Blue Corner, and the northern reefs.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a friendly, professional environment and wants to continue developing their diving career.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead certified divers on daily fun dives.
  • Assist PADI Instructors during training courses.
  • Conduct dive briefings and ensure safe diving practices.
  • Prepare and maintain scuba equipment.
  • Help with boat logistics and daily dive operations.
  • Provide outstanding customer service to divers from around the world.
  • Maintain high standards of safety, professionalism, and environmental awareness.

Requirements

  • Indonesian citizen.
  • Current PADI Divemaster certification (or equivalent recognized by PADI).
  • Active Emergency First Response (EFR) and CPR/First Aid certification.
  • Current diving medical (fit-to-dive).
  • Excellent buoyancy and diving skills.
  • Comfortable diving in drift conditions and varying currents.
  • Friendly, professional, and enthusiastic attitude.
  • Good communication skills in English (spoken). Additional languages are a plus.
  • Team player with a strong work ethic and willingness to learn.
  • Able to relocate and work in Nusa Lembongan.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience guiding divers in Nusa Penida/Lembongan or other current-prone dive destinations.
  • Experience with marine life identification and underwater photography is an advantage.
  • Boat handling or compressor experience is a bonus but not required.

What We Offer

  • Full-time employment.
  • Basic Salary + Guiding bonus paid per tank, with earnings based on the number of divers and dives conducted.
  • Food allowance.
  • One day off per week.
  • THR (Religious Holiday Allowance) in accordance with Indonesian regulations.
  • BPJS Kesehatan & BPJS Ketenagakerjaan.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career development within a growing PADI Dive Center.

If you’re passionate about diving, enjoy working with people, and are ready to become part of a growing team, we’d love to hear from you.

Please send your CV, recent photo, copies of your diving certifications, and a short introduction outlining your diving experience and why you’d like to join Mantascape Diving.

Due to Indonesian employment and work permit regulations, we are unable to consider applications from foreign nationals for this PADI Divemaster position. If you are not an Indonesian national, please do not apply for this role. We appreciate your understanding.
If you are a foreign PADI Professional, we encourage you to keep an eye on our future vacancies. We may have opportunities for PADI Instructors in the future, and we would be pleased to receive your application when those positions become available.

item.description:
PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor – Rincón, Puerto Rico

Rincón Diving & Snorkeling | PADI 5-Star Dive Center

Location: Rincón, Puerto Rico
Position Type: Full-Time or Seasonal

About Us:

Rincón Diving & Snorkeling is a PADI 5-Star Dive Center on the west coast of Puerto Rico. For over a decade, we’ve helped thousands of visitors discover the ocean through guided shore dives, snorkeling tours, and PADI training — from beginners to professional levels.

Our mission is simple: teach people to love and protect the ocean. We’re a small, passionate team focused on safety, education, and sustainable tourism.

The Role:

We’re looking for a PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor who loves working with people and wants to grow professionally in all areas of diving. Beginners are welcome — we’ll help you gain hands-on experience in teaching, guiding, and technical skills.

Instructors will conduct PADI programs from snorkeling through Divemaster, lead guided shore dives, and assist in retail and customer service operations. Because we are a shore diving operation, reliable personal transportation is required to carry scuba gear between the shop and local dive sites.

This position also includes the opportunity to learn scuba equipment servicing and hydrostatic testing through our sister company, Puerto Rico Hydrostatic, a DOT-certified facility that services high-pressure tanks and dive gear across the island.

Responsibilities:

  • Teach PADI programs from snorkeling and DSD through Divemaster

  • Lead guided shore dives and snorkel tours

  • Maintain and prepare gear for customers

  • Promote safe and eco-friendly diving practices

  • Support retail, reservations, and guest relations

  • Participate in cross-training for equipment repair and hydrostatic testing

Requirements:

  • Active PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor (OWSI) or higher (new instructors welcome)

  • EFR Instructor rating

  • Authorized to work in the United States

  • Physically fit and comfortable working outdoors in tropical conditions

  • Reliable transportation for gear transport

  • Spanish bilingual a strong plus

What We Offer:

item.description:
Ready to embark on an extraordinary adventure in the stunning paradise of South Caicos? Salterra, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa, Turks & Caicos, is seeking an experienced Concierge with a love for Adventure and experience in luxury hospitality.

Position: Adventure Concierge (with Dive Experience)

Location: South Caicos, Turks and Caicos Islands

Details: This role requires strong written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, and experience in wellness, hospitality, and diving. Responsibilities include greeting and booking guests on a variety of boating adventures and nature tours, answering gest questions regarding adventures and offerings. The ideal candidate will be a certified diver with knowledge of dive courses, gear, and a passion for the ocean.

From time to time, this role may be required to guide a tour so experience coordinating safety and logistics for groups of people is required. Ensuring that bookings and retail items are charged appropriately in various management systems and inventory is tracked. Interest in fitness activities including but not limited to snorkeling, hiking, biking, kayak and paddleboarding, snorkeling, nature walks, and community functions is a plus. Demonstrate strong leadership, desire to share knowledge, and proficient in Microsoft Suite, Marriott systems (MGS, GXP, Opera, Symphony), and Book4Time or similar. Knowledge of the local environments, flexibility with shifts (including weekends and holidays), willingness to commit to a 1 year contract and reside on South Caicos.

At Salterra, you’ll not only be living in the breathtaking surroundings of South Caicos but also become part of a warm, vibrant community dedicated to excellence and guest satisfaction. Our resort offers a unique blend of luxury and adventure, providing our guests-and our team-with unforgettable experiences and the opportunity to grow their career in one of the most beautiful places in the world.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, protecting company assets, maintaining confidentiality, and ensuring your uniform and personal appearance are professional. Adventure by Salterra team will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time) and taking a hands-on approach to their work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and 100 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for the Adventure by Salterra team- to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

About Us:

Diving Sports is a premier destination for scuba divers and freedivers in Vancouver, Canada. With a passion for marine conservation and adventure, we offer a wide range of diving equipment, certification courses, and unforgettable diving experiences. Our team is dedicated to providing exceptional customer service and our shop offers a wide range of diving gear, from beginner essentials to advanced equipment for seasoned divers, along with expert guidance and support.

 

Job Description:

We are currently seeking a dynamic and enthusiastic individual to join our team as a Scuba Diving Instructor/Sales Associate. In this role, you will have the opportunity to share your passion for diving with scuba students and provide expert guidance on equipment selection, to contribute to the overall success of our dive shop.

 

Responsibilities:

Tasks vary depending on the schedule but include:

  • Teach PADI/SDI scuba diving courses
  • Assist customers in selecting appropriate scuba diving gear, including wetsuits, masks, fins, and other accessories
  • Provide knowledgeable advice on scuba diving techniques, safety procedures, and equipment maintenance
  • Conduct retail transactions accurately and efficiently, including processing payments and managing inventory
  • Assist with the organization and maintenance of the retail space, ensuring a clean and welcoming environment for customers
  • Participate in promotional events and community outreach initiatives
  • Contribute to the overall success of the team by supporting colleagues and collaborating on various projects as needed

 

Requirements:

  • PADI/SDI Instructor or Divemaster
  • Cold-water diving experience
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Being able to legally work in Canada
  • Previous retail or customer service experience preferred
  • Freediving instructor/freediving knowledge preferred

 

Benefits:

  • Competitive hourly wage
  • Extended Health and dental
  • Employee discounts on diving gear and courses
  • Opportunities for advancement and professional development

 

How to Apply: Please submit your resume and a brief text highlighting your diving experiences. You can apply through this post or send your resume to customerservice@divingsports.com

We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

About Us

Blue Holic Scuba is a community-focused, 5-Star PADI Dive Center based in Los Angeles. We focus on small-group, high-quality instruction and creating a welcoming environment for all divers. Our goal is simple: build confident, capable divers through thoughtful teaching.

@blueholicscuba on instagram | www.blueholicscuba.com

Position Overview

We’re looking for a PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor who is passionate about teaching and excited to dive in Southern California waters.

This is a weekend-based role with consistent scheduling and occasional weekday opportunities.

Schedule
Saturdays: Pool training (Algin Sutton Aquatic Center)
Sundays: Ocean dives (Catalina Island or Channel Islands)
Occasional:

Weekday oil rig dives
Responsibilities

Lead small groups with a focus on safety and clarity
Support students from first session through certification
Adapt teaching to different comfort and skill levels
Communicate clearly with staff and students
Class Structure
Maximum 4 students per instructor
Emphasis on personalized, hands-on instruction
Quality over volume — no rushed teaching

Compensation

$25 / Open Water student (pool)
$40 / Open Water student (ocean)
$50 / Advanced student
$75 / Rescue student

Example:
One weekend can look like: 4 Open Water students (Saturday pool) + 3 Open Water students (Sunday ocean) = (25 × 4) + (40 × 3) = $100 + $120 = $220

Perks:

Group liability insurance included
Parking covered
Consistent weekend scheduling
+1 on local boat trips if not sold out
Requirements
Active PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor status
Comfortable diving in California conditions
Strong communication and teaching skills
Reliable and team-oriented
Nice to Have
Experience teaching newer or nervous divers
Familiarity with specialties (navigation, buoyancy, deep, etc.)
Interest in growing with a community-focused shop
How to Apply

Send us:

Certification level
Teaching experience
Availability

📧 blueholicscuba@yahoo.com
📞 (323) 641-7416

item.description:
Blue View Divers – PADI 5★ Eco Dive Centre
Koh Phi Phi, Thailand

Blue View Divers is looking for a short term  Chinese-speaking PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor (OWSI) with fluent English to join our friendly international team on the beautiful island of Koh Phi Phi for the peak season.

As a PADI 5★ Eco Centre, we pride ourselves on providing exceptional customer service, small groups, high-quality diver education and a genuine commitment to marine conservation. If you are passionate about teaching, love working with people and want to be part of a supportive team, we’d love to hear from you.

We welcome both experienced instructors and newly qualified OWSIs. Mentoring and support are available for the right candidate.

Position Details

  • Position: Full-time PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor
  • Minimum Commitment: 3 months (Nov – Dec – Jan) with option to extend
  • Location: Koh Phi Phi, Thailand
  • Start Date: Late Oct – Early Nov

About the Role

You will teach and supervise a variety of PADI programs including:

  • Discover Scuba Diving
  • Open Water Diver
  • Advanced Open Water
  • Rescue Diver
  • Scuba Reviews
  • Guided fun dives
  • Private snorkelling experiences

There are also opportunities to assist with:

  • Underwater photography
  • Social Media Content Creation for your market
  • AWARE speciality courses

What We’re Looking For

Essential

  • Current PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor
  • Fluent Chinese and English
  • Professional, friendly and enthusiastic personality
  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Strong commitment to safety and PADI standards
  • Positive attitude and team player
  • Flexible and able to adapt to changing schedules
  • Full professional insurance
  • Complete set of personal dive equipment including torch.

Preferred (but not essential)

  • Underwater photography skills
  • AWARE Instructor ratings (or willingness to obtain them)

Why Join Blue View Divers?

  • Work at one of Phi Phi’s most established PADI Dive Centres
  • Small, supportive international team
  • High teaching standards with excellent online reviews
  • Mentoring and professional development
  • Island lifestyle with world-class diving

Sales & Working Environment

Our dive centre is located in a peaceful area outside the main town therefore we operate as a mostly paper-free, online business, so there are not usually any retail shop sales shifts required for this position.

If you have your own Mandarin-speaking client base or generate your own bookings, we offer acommission structure. Several members of our multilingual team, including our Spanish and Portuguese instructors, bring repeat guests and referrals to Blue View Divers under agreed commission arrangements, and we welcome instructors who have built their own network of clients.

Additional Information

At Blue View Divers we aim to  deliver exceptional diver training while maintaining and upholding PADI Standards, and every member of our team is expected to do the same.

Successful candidates will demonstrate the maturity and professionalism to prioritise the needs of the business, work well under pressure and contribute positively to our close-knit team.

Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted regarding the next stage of the recruitment process. If you do not hear from us, please consider your application unsuccessful.

Only apply if you are fluent in Mandarin Chinese. Applications from candidates who do not meet this language requirement will not be considered and will be automatically discarded.

How to Apply

Please send the following:

  • CV/Resume
  • Cover letter explaining why you would be a great fit for Blue View Divers
  • PADI Student Count Report
  • Professional Diving Employment History
  • Two professional references

Email: Bvd.enquiries@gmail.com

We look forward to welcoming an enthusiastic instructor who shares our passion for outstanding diver education, exceptional customer service and protecting our oceans.

item.description:
Atlantis Dubai is part of Kerzner International, and home to two extraordinary resorts: the world-renowned Atlantis, The Palm and the ultra-luxury Atlantis The Royal. Together, they represent world-class service, bold innovation, and unforgettable experiences brought to life.

 

With over 6,000 colleagues from 129 nationalities, Atlantis Dubai operates as one team, with many departments and back-of-house functions seamlessly supporting both resorts. Across every role and department, our shared purpose is the same: to create amazing experiences and everlasting memories – not only for our guests, but for our colleagues too.

About The Role

  • Perform as a mermaid in underwater shows, meet-and-greets, and themed events.
  • Swim gracefully in a mermaid tail while executing choreographed routines or improvisational movements.
  • Participate in rehearsals, costume fittings, and promotional activities.
  • Maintain physical fitness and water safety proficiency.
  • Follow safety procedures and emergency protocols as instructed by staff or Dive Safety Officer.
  • Follows all policies and procedures set in the Atlantis Dubai Dive Operations Manual
  • Assist in the care, maintenance, and cleaning of mermaid costumes and equipment.
  • Logs and reports all equipment malfunctions to supervisor immediately.
  • Maintains dive logs and records of own dives.
  • Ensures a complete understanding and adheres to policies of all division / department policies.
  • Maintains a safe, secure, and healthy work environment for both people and animals.
  • Attend meetings and trainings as requested and required.
  • Maintains a sound knowledge of the Company’s facilities and related services.
  • Maintains confidentiality of information always received.
  • Performs other reasonable duties throughout the Division as requested by management.

About You 

  • Certified free diver with a recognized free diving certification.
  • Must demonstrate strong swimming skills by successfully passing annual departmental swim test.
  • Must have the ability to hold breath underwater for extended periods.
  • Previous experience in aquatic performance, synchronized swimming, diving, or dance preferred.
  • Comfortable performing in front of large crowds and engaging with children and adults.
  • Ability to swim and perform underwater for extended periods in varying water temperatures.
  • Endurance for repetitive movements and extended periods in costume.
  • Excellent health and physical condition; passes annual dive medical.
  • Ability to lift or carry costume elements or equipment up to [e.g., 25 lbs].
  • Ability to wear and swim in a monofin or mermaid tail for extended periods.
  • Cpr, first aid, and lifeguard certification (or willingness to obtain).
  • Flexible schedule including weekends, holidays, and evenings.
  • Positive attitude and strong work ethics.
  • Must be articulate and confident in written and spoken english.
  • Must be comfortable performing assigned duties in close proximity to all animals in our collection.
  • Demonstrates mature responsible behavior in duties.

 

We offer a competitive, tax-free salary paid in UAE Dirhams (AED), alongside a wealth of benefits. These include generous food and beverage privileges, exclusive discounted rates at all Kerzner properties worldwide, comprehensive health insurance (with dental coverage), annual flights home, life insurance, an incentive programme, and a variety of colleague wellness and social initiatives.

With a strong emphasis on learning and development, colleagues at Atlantis enjoy access to world-class training, career mobility, and internal growth opportunities across the Kerzner portfolio – making this an ideal environment for ambitious individuals seeking a long-term, fulfilling career in luxury hospitality. Join the A-Team and discover the extraordinary.

If you are interested please submit your CV and a current photo HERE

item.description:
Join Pro Dive International, Mexico

Pro Dive International is looking for professional, motivated, and customer-focused PADI MSDT Instructors to join our team in Mexico’s Riviera Maya and Cozumel.

Operating premium dive centers within beachfront resorts, we provide recreational diving, professional training, and unforgettable underwater experiences for guests from around the world. Our instructors play a key role in delivering exceptional customer experiences while helping divers continue their underwater journey.

About the Role

This position is ideal for instructors who enjoy working with people, take pride in delivering outstanding customer service, and understand that helping guests choose the right diving experiences and continuing education is an essential part of being a successful instructor.

At Pro Dive International, teaching and sales go hand in hand. We believe the best instructors don’t just certify divers, they inspire them to keep diving, continue their education, and discover everything our destinations have to offer.

Key Responsibilities

As a Dive Instructor, you will:

• Teach PADI recreational courses.
• Guide certified divers on local reef dives and excursions.
• Deliver exceptional customer service before, during, and after every activity.
• Build strong relationships with guests throughout their stay.
• Recommend courses, diving experiences, and continuing education based on each guest’s interests and goals.
• Actively contribute to the sales performance of your dive center by promoting our products and services.
• Represent Pro Dive International professionally within our partner resorts.
• Maintain the highest standards of safety and professionalism.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for instructors who:

• Love teaching and helping divers progress.
• Are passionate about creating memorable guest experiences.
• Enjoy interacting with people from around the world.
• Have strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Are confident discussing and recommending courses and diving experiences.
• Are motivated by both professional excellence and sales performance.
• Take initiative and work well within a team.
• Maintain a positive attitude and strong work ethic.

Minimum Requirements

• PADI MSDT Instructor.
• Active teaching status.
• Fluent English (other languages are a plus).
• Strong communication skills.
• Sales-oriented mindset.
• Professional appearance and conduct.
• Commitment to safety and customer service.

What We Offer

• Year-round employment.
• Competitive salary and performance-based commissions.

item.description:
We are thrilled that you are considering joining the team at Sun Diving Centre for your Divemaster Internship.

We would like to share a bit more information about how our internship program works, the schedule, and a breakdown of the costs and inclusions if you are selected for the team.

Program Overview & Schedule

Duration: The internship is a comprehensive four-month program designed to give you hands-on, real-world experience in a busy dive centre.

Working Hours: Your day-to-day hours will be 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM in alignment with our dive centre’s opening hours.

Time Off: You will receive six scheduled days off per month to rest, explore, and recharge. We will create a volunteer/intern schedule to ensure everyone gets their well-deserved downtime.

What We Offer (In Return for Your Hard Work)

Free Divemaster Training: We completely waive the instructor and training fees for your Divemaster course (which usually costs $1,080 USD).

Accommodation & Meals: You will receive shared accommodation, as well as breakfast and lunch on your working days.

Household Essentials: We supply basic home comforts for your accommodation, including tea, coffee, sugar, and cooking oil.

Course Prerequisites & PADI Fees

Rescue & EFR Certifications: If you are not yet Rescue & EFR certified, you can complete these with us at a heavily discounted rate (if you already hold these certifications, feel free to ignore this part!):

Rescue Course: $195 USD (50% off our standard $390 USD rate)

EFR Course: $85 USD (50% off our standard $170 USD rate)

PADI Materials & Membership: You will be responsible for purchasing the PADI e-learning/theory materials (approximately 170 AUD) and paying your final PADI Membership fee at the end of your training (approximately 260 AUD). Please note that PADI occasionally adjusts these fees yearly, which is outside of our control.

Next Steps

Because our last season has only just wrapped up, we will be taking the next few months to review applications and shortlist candidates. We will reach out to you as soon as we have an update on your application.

If you have any questions in the meantime, or if there is any additional information you would like to share with us, please don’t hesitate to reply to this email.

We look forward to staying in touch!

item.description:
Bali Diving Academy — a PADI 5-Star CDC established in 1991 — is looking for a Dive Centre Leader to run our Nusa Lembongan location.

This is a management role first.

You run the shop, lead the team and drive the sales — and you teach when the schedule needs you to.

THE ROLE

  • Managing bookings, reservations and the daily dive schedule
  • Handling walk-ins and turning enquiries into sales
  • Greeting and looking after customers — instructors are teaching, divemasters are on the boat, so the shop experience is yours to own
  • Collecting and reconciling payments
  • Completing all paperwork: certification checks, medical questionnaires, course documentation
  • Leading and supervising the local team, and stepping in wherever help is needed
  • Making sure equipment and facilities are maintained and used correctly
  • Retail: stock, displays, merchandising and upselling
  • Teaching PADI courses when needed
  • Daily planning, problem solving, reporting and basic accounting
  • Socialising with divers — before, between and after dives

WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • PADI MSDT or above, with solid experience
  • Proven managerial experience
  • Strong sales ability, and the initiative to come up with new ideas to grow business on location
  • A team leader by nature, who works well with local staff
  • Excellent customer-oriented attitude, consistently
  • Fluent English; other languages a plus (Chinese especially)
  • Social media, digital marketing or photography skills are a big plus
  • Minimum 12-month commitment

WE OFFER

  • Base salary, housing allowance, revenue-based commission and teaching commission
  • Full-year work permit and taxes covered
  • Great diving

HOW TO APPLY

Start date: ASAP

If you think you’re the right person, send your CV to hrd@scubali.com.

Location: United Arab Emirates

Company: DiveCampus Diving Club LLC (📍Dubai and 📍Khorfakkan)

DiveCampus is looking for active, motivated PADI Instructor who want more than just a guiding role. This position is ideal for recently certified OWSI and MSDT who are serious about building a long-term career and growing within a high-standard, professional training environment.

Languages Preferred

Only candidates with strong English proficiency and who speak one or more of the below languages should apply. Additional language preferred:

  • Arabic
  • Afrikaans
  • Russian
  • French
  • Spanish
  • German
  • Italian

What We Offer

  • Supportive, passionate, and experienced dive team
  • Access to premium equipment, modern training facilities, and exclusive dive locations
  • Competitive pay structure with performance-based bonuses
  • Staff loan support to continue education, with a clear pathway to employment at DiveCampus
  • Opportunities for progression into Instructor Continuing Education or Technical Diving pathways
  • In-house marketing and sales support to help maintain consistent work schedules
  • Full-time contract
  • Accommodation (subject to availability ONLY)

Instructor Role Overview

  • Conduct PADI courses with opportunities to progress in your career
  • Guide certified divers in accordance with PADI standards and local regulations
  • Support daily dive operations and logistics
  • Deliver a consistently high-quality customer experience
  • Continue professional development and instructor-level training

Who We Are Looking For

  • Certified, active-status PADI OWSI or MSDT
  • Professional, punctual, and customer-focused
  • Confident in the water with a genuine interest in teaching
  • Comfortable guiding dives and working with an international clientele
  • Able to work independently and as part of a team
  • Proficient in English and at least one additional language listed above

How to Apply

Interested candidates should apply via the PADI Job Portal with:

  • Updated resume (applications without a resume will not be considered)
  • Language proficiency details
  • A short note outlining long-term career goals in the dive industry

Marketing Manager
Part-Time for a Commission · Deep Blue Divers, Dahab, Egypt

Deep Blue Divers is looking for a marketing manager to take our online presence and turn it into a steady stream of bookings — someone who can turn our dive courses, fun-dive packages, and hostel stays into a story people want to book.

About the role
You’ll have built a marketing engine that keeps Deep Blue Divers visible and booked out — strong social channels, well-optimized listings on booking platforms, and active partnerships that bring divers to our door. What you’ll do
Run our social media and content calendar (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok); manage and optimize our listings on booking platforms; build outreach and partnerships with travel agencies and influencers; run lead-generation campaigns and track what converts; keep our brand voice and visuals consistent across channels; report on what’s working and adjust.

Required
Proven experience running marketing for a hospitality, travel, or dive business; strong content and copywriting skills; comfortable with social media management and basic analytics; self-motivated and results-driven — comfortable working on a commission-only structure.

Preferred
Experience marketing to international travelers; familiarity with the dive or adventure travel industry.

Compensation
Commission-only, part-time: paid on bookings and revenue directly generated through your campaigns and outreach (rate to be discussed). No base salary.

How to apply
Email your CV and a portfolio or examples of past work to info@divedahab.com.
or whats app: +201221134668

item.description:
Are you looking to take the next step in your diving career and become a highly competent dive professional?

Crazy Shark Diving Center a PADI Dive Center based in Sharm El-Shiekh, is offering a structured career development internship for divers who are serious about progressing into the professional side of the dive industry.

Please note: This is a training internship, not a job offer or paid position. This program is designed for divers who want to gain real-world experience, mentorship, and professional-level training while working toward their certifications.

Our internship is ideal for divers aiming to become:
• PADI Divemasters
• Future PADI Instructors
• Confident, employable dive professionals

Training opportunities available

Depending on your current certification level, we offer multiple pathways, including:
• Divemaster Internship (2–4 weeks)
• Zero to Pro Program (Open Water to Divemaster)

Additional specialty training may include:
• PADI Enriched Air (Nitrox)
• Deep Diver
• Shark Conservation / Shark AWARE
• Dive Against Debris
• Fish Identification
• Underwater Naturalist
• Marine conservation-focused specialties

Why train with us?

Located in the beautiful waters of the Red Sea, we offer access to incredible diving, including vibrant reefs, megafauna encounters, and our world-famous WWII Wrecks.

At Crazy Shark, we focus on building dive professionals who are:
• Skilled
• Responsible
• Confident leaders underwater
• Passionate about ocean conservation

We pride ourselves on producing strong professionals who leave our program ready for the next stage of their careers.

Minimum requirements for Divemaster candidates

• Minimum age: 18
• Certified Rescue Diver (or equivalent)
• EFR / CPR & First Aid within 24 months
• Medical clearance for diving
• Minimum 40 logged dives to start
• Minimum 60 logged dives for certification

Flexible start dates available throughout the year.

If you are serious about turning your passion for diving into a professional career, we would love to hear from you.

How to Apply:

Applicants should submit:

  • Cover letter outlining career goals and reasons for becoming a dive professional
  • Current CV or resume
  • Recent Photo
  • Dive history and number of logged dives
  • Copies of diving certifications
  • Professional or character references (where available)

To the following E-Mail mmimm52@bk.ru or via WhatsApp +201020716361

item.description:
An unexpected vacancy has opened in our team and Mare Nostrum Diving is looking for one enthusiastic PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor who can join us as soon as possible.

We are a PADI 5★ Resort, PADI Eco Center and Green Fins Member, based on the beautiful island of Ustica, Italy’s oldest Marine Protected Area.

Your office is the sea

Unlike many dive centres where much of the day is spent around the shop, our operation is almost entirely boat-based.

We run high-quality half-day diving trips, guide small groups, teach PADI courses and Discover Scuba Diving experiences, while introducing guests to the natural, historical and cultural heritage of Ustica.

We don’t simply guide dives—we interpret the sea. Quality and safety always comes before quantity.

Alongside recreational diving, we actively participate in marine conservation, citizen science and environmental monitoring projects with universities and environmental organisations.

We also operate as a commercial diving company, carrying out underwater inspections, maintenance and scientific support activities. Although this position focuses on recreational diving, you’ll gain exposure to a broader professional diving environment.

Why join us?

You’ll work alongside the owners.

Danilo and Tatiana have more than 30 years of professional diving experience and are still on the front line every day—guiding dives, teaching courses, skippering boats and managing operations.

We’re not interested in producing instructors who certify the highest number of students.

We want to help develop professionals who deliver safe, meaningful and memorable underwater experiences. Our guests choose us because they’re looking for authentic diving, personal attention and professionalism—not crowded inflatable boats or rushed schedules.

The right person

We’re not looking for someone who has collected every possible specialty. We’re looking for someone with curiosity, passion, humility, reliability and a genuine desire to learn.

Skills can be taught. Procedures can be learned. Experience comes with time.
But we cannot transplant passion.

If you’re looking for experienced mentors who will explain not only how, but also why things are done, we’d love to meet you.

Requirements

  • Current PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor
  • MSDT appreciated, but not required
  • Fluent English
  • Italian required (basic conversational level is sufficient)
  • French is a valuable advantage
  • Comfortable teaching beginners and guiding certified divers
  • Physically fit for daily boat operations, equipment handling and lifting scuba cylinders
  • Positive, flexible and a genuine team player
  • Passionate about the marine environment

Please do not apply if…

  • You are a smoker. This is a non-negotiable requirement. We only recruit people who already live a smoke-free lifestyle—we’re not looking for promises to quit or to smoke “only off duty”.
  • You’re looking for an easy season or just somewhere to collect certifications.

We offer

  • Seasonal position until 31 October 2026
  • Accommodation
  • Salary commensurate with experience
  • Daily boat diving in one of the Mediterranean’s finest Marine Protected Areas
  • A friendly international team
  • Active involvement in conservation and citizen science projects
  • The opportunity to learn from experienced professionals still working in the field every day

Application

1. Candidate Registration Form
https://form.jotform.com/230244248774357

2. Pre-interview Questionnaire
https://form.jotform.com/241452757020349

Suitable candidates will then be invited to an online interview.

Immediate availability is highly preferred.

We’re not looking for the perfect instructor. We’re looking for the right person.

Dive Operations Organize and lead daily diving activities. Conduct dive...
item.description:
Job Summary

The PADI Divemaster is responsible for supervising certified divers, assisting PADI Instructors during training programs, conducting authorized PADI programs independently, ensuring diver safety, maintaining diving equipment, and delivering exceptional customer service while operating in accordance with PADI Standards, local regulations, and company policies.

Dive Operations

  • Organize and lead daily diving activities.
  • Conduct dive site briefings and debriefings.
  • Guide certified divers underwater.
  • Plan dives based on weather, currents, visibility, and diver experience.
  • Monitor diver safety before, during, and after dives.
  • Assist with boat diving and shore diving operations.
  • Deploy and recover dive flags and surface marker buoys (SMBs/DSMBs) as required.
  • Conduct diver head counts throughout the trip.

Guest Experience

  • Welcome guests professionally.
  • Verify certifications and dive experience.
  • Assist with equipment selection and fitting.
  • Help nervous or inexperienced divers.
  • Identify marine life.
  • Promote environmentally responsible diving.
  • Take photos and videos when required.
  • Handle guest concerns professionally.

Equipment Responsibilities

  • Prepare cylinders and equipment.
  • Inspect regulators, BCDs, cylinders, weights, and accessories.
  • Perform pre-dive equipment inspections.
  • Clean and disinfect rental equipment.
  • Report equipment defects.
  • Maintain equipment inventory.
  • Assist with compressor and cylinder handling (if authorized).

Boat Operations

  • Assist guests boarding and exiting boats.
  • Secure diving equipment.
  • Prepare emergency equipment.
  • Assist captain during departures and arrivals.
  • Deploy mooring or anchor systems when required.
  • Help recover divers safely.

Environmental Responsibilities

  • Promote responsible diving practices.
  • Prevent damage to coral reefs.
  • Encourage proper buoyancy control.
  • Report environmental hazards.
  • Participate in conservation activities.
  • Follow Green Fins standards or equivalent environmental policies.

Administrative Duties

  • Complete dive logs.
  • Record attendance.
  • Process liability waivers.
  • Verify diver certifications.
  • Prepare daily operational reports.
  • Report incidents and equipment damage.
  • Assist with bookings and customer inquiries when required.

item.description:
Job Summary

The Snorkeling Guide is responsible for planning, supervising, and leading safe and enjoyable snorkeling trips for guests. The guide provides safety briefings, assists guests in the water, identifies marine life, ensures compliance with local regulations, and delivers a high standard of customer service while protecting the marine environment.

Key Responsibilities

Guest Safety

  • Conduct comprehensive pre-trip safety briefings.
  • Assess guest swimming ability and confidence.
  • Ensure proper fitting and use of snorkeling equipment.
  • Supervise guests continuously during water activities.
  • Respond quickly and appropriately to emergencies.
  • Administer first aid and oxygen when required.
  • Monitor weather, sea conditions, tides, and currents.
  • Cancel or modify activities if conditions become unsafe.

Tour Operations

  • Lead guided snorkeling excursions.
  • Select suitable snorkeling sites based on daily conditions.
  • Maintain guest-to-guide ratios according to company policy.
  • Perform head counts before, during, and after each activity.
  • Coordinate with boat captains and crew.
  • Ensure all equipment is loaded, cleaned, and stored correctly.

Customer Experience

  • Welcome guests professionally.
  • Explain snorkeling techniques to beginners.
  • Assist nervous or inexperienced participants.
  • Identify and interpret marine life and local ecology.
  • Encourage environmentally responsible behavior.
  • Answer guest questions throughout the excursion.
  • Take photos/videos when included in the package.

Equipment Management

  • Inspect masks, snorkels, fins, buoyancy aids, and wetsuits.
  • Report damaged equipment.
  • Clean, disinfect, and store equipment after each trip.
  • Assist with inventory control.

Environmental Protection

  • Promote responsible snorkeling practices.
  • Prevent guests from touching coral or marine animals.
  • Educate guests on marine conservation.
  • Follow Green Fins or equivalent environmental standards.
  • Report environmental hazards or pollution.

Administration

  • Complete daily trip reports.
  • Record incidents and near misses.
  • Maintain equipment checklists.
  • Assist with guest waivers and documentation.
  • Report maintenance requirements.

item.description:
PADI OWSI + EFRI (or higher) – Dive Instructor Position

Puerto del Carmen, Lanzarote (Canary Islands, Spain)
Start: start immediately
Duration: Minimum 7 months (long-term preferred)

Important: Spanish & English required. French or German is a strong plus. EU passport required.

We are a small PADI 5 Star IDC Center (2–4 staff) based in Puerto del Carmen, focused on:

  • small groups
  • high-quality teaching
  • real attention to detail
  • and doing things properly, even if it takes more effort

If you enjoy large groups, parties and “volume diving”, this is probably not the right place.

If you care about an organized schedule & environment, teaching well, working with intention, striving for quality and being proud of what you do, keep reading.

You might be a good fit if you…

  • speak Spanish & English fluently (French/German is a big plus)
  • are confident working independently, but also enjoy teamwork
  • have a positive, proactive mindset
  • care about quality over quantity
  • are organized, reliable, and professional in how you present yourself
  • work well within structured systems and schedules, and value consistency in established procedures
  • enjoy working with people and creating a good atmosphere
  • are physically fit and comfortable with 3 dives per day + equipment handling
  • want to improve as an instructor, not just repeat the same routine
  • are environmentally aware
  • are a non-smoker (or able to not smoke whilst diving)
  • don’t mind having a dog around the dive center 🐶

Requirements

  • Active PADI OWSI + EFR Instructor (or higher)
  • EU passport (Spanish NIE/DNI is a plus)
  • Valid fit-to-dive medical (or completed upon arrival)
  • Good understanding of PADI systems (eLearning, App, Pro Site)
  • Full set of professional, well-maintained diving equipment
  • Valid European driving license (manual) – min. 2 years
  • Previous experience is helpful, but not essential

Your responsibilities

  • Up to three activity sessions/dives a day (8:15/10:15/12:15)
  • Conduct dives and courses according to your qualification level
  • Guide snorkelers & certified divers, run DSDs, refreshers, and courses
  • Support Divemaster training when applicable
  • Handle equipment (packing, carrying, loading, cleaning)
  • Maintain a clean and organized work environment
  • Assist with basic office duties when needed
  • Help keep equipment, vehicles, and facilities in top condition

What we offer

  • Full-time position with legal contract in Spain
  • Social security & health insurance
  • 23 paid holidays/year worked
  • 2 days off per week (rotation)
  • Salary: 1,424.50€ / month (review after 4-6 months, depending on candidate and experience level)
  • approximate working schedule 7:30 ~ 15:30
  • DAN liability insurance
  • No tank filling (external service)

What makes the difference

  • Small groups → better teaching, less stress
  • Clean, modern dive center with sea view terrace
  • Well-maintained vehicles & quality equipment
  • Introductory days to get familiar with sites & operations
  • Staff discounts on dive gear
  • Support in finding accommodation
  • Real opportunity to grow long-term

If you bring additional skills (social media, SEO, photography, videography, editing, operations, leadership), we are open to building a long-term path together.

Why Lanzarote

  • Year-round diving (18–24°C)
  • Plenty of dive sites for recreational and technical diving
  • Easy logistics and entrance points, short distances
  • Shore & boat diving (click for more info)
  • Consistent conditions and diverse marine life

How to apply

Send your CV (diving & non-diving) including photo & motivation letter to:
📧 staff@scuba-legends.com
Subject: PADI Job Board Instructor + Your Name

Please include:

  1. Highest certification level + instructor specialty ratings
  2. Diving experience (total dives, years, student numbers)
  3. Driving license (Yes/No)
  4. Nationality, passport, age, teaching languages
  5. Availability (earliest/latest start)
  6. Short-term or long-term interest
  7. Confirmation of owning full equipment as per PADI standards
  8. Interest in additional responsibilities

Only complete applications will be considered.

Accommodation (optional support)

Finding accommodation in Lanzarote can be challenging, especially at non-touristic prices.

We currently offer short term rental options (min 3months, until max end 2026) to get settled and find your own place.

  • A large private ground floor room with shared bathroom (max. 2 pax) in duplex house with patio, terrasse & large, shared kitchen
  • Located in San Bartolomé (quiet area, fields and mountain view, basic public transport & amenities in town)

Rent: 600€/month (incl. electricity & water)
Availability: Limited – first come, first served (1 month rent + 1 month deposit to be paid via bank transfer upon reservation).

Final note

If you’re looking for a place where:

  • your work actually matters
  • quality is more important than numbers
  • and you can grow as a professional

then this might be the right fit.

Scuba Legends Dive Center Lanzarote

Looking to live in one of the best cities in the world and continue with your passion of being a PADI Professional?

Dive Centre Manly is situated closest to some of Sydney’s best dive sites, including Cabbage Tree Bay. Being a multi-award winning PADI 5 Star Instructor training facility, we offer a complete range of dive courses from beginner level Introduction to Snorkelling & Discover Scuba up to Instructor level and beyond – including Sydney’s most talked about Learn to Dive course.

Our facilities include:

  • Award winning retail & equipment rental store
  • PADI 5 Star Instructor training facility
  • 3 meter-deep heated and floodlight diver training pool
  • 2 air-conditioned classrooms
  • Our very own Dive Boat, Sea Dragon II
  • Scuba equipment servicing workshop

 

Ideally, we are looking for a PADI MSDT with a few years of experience to join our team! We are also open to discussions with new Instructors and Divemasters.

Responsibilities include performing all kinds of logistical tasks and daily preparation of the dive centre, and equipment, conducting Discover Scuba Dives, diving courses from basic level to professional training, PADI program sales, and guiding local dives.

 

Applicants who apply should be:

  • Passionate about the ocean and have knowledge of scuba diving
  • Punctual, polite, customer focused and keen to help in every detail
  • Have working rights in Australia
  • Certified as a PADI OWSI or greater
  • 1+ years of teaching experience

Perks:

  • The chance to work with some of Australia’s most experienced divers
  • Access to outstanding employee discounts on gear purchases & servicing
  • Free use of tank fills & weights

  • Discounted boat diving

Salary is negotiable with contractor/freelance or full-time employment available for the right candidate (Monday to Sunday).

We are looking for two enthusiastic and professional PADI OWSI/MSDT Instructors to join our international team: 🇫🇷 1 French-speaking Instructor 🇩🇪 1 German-speaking Instructor Season: 15 November – 15 May Whether you’re looking for...
item.description:
We’re Hiring – 2 PADI Dive Instructors 🇹🇭

French-Speaking Instructor & German-Speaking Instructor

Join Koh Kood Divers for the 2026/2027 season!

We are looking for two enthusiastic and professional PADI OWSI/MSDT Instructors to join our international team:

  • 🇫🇷 1 French-speaking Instructor
  • 🇩🇪 1 German-speaking Instructor

Season: 15 November – 15 May

Whether you’re looking for a seasonal position or a longer-term opportunity beyond the season, we’d love to hear from you.

Couples are welcome to apply.

We’re building a young, energetic and fun team, so we’re looking for instructors with a positive attitude, plenty of enthusiasm, and a passion for diving, customer service, and island life.

About Koh Kood Divers

Koh Kood Divers is a busy, well-established PADI 5-Star Dive Centre located on one of Thailand’s most beautiful islands. We focus on small groups, high-quality training, and creating an enjoyable experience for both guests and staff.

Unlike many dive centres, we operate two boats during the high season, allowing us to separate beginners from certified divers and keep groups small.

What We Offer

  • Guaranteed minimum salary of 30,000 THB per month
  • Excellent commission structure
  • Typical earnings during high season can reach 50,000–70,000+ THB per month
  • Friendly international team
  • Beautiful tropical island lifestyle
  • Opportunity for long-term employment
  • Small teaching groups (maximum 4 students per instructor)

Commission Structure

  • Scuba Review – 500 THB
  • Discover Scuba Diving – 600 THB
  • Fun Dive – 225 THB per tank
  • Adventure Dive – 600 THB
  • Scuba Diver – 2,200 THB
  • Open Water – 3,000 THB
  • Advanced Open Water – 2,700 THB
  • Emergency First Response – 1,000 THB
  • Rescue Diver – 2,900 THB
  • Divemaster Course – 9,000 THB

If your commission exceeds the guaranteed salary, you receive the higher amount.

Typical Weekly Schedule

  • 3 days per week: Koh Rang Marine Park trips (approximately 07:45–17:00)
  • 4 days per week: Koh Kood local dive trips (approximately 07:45–15:00)
  • Occasionally an office day for bookings and customer service.

Your Role

Work is approximately 95% boat-based.

Responsibilities include:

  • Teaching PADI courses
  • Guiding certified divers
  • Conducting Discover Scuba Diving experiences
  • Looking after snorkelling guests
  • Delivering excellent customer service
  • Helping maintain equipment and boats
  • Working closely with the rest of the team

Boat Master Rotation

During your first month you’ll primarily work as Boat Master to learn our systems and ensure everything runs smoothly. After that, all instructors rotate through the Boat Master role so everyone remains familiar with daily operations.

Teaching

  • Maximum 4 students per instructor
  • Open Water courses completed over 3 days
  • Discover Scuba Diving conducted directly from the boat
  • Most DSD dive sites are around 10 metres, making them ideal for beginners.
  • Snorkellers are often onboard, providing opportunities to introduce guests to scuba diving and earn additional commission.

What We’re Looking For

  • Current PADI OWSI or MSDT
  • Fluent French or German, with good English
  • Professional attitude
  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Team player
  • Comfortable working on boats
  • Positive personality with a strong work ethic

Accommodation & Living Costs

item.description:
Are you looking to take the next step in your diving career and become a highly competent dive professional?

Gozo Azul Diving, a PADI 5-Star IDC and Eco Center based in Ponta do Ouro, is offering a structured career development internship for divers who are serious about progressing into the professional side of the dive industry.

Please note: This is a training internship, not a job offer or paid position. This program is designed for divers who want to gain real-world experience, mentorship, and professional-level training while working toward their certifications.

Our internship is ideal for divers aiming to become:
• PADI Divemasters
• Future PADI Instructors
• Confident, employable dive professionals

What we offer

Our internship provides hands-on experience in the daily operations of a busy professional dive center, with direct mentorship from experienced instructors.

During the program, candidates will gain practical experience in:
• Assisting with dive operations and student training
• Guiding certified divers
• Dive site mapping and underwater navigation
• Emergency readiness and rescue skills
• Equipment handling and gear preparation
• Cylinder fills and compressor procedures
• Customer service and reception duties
• Professional dive center workflow and logistics

This is not just about earning a certification — it is about developing the skills, mindset, and professionalism required to succeed in the diving industry.

Training opportunities available

Depending on your current certification level, we offer multiple pathways, including:
• Divemaster Internship (8–12 weeks)
• Zero to Pro Program (Open Water to Divemaster)
• IDC Preparation
• Instructor Development support

Additional specialty training may include:
• PADI Enriched Air (Nitrox)
• Deep Diver
• Shark Conservation / Shark AWARE
• Dive Against Debris
• Fish Identification
• Underwater Naturalist
• Marine conservation-focused specialties

Why train with us?

Located in the beautiful waters of Ponta do Ouro, we offer access to incredible diving, including vibrant reefs, megafauna encounters, and our world-famous unbaited shark dives at Pinnacles.

At Gozo Azul, we focus on building dive professionals who are:
• Skilled
• Responsible
• Confident leaders underwater
• Passionate about ocean conservation

We pride ourselves on producing strong professionals who leave our program ready for the next stage of their careers.

Minimum requirements for Divemaster candidates

• Minimum age: 18
• Certified Rescue Diver (or equivalent)
• EFR / CPR & First Aid within 24 months
• Medical clearance for diving
• Minimum 40 logged dives to start
• Minimum 60 logged dives for certification

Flexible start dates available throughout the year.

If you are serious about turning your passion for diving into a professional career, we would love to hear from you.

item.description:
Bubble & Dive is op zoek naar enkele PADI Instructors die ons team willen versterken en mee willen bouwen aan ons verhaal.

Wij zijn een PADI 5 Star IDC Center met een duidelijke visie: kwaliteit, veiligheid en persoonlijke begeleiding staan altijd centraal.

Wij zoeken geen namen op een lijst, maar collega’s die geloven in:

✔ kwaliteit en veiligheid
✔ het correct toepassen van de PADI-standaarden
✔ persoonlijke begeleiding van studenten
✔ blijven bijleren en zichzelf verder ontwikkelen
✔ een sterke community
✔ een engagement op langere termijn

Kwaliteit en het respecteren van de PADI-standaarden zijn voor ons niet onderhandelbaar.

Wij geloven niet in de goedkoopste opleidingen, maar in duurzame kwaliteit voor onze studenten én een omgeving waarin lesgevers de tijd, middelen en waardering krijgen om écht het verschil te maken.

Bij Bubbleanddive waarderen we de inzet van onze lesgevers, ook financieel.

Wat bieden wij?

✔ Een PADI 5 Star IDC Center met een eigen Course Director
✔ Een goed uitgeruste winkel en opleidingsinfrastructuur
✔ Ondersteuning en tools om opleidingen en studenten efficiënt te beheren
✔ Opleidingen en doorgroeimogelijkheden
✔ De kans om mee te bouwen aan een ambitieus en groeiend duikcentrum

Ben je vandaag aangesloten bij een andere opleidingsorganisatie, maar spreekt onze visie je aan? Dan maken we graag kennis. Voor de juiste kandidaten bekijken we met plezier de mogelijkheden van een PADI Crossover.

Wij geloven dat de juiste ingesteldheid belangrijker is dan het logo op je huidige brevetkaart.

Een brevet is geen eindpunt.

item.description:
Divemaster & Marine Biology Training Program South Africa

This program combines the PADI Divemaster training with an intro to marine biology. It’s designed to build confident, safe dive pros while giving a solid overview of marine biology concepts and projects.

Once certified, the candidates can proudly work as PADI SCUBA professionals, equipped with a deeper understanding of the marine environment and may even choose to further their education and pursue careers in Marine Science.Moreover, it will provide a unique and diverse skill set that can be applied to any future job and best of all it all happens right here in the heart of the White shark capital of the world! Program runs monthly from the 1st of the month.

Program Highlights:

  • ELMO Elasmobranch Egg Case Collection, rehydration and Analysis
  • Sea Fishing – Tag and Release – Boat shift, ORI catch & release
  • B.R.U.V. (Baited Remote Underwater Video) Analysis through PADI Project Aware Coral Reef ConservationProgram
  • Intertidal Transect Studies
  • Microplastics sampling (local beach sample collections)& processing via Density Separation
  • Seabird and Penguin Rehabilitation Centre (SAPREC)
  • Skippers training & Seamanship Orientation
  • PRE-SEA: Small Vessel Safety Induction Training & certification (required by law to work on any commercial vessel)
  • PADI Aware Dive Against Debris® specialty–  Beach Cleanup & Cleanup Dives with Data Collection…PIC Cert optional.
  • PADI Nudibranch Research Diver specialty –and related sea slug dives with data collection to determine reef health…PIC Cert optional.
  • SCUBA Diver Training and qualification via the sought after PADI SCUBA diver training courses at our 5-star Instructor Development Centre
  • Emergency First Responder (EFR) First Aid Training – you will become a certified First Aid Provider.
  • We run 2 shifts per day of 3 to 4 hours per shift, with some days off to relax and explore the beautiful Mossel Bay and surroundings.

  • Shark Week Program Highlights: (included in the 2 Month option)

  • PADI Aware Shark Conservation specialty – “Sharks in Peril and why should we care”
    • Classroom session, Learn about the challenges sharks face and what we can do to protect them. PADI AWARE Shark Conservation Diver Specialty certification optional extra.
  • Discover Scuba Diving Experience (for non-certified divers), Complete the PADI Discover Scuba Diver program & learn scuba basics and dive under the direct supervision of a qualified PADI Instructor. (Baited shark dive for qualified divers)
  • Shark Tagging with ORI (Oceanographic Research Institute), Head out aboard deep sea vessel “Salt Life Fishing” , Learn hands-on how to catch, handle, measure, tag, and safely release sharks, Participate in a citizen science tagging initiative.
  • Baited Shark Dive + B.R.U.V. Operation, Scuba dive with shy sharks and deploy and retrieve a Baited Remote Underwater Video (B.R.U.V.). Learn how to set up and operate this tool used to observe shark behaviour.
  • Video Review + E.L.M.O Egg Case Session,  Review your B.R.U.V. video,lLearn how to identify species and understand shark presence in local waters.  ELMO: Elasmobranch Egg Case Collection and Analysis, collect, rehydrate, measure and document shark egg cases.
  • White Shark Cage Diving with White Shark Africa. Depart on shark cage dive vessel “First Strike” & experience Mossel Bay’s Great White Sharks from a cage.

Additional Activities:

Beyond marine research and diving, participants can engage in a variety of optional activities, including horse riding safaris, game drives, lighthouse hiking trails, skydiving, sailing trips, and wine tasting at local vineyards.

Accommodation: Accommodation and airport transfers are available upon request, ensuring a seamless experience throughout your training. Accomodation can be arranged for you at about R6000 per month. (About $340) *subject to availability 

OPTION 1 – 1 Month:

Padi Open Water Diver + Advanced Diver + Rescue Diver + SAMSA Skippers Training and Seamanship Orientation + Emergency First Responder (EFR) + Program highlights as set out above. $2350 – R41900 (subject to change and exchange rate dependent)

OPTION 2 – 2 Months: (Divemaster option) – Recommended

Padi Open Water Diver + Advanced Diver + Rescue Diver + SAMSA Skippers Training and Seamanship Orientation + Emergency First Responder (EFR) + PADI DIVEMASTER + Program highlights as set out above + Shark Week Program highlights !

$4230 – R75900 (subject to change and exchange rate dependent)

gardenroutescuba@gmail.com,more info on www.gardenroutescuba.co.za/marinebio

item.description:
Waikiki Dive Center Now Hiring: IDC Staff Instructor – Full-Time or Part-Time (Immediate Start)

📍 Waikiki Dive Center – Honolulu, Oahu, Hawaii

🔗 WaikikiDiveCenter.com | WaikikiDiving.com

Join the most iconic and longest-standing PADI 5-Star IDC in Hawaii. With over 45 years of experience, Waikiki Dive Center is more than a dive shop—it’s a mission-driven ohana dedicated to excellence in dive education, safety, and ocean stewardship.

We are actively seeking a PADI IDC Staff Instructor (Full-time or Part-time) with strong leadership, professionalism, and a passion for teaching and mentoring. You’ll be joining a legacy dive team with a global reputation and the highest pay scale in the Hawaiian islands.

❗ POSITION REQUIREMENTS

  • Must be a U.S. citizen or hold a valid U.S. work visa (We do not sponsor visas)
  • 1-year minimum commitment
  • Minimum 2 years Instructor professional experience
  • Must hold active PADI Teaching Status
  • Valid EFR, AED, O2 Instructor credentials (within last 2 years)
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation
  • Must be available for Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year holidays

🧭 WHO WE ARE

Waikiki Dive Center is Hawaii’s oldest and most awarded dive shop, recognized by PADI Scuba Diving Magazine in all 7 “Best of the Pacific” categories. We’ve logged over 4 million safe dives and issued 35,000+ certifications. We are also a VA-approved vocational dive training provider for military veterans and eligible dependents.

Our mission: I.D.E.A. – Inspire, Discover, Empower, Advance.

We lead with humility, discipline, professionalism, and teamwork. Our culture is rooted in accountability, service excellence, and environmental respect. We support each other, push for growth, and believe leadership begins with the small things—like showing up on time, prepared, and focused.

💼 COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

W2 Hourly Pay:

  • IDC Staff Instructor or higher: $26+/hr (DOE and performance)

Employee Benefits:

  • Medical & EAP
  • 401(k) (Full-time only, after 1 year)
  • Flexible scheduling
  • Spot bonuses for excellence
  • Teaching opportunities in PADI and VA-approved vocational programs
  • Free diving & boat seats, staff gear discounts

We’re proud to offer the highest pay scale among Hawaiian dive operators—with room to grow. This is a team that recognizes effort, initiative, and consistency.

🔧 RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead PADI courses: DSD, OW, AOW, Rescue, Specialties such as Deep, Wreck, Nav, Rescue, EFR, Divemaster, and assist IDC as applicable
  • Mentor and coach dive staff in professionalism, safety, and guest interaction
  • Audit course paperwork, uphold training standards, and maintain accurate records
  • Conduct daily dive charters, including setup, briefings, in-water leadership, and cleanup
  • Be a workflow-proficient instructor, able to manage mixed groups (certified divers, students, DSDs)
  • Support customer service both in-shop and on vessels
  • Participate in safety drills, weekly staff meetings, and operational planning
  • Represent Waikiki Dive Center’s values and aloha spirit at all times

🔍 WHO YOU ARE

  • A disciplined, emotionally mature leader who leads by example and elevates the team
  • Comfortable working with diverse guests, multicultural backgrounds, and group dynamics
  • Excellent communication and conflict resolution skills—direct, respectful, and clear
  • Committed to safety, quality, and professionalism in every aspect of dive operations
  • Able to manage high-volume schedules during holidays and peak tourism months
  • Passionate about marine conservation and responsible tourism
  • Bilingual or multilingual is a strong plus (Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Spanish, French, etc.)

🌎 DIVERSITY & GLOBAL OUTREACH

At Waikiki Dive Center, we proudly serve a global customer base. Our strength lies in our diversity—of background, culture, and thought. We believe inclusivity drives creativity, safety, and service quality.

We strongly encourage bilingual professionals and instructors with international experience to apply.

💬 WHAT OUR TEAM SAYS

“Woah!!! That is awesome. And so rare for scuba instructors to be paid in the way they deserve”

— Avalon, IDC Staff Instructor

“You can be a guide or an Instructor.   We are  Instructors.”

– Kevin, Course Director

📝 APPLY TODAY

Email your resume and brief cover letter to:

📧 info@waikikidivecenter.com

📌 Subject line: Application – IDC Staff Instructor

Or apply directly via WaikikiDiveCenter.com

🌊 READY TO DIVE IN?

If you’re looking to be more than just an instructor—if you want to be part of a team that values integrity, excellence, humility, and heart—then this is your opportunity.

Live with purpose. Dive with heart. Lead with aloha.

Be part of something life-changing.

🛡️ Our Core Values

  • Safety, Quality, Performance, and Experience – Every part of the customer experience reflects our commitment to safety, expertise, and lasting impact. We’re not here to be mediocre —we’re here to be the most trusted.
  • Purpose Over Ego – We make choices that reflect our mission, not just ourselves. Every interaction, briefing, and dive reflects our higher purpose—to inspire and empower others through the ocean.
  • Clear, Respectful Communication – We value directness with kindness. We communicate intending to unite, not divide: no drama, no gossip—only clarity, accountability, and mutual respect.
  • Emotional Maturity – We stay grounded under pressure. We take ownership of our actions, receive feedback with humbleness, and navigate challenges with thorough planning and teamwork.
  • Altruism with Boundaries – We show up for each other with generosity and support, but not at the cost of burnout or resentment. We promote synergetic teamwork that balances individual wellness and collective strength.
  • Discipline in the Details – We believe excellence lives in doing the little things right, from gear setup to customer service, because they add trust and safety.
  • Always Advancing – We pursue growth personally, professionally, and as a team. Curiosity, improvement, and continuous learning are ways we honor the ocean and each other.

What We Offer – W2 Compensation (Divemaster $20+ per hour – MSDT Instructor $24+ per hour – IDC Staff Instructor or higher $26+ per hour)

  • Top-tier compensation – Proud to drive the pay scale, being the best in Hawaii and globally
  • A meaningful role creating life-changing dive experiences
  • Daily excursions along Oahu’s breathtaking coastline
  • Encounters with marine biodiversity that are soul-enriching
  • A collaborative, empowering, purpose-driven work environment
  • Opportunities to teach PADI courses and VA-approved vocational classes
  • Professional and financial rewards, including but not limited to:
    • Medical & EAP
    • 401(k) (Full-time only and after one year)
    • Flexible scheduling
    • Spot bonuses for excellence
    • Employee discounts, fun diving and boat seats
    • Keyman opportunities

Your Role May Include:

  • Leading and guiding divers, and teaching PADI courses: Open Water, Advanced, Rescue, Specialties, Divemaster, IDC-level as applicable
  • Participate in all safety drills and staff meetings in person
  • Supporting students through professional and vocational pathways
  • Leading local and international dive tours
  • Preparing for dives: gear setup, tank loading/offloading, customer service, boat support, cleanup
  • Conducting Discover Scuba Diving with patience and professionalism as DSD Leader
  • Representing our ohana and the spirit of aloha in all guest interactions

🤿 Who You Are

  • A Dive Professional — Dependable, ethical, honest, and humble, with a strong sense of purpose and pride in your work
  • A “make your bed” team player—disciplined, resilient, and committed to doing the little things right every day, pleasantly and efficiently
  • Pleasant, mature, and collected—able to lead divers with precision, charisma, and responsiveness.
  • Sees communication etiquette as a core part of connecting and unifying for trust, respect, and positivity.  Avoid drama, gossip, hearsay, and assumptions, and understand your role between personal and professional boundaries.  You are a dive leader and a professional who always has positive intent, and you foster a teamwork environment rooted in safety, accountability, and mutual respect.
  • Passionate about protecting Hawaii’s reefs and marine life
  • Excited to grow personally and professionally as part of something bigger
  • Bilingual candidates are strongly encouraged to apply. As the most iconic and oldest dive shop on Oahu, we take pride in our diverse and inclusive team dedicated to serving a global customer base. With over 4 million safe dives and 35,000 certifications achieved, our strength lies in connecting with people from all walks of life through language and aloha.

🌺 Join Our Ohana

If this resonates with you, to live with purpose, dive with passion, and help others discover the underwater world, apply now and be part of something life-changing.

Aloha,
The Waikiki Diving Center Team

🔧 RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Prep the charter and ensure completion of pre-check log, Emergency equipment, and readings
  • Mentor and coach dive staff in professionalism, safety, and guest interaction

  • Support customer service both in-shop and on vessels
  • Participate in safety drills, weekly staff meetings, and operational planning
  • Represent Waikiki Dive Center’s values and aloha spirit at all times

🔍 WHO YOU ARE

  • A disciplined, emotionally mature leader who leads by example and elevates the team
  • Comfortable working with diverse guests, multicultural backgrounds, and group dynamics
  • Excellent communication and conflict resolution skills—direct, respectful, and clear
  • Committed to safety, quality, and professionalism in every aspect of dive operations
  • Able to manage high-volume schedules during holidays and peak tourism months
  • Passionate about marine conservation and responsible tourism
  • Bilingual or multilingual is a strong plus (Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Spanish, French, etc.)

🌎 DIVERSITY & GLOBAL OUTREACH

At Waikiki Dive Center, we proudly serve a global customer base. Our strength lies in our diversity—of background, culture, and thought. We believe inclusivity drives creativity, safety, and service quality.

We strongly encourage bilingual professionals and instructors with international experience to apply.

💬 WHAT OUR TEAM SAYS

“Woah!!! That is awesome. And so rare for scuba instructors to be paid in the way they deserve.”

— Avalon, IDC Staff Instructor

“You can be a guide or an Instructor.   We are  Instructors.”

– Kevin, Course Director

📝 APPLY TODAY

Email your resume and brief cover letter to:

📧 info@waikikidivecenter.com

📌 Subject line: Application – Captain

Or apply directly via WaikikiDiveCenter.com

🌊 READY TO DIVE IN?

If you’re looking to be more than just an instructor—if you want to be part of a team that values integrity, excellence, humility, and heart—then this is your opportunity.

Live with purpose. Dive with heart. Lead with aloha.

Be part of something life-changing.

item.title: PADI Rescue Diver Ready Divemaster

item.description:
Lead by Example. Help Build the Future of Diver Preparedness.

At Rescue Diver Ready (RDR), we believe every great instructor was once an exceptional Divemaster.

We’re building a nationwide team of passionate PADI Divemasters who are committed to diver safety, teamwork, and creating unforgettable participant experiences at Rescue Diver Ready Weekends across the United States.

This is more than a Divemaster assignment.

It’s an opportunity to become a Founding Rescue Diver Ready Divemaster, work alongside experienced PADI Professionals, and help build one of the most respected rescue-focused training movements in North America.

About Rescue Diver Ready

Rescue Diver Ready is a diver preparedness platform dedicated to advancing diver safety through education, training, technology, and community.

Our mission: Don’t Just Dive. Be Rescue Diver Ready.

Through immersive Rescue Diver Ready Weekends, realistic rescue scenarios, leadership development, and community engagement, we help divers become more prepared, more confident, and better equipped to respond when emergencies occur.

Position Overview

As a Rescue Diver Ready Divemaster, you’ll play a vital role in delivering safe, organized, and engaging training events.

Working alongside our instructional team, you’ll help prepare participants, supervise in-water activities, assist with rescue scenarios, support event operations, and ensure every diver has an exceptional experience.

Minimum Qualifications

Applicants must:

  • Current Teaching Status PADI Divemaster or higher
  • Current professional liability insurance
  • Current CPR/First Aid credentials meeting PADI standards
  • Member in good standing with PADI
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills
  • Strong commitment to diver safety
  • Authorized to work in the United States

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active Assistant Instructor or Instructor candidate
  • Emergency Oxygen Provider certification
  • Experience assisting Rescue Diver courses
  • Background in EMS, Fire Rescue, Military, Law Enforcement, Lifeguarding, or Public Safety

Responsibilities

  • Assist instructors during Rescue Diver Ready events
  • Supervise participants during surface and in-water activities
  • Support realistic rescue scenarios
  • Help maintain a safe training environment
  • Assist with equipment setup and logistics
  • Conduct participant check-in and orientation
  • Support emergency action procedures when required
  • Help create an outstanding participant experience
  • Represent Rescue Diver Ready professionally

Divemaster Development

Every selected Divemaster will complete Rescue Diver Ready Team Orientation covering:

  • Event operations
  • Rescue scenario support
  • Victim management
  • Participant experience
  • Safety protocols
  • Team communication
  • Brand standards

This program is designed to help Divemasters strengthen leadership skills while working alongside experienced Rescue Diver Ready Instructors.

Compensation

This is an Independent Contractor (1099) position.

Compensation may include:

  • Competitive daily rate
  • Travel reimbursement (when applicable)
  • Lodging accommodations (when applicable)
  • Official Rescue Diver Ready apparel
  • Professional development opportunities

Compensation varies by assignment.

Why Join Rescue Diver Ready?

  • Become part of a founding national event team
  • Work alongside experienced PADI Instructors
  • Gain valuable large-event experience
  • Build leadership and rescue management skills
  • Expand your professional network
  • Prepare for future instructor development
  • Help inspire safer, more confident divers

Our Ideal Candidate

You are:

  • Passionate about diver safety
  • Professional and dependable
  • Calm under pressure
  • Team-oriented
  • Positive and encouraging
  • A natural leader who enjoys helping others succeed

Most importantly, you believe preparedness saves lives and that every diver should be Rescue Diver Ready.

How to Apply

Please submit:

  • Diving résumé
  • PADI Member Number
  • Summary of diving and professional experience
  • Current liability insurance information
  • Geographic location
  • Travel availability

If you’re passionate about leadership, safety, and helping divers become more confident and prepared, we’d love to hear from you.

Join the Movement.

Don’t Just Dive. Be Rescue Diver Ready.
