item.description:
Join the Movement. Help Shape the Future of Diver Preparedness.

Most dive instructors teach courses.

At Rescue Diver Ready (RDR), we’re building something much bigger.

We’re creating a national network of experienced PADI Professionals committed to one mission:

To make every diver more prepared, more confident, and better equipped to respond when it matters most.

Through immersive Rescue Diver Ready Weekends, realistic emergency scenarios, leadership development, and community-driven events, we’re redefining rescue training across the United States.

This is more than an instructor opportunity—it’s your chance to become a Founding Rescue Diver Ready Instructor and help build one of the most respected rescue-focused instructional teams in North America.

About Rescue Diver Ready

Rescue Diver Ready is a diver preparedness platform dedicated to advancing diver safety through education, training, technology, and community.

Our mission: Don’t Just Dive. Be Rescue Diver Ready.

We believe preparedness saves lives. Our events help divers strengthen rescue skills, improve emergency decision-making, build confidence, and become better dive buddies and leaders.

Position Overview

As a Rescue Diver Ready Instructor, you’ll deliver engaging rescue training, facilitate realistic scenarios, mentor participants, maintain the highest safety standards, and represent the Rescue Diver Ready mission with professionalism.

Minimum Qualifications

Applicants must:

  • Current Teaching Status PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor or higher
  • Minimum one year of active teaching experience
  • Certified at least 10 Rescue Diver students
  • Current professional liability insurance
  • Current CPR/First Aid credentials
  • Member in good standing with PADI
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills
  • Authorized to work in the United States

Preferred Qualifications

  • MSDT or IDC Staff Instructor
  • Specialty Instructor ratings
  • Emergency Oxygen Provider Instructor
  • Experience teaching large group events
  • Background in EMS, Fire Rescue, Military, Public Safety, Emergency Management, or Lifeguarding

Responsibilities

  • Deliver Rescue Diver Ready training and scenarios
  • Coach and mentor participants
  • Evaluate diver performance
  • Maintain the highest safety standards
  • Support event setup, operations, and debriefs
  • Collaborate with instructors, divemasters, and event staff
  • Represent Rescue Diver Ready professionally

Instructor Development

Selected instructors will complete Rescue Diver Ready Orientation covering:

  • Event operations
  • Scenario management
  • Incident Command principles
  • Victim management
  • Training methodology
  • Participant experience standards
  • Brand standards

Our goal is to deliver a consistent, high-quality experience at every Rescue Diver Ready event nationwide.

Compensation

This is an Independent Contractor (1099) position.

Compensation may include:

  • Competitive daily instructor rate
  • Travel reimbursement (when applicable)
  • Lodging accommodations (when applicable)
  • Official Rescue Diver Ready apparel
  • Professional development opportunities

Compensation varies by assignment and will be discussed during the interview process.

Why Join Rescue Diver Ready?

  • Join a founding national instructor team
  • Help shape the future of diver preparedness
  • Work alongside experienced PADI Professionals
  • Deliver innovative rescue-focused training
  • Expand your professional network
  • Inspire divers to become safer and more confident
  • Help build the leading rescue training movement in North America

How to Apply

Please submit:

  • Professional diving résumé
  • PADI Instructor Number
  • Summary of teaching experience
  • Student Count Report (including Rescue Diver certifications)
  • Current liability insurance information
  • Geographic location
  • Travel availability

Preparedness doesn’t begin during an emergency—it begins with training.

If you’re passionate about creating confident, capable divers and believe every diver should be ready to respond when it matters most, we’d love to hear from you.

Don’t Just Dive. Be Rescue Diver Ready.

item.description:
With over 30 years of experience in the industry, ScubaCaribe has established itself as one of the leading PADI Five-Star Dive Centres and watersports operations worldwide.

We are currently looking for enthusiastic and passionate individuals to fill the position of Dive Team Leader & PADI OWSI, as soon as possible, in one of our reference destinations in AMEA: ZANZIBAR.

The successful candidates must meet the following requirements:

  • PADI OWSI certification (or higher) and EFR Instructor.
  • Ideally, at least 1 year of experience in a similar position.
  • Enthusiastic, proactive and sales – oriented. Passionate about teaching diving and promoting continuing education
  • Team player with ability to adapt to local conditions and, highly safety and compliance oriented while providing the best customer service.
  • Basic knowledge of equipment maintenance, compressor handling and boat engineering is a plus
  • Advanced level of written and spoken English, Spanish and French. (Other languages are an add).
  • Leadership, communication and problem-solving.
  • Guest experience and sales / revenue-orientated
  • Organization and administration skills.
  • Knowledge about excursions by boat, diving and other watersports activities.
  • ScubaCaribe is the official Dive Centre and Watersports provider for RIU Resorts, so a great sense of responsibility in regard to personal conduct is a must.

Responsibilities PADI OWSI

  • Ensure the implementation of control measures delegated to the position
  • Actively participate in all diving activities (theory sessions, confined and open water sessions and/or diving with certified divers).
  • Sales promotion.
  • Ensure that the highest level of customer service is provided to all guests.
  • Monitor and report on the correct implementation of safety measures during underwater activities.
  • Assist and collaborate in other daily tasks of the operation and watersports centre.

Dive Team Leader Position 

  • All of the above plus responsible for briefing and debriefing of staff on a daily basis. Ensuring all diving and snorkeling team are aware of their tasks for the day-to-day operation.
  • Planning and development of diving activities ensuring through direct supervision that all safety and quality standards are met.
  • Staff management: Attendance, assignment and control of responsibilities, internal training etc.
  • Administrative tasks such as incident reports, inventories, analytics and supply orders among others.
  • Ensure standards are met in operation including: Bookings and booking data are set up correctly, Staff control & qualifications, Safety & risks assessments, equipment suitable on activities and facilities and deliver cf coaching and training and correct as appropriate.
  • Deal when necessary with customer/service inquiries in a professional and positive way. Ensuring that the service maintains a strong customer focus and remains committed to our philosophy.

For both positions we offer:

    • A competitive basic salary and commissions
    • Accommodation in staff residence
    •  Work permit
  • 26 days annual leave
  • Flight bonus
  • 3 meals a day in hotel canteen

This is a two-years contract commitment, which we seek to fill immediately.

For more information about the company, please visit the web https://www.scubacaribe.com and if you are interested in the position, please apply by sending a CV and a recent photo to bl.zanzibar@scubacaribe.com

item.description:
We’re Hiring | PADI Female Instructor | Pondicherry 🇮🇳

Are you passionate about the ocean, inspiring new divers, and building a meaningful career in scuba diving?

Temple Adventures, one of India’s Only PADI Career Development Centres, is looking for a PADI Female Instructor (OWSI or above) to join our growing dive team in Pondicherry.

If you believe diving is more than a profession—it’s a way of life—we’d love to hear from you.

What we’re looking for:

✔ PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor (OWSI) or higher
✔ Excellent communication and teaching skills
✔ Passion for ocean conservation and adventure
✔ Friendly, professional, and team-oriented mindset
✔ Ability to mentor divers from beginner to professional levels

Why join Temple Adventures?

🌊 Work with one of India’s most experienced dive teams
🐠 Train divers in a thriving marine environment
📈 Career growth through professional development
💙 Be part of a culture that values safety, education, and ocean conservation

📍 Location: Pondicherry, India

📲 Interested? Send your profile via WhatsApp: +91 89405 61439

item.description:
Nima Dive Center, www.nimadivingcenter.gr,  is a beachfront 5 Star TEC REC Dive Center located in Agia Anna beach, Naxos island, Cyclades Greece.

We are looking for a female scuba instructor to join our team in the beautiful Cyclades island for the 2026 season for a 3 months contract starting on July 2026.

Prerequisites:

  • Be in a teaching status
  • Fluency in English, any other language is a plus ( French, German)
  • EU citizenship
  • Team player and able to work under pressure
  • Newly certified instructors are welcome

We are offering fixed monthly salary, commission on upsale courses, accomodation, a day off per week, professional environment with a high standard equipment and diverse diving activities.

If you want to work in a professional environment with high standards in safety, you can send your application, CV included, to  info@naxosdivingcenter.gr

item.description:
Interdive Diving Club a small and friendly diving center from Agistri island, Saronic Gulf, Greece, is looking for PADI Dive Master (DSD leader) to join the team for the 2026 season from July to September

What we are looking for:
✅ Candidates must be European Union citizens
✅ English language requested
✅ PADI Dive Master renewed for 2026
✅ At least 100 logged dives
✅ DSD leader not mandatory but highly preferred
✅ Previous experience working in a diving center is a plus

You will work on our diving boat Astrolavos who offers daily tours around Agistri island. You can be dive leader, DSD leader, sailor and also you will perform the usual tasks needed in a diving center/boat.
You will sleep on the of our ships. We provide also a BBQ meal when boat touring.
Salary is based on experience.

If you are passionate about diving, love meeting people from all over the world and want to spend your days on one of the most beautiful islands in Greece, this is your chance! 🐠💙

📩 Send us a message with your CV on WhatsApp +30 698 871 7959 today – join the Interdive family!

item.description:
ABOUT EMPEROR DIVERS

Emperor Divers has been delivering exceptional dive experiences for over 30 years, across liveaboards, dive centres, and scuba courses in some of the world’s best dive destinations — Egypt, the Maldives, Indonesia, and the Solomon Islands.

Our Nusa Lembongan operation sits at the heart of the Indonesian diving circuit: a small island off the southeast coast of Bali, known for its manta rays, rich reef systems, and one of the most celebrated dive sites in the region — the Nusa Penida channel.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an experienced dive professional ready to take full ownership of our operation on Nusa Lembongan — one of Indonesia’s most iconic dive destinations.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll lead the team, dive operations, guest experience, finance, and shape the next chapter of Emperor Divers on Lembongan — backed by more than 30 years of global dive expertise.

What we’re looking for:
✔ PADI Instructor (MSDT preferred)
✔ Proven dive centre management experience
✔ Strong knowledge of equipment, compressors, and boat logistics
✔ Confident leading multicultural teams
✔ Ready to commit to island life long-term

What we offer:
💰 IDR 23M per calendar month + benefits
🏠 On-site accommodation included
✈️ KITAS sponsored
📄 Full-time | 6 days per week
📅 Closing date: 10 July 2026

🔗 Full details and to apply: https://sites.google.com/view/emperorrecruitment/dive-centre-manager-nusa-lembongan

📧 Questions: human.resources@emperordivers.com

item.description:
Diving Atlantis, a well-established PADI Dive Center located in Tenerife, is looking for a motivated PADI Diving Instructor to join our international team.

Requirements:

  • PADI Instructor certification
  • Good command of English (mandatory)
  • Knowledge of languages:  French & English
  • Valid driving license
  • Work permit for the European Union
  • No previous work experience required – commitment, motivation, and willingness to learn are more important

Responsibilities:

  • Conducting PADI entry-level courses
  • Organizing introductory dives and snorkeling activities
  • Leading certified divers on boat and shore dives
  • Assisting with daily operations of the dive center

What we value as an extra asset:

  • Skills in social media content creation
  • Knowledge of graphic design software

We offer a friendly and professional work environment in one of the best diving destinations in Europe. If you are passionate about diving and eager to grow as an instructor, Diving Atlantis Tenerife is the right place for you!

To apply, please send your CV and a short motivation letter to office@divingatlantis.com

item.description:
**Job Opportunity: Scuba Instructor in St. Thomas, USVI**

**Company:** Adventure Scuba

**Location:** St. Thomas, US Virgin Islands

 

Are you a passionate scuba diver with a desire to share your love for the underwater world? Do you dream of working in a tropical paradise with crystal-clear waters and vibrant marine life? Look no further! Adventure Scuba in St. Thomas, US Virgin Islands, is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Scuba Instructor to join our team.

 

**About Adventure Scuba:**

Adventure Scuba is a premier diving destination located on the picturesque island of St. Thomas in the heart of the Caribbean. With its warm climate, breathtaking landscapes, and diverse marine ecosystems, St. Thomas offers an unparalleled scuba diving experience. Our scuba center is dedicated to providing exceptional service and unforgettable underwater adventures to our guests.

 

**Job Responsibilities:**

As a Scuba Instructor at Adventure Scuba, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring our guests’ safety, enjoyment, and education during their diving experiences. Your primary responsibilities will include:

  1. **Conducting Diving Courses:** Leading scuba diving courses for beginners, advanced divers, and specialty certifications (PADI or SSI certification required).
  2. **Guided Dives:** Leading guided dives to various dive sites around St. Thomas, showcasing the beauty of the local marine life and underwater landscapes.
  3. **Ensuring Safety:** Prioritizing the safety of guests by adhering to all diving industry safety standards and protocols.
  4. **Customer Service:** Providing excellent customer service, addressing guests’ questions, and ensuring their overall satisfaction with their diving experience.
  5. **Equipment Maintenance:** Ensuring all scuba equipment is properly maintained, serviced, and in good working condition.
  6. **Environmental Conservation:** Promoting responsible diving practices and fostering environmental awareness among guests to protect the fragile marine ecosystems.

 

**Requirements:**

To be considered for the Scuba Instructor position, applicants must meet the following criteria:

MUST BE A US CITIZEN OR HOLD A VALID WORK VISA

  1. **Certification:** PADI Scuba Instructor certification.
  2. **Experience:** Minimum of 2 years of experience as a Scuba Instructor, conducting courses and leading guided dives.
  3. **First Aid/CPR:** Current First Aid and CPR certifications.
  4. **Passion for Diving:** A genuine passion for scuba diving and a strong desire to share that passion with others.
  5. **Communication Skills:** Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to engage with guests from diverse backgrounds.
  6. **Team Player:** Ability to work effectively as part of a team and collaborate with other resort staff.
  7. **Language:** Proficiency in English (additional languages, especially Spanish, is a plus).

 

**Perks:**

This is an incredible opportunity to work in a stunning location with like-minded individuals who share a love for diving and the ocean. Benefits of this position include:

  1. **Competitive Compensation:** A competitive salary commensurate with experience and qualifications.
  2. **Accommodation:** Accommodation assistance can be provided for those relocating to the island.
  3. **Diving Benefits:** Access to dive regularly in some of the most spectacular dive sites in the Caribbean.
  4. **Personal Growth:** Opportunities for professional development and advancement within Adventure Scuba.
  5. **Exploring St. Thomas:** Discover the beauty of St. Thomas during your time off, with its white sandy beaches, tropical rainforests, and vibrant local culture.

 

**How to Apply:**

If you are an enthusiastic and experienced Scuba Instructor ready for an exciting adventure in St. Thomas, US Virgin Islands, please submit your resume, a cover letter, and any relevant certifications here or to uwa@godivevi.com

 

Join us at Adventure Scuba and make a difference in the lives of fellow divers while experiencing the thrill of exploring the mesmerizing underwater world of St. Thomas!

item.description:
**Job Opportunity: PADI Dive Master in St. Thomas, USVI**

**Company:** Adventure Scuba

**Location:** St. Thomas, US Virgin Islands

 

Are you an experienced and certified PADI Dive Master seeking an opportunity to share your passion for diving in a tropical paradise? Look no further! Adventure Scuba in St. Thomas, US Virgin Islands, is currently searching for a dedicated and enthusiastic PADI Dive Master to join our team.

 

**About Adventure Scuba:**

Adventure Scuba is a premier diving center located on the enchanting island of St. Thomas in the heart of the Caribbean. With its warm waters, breathtaking underwater landscapes, and diverse marine life, St. Thomas offers an unparalleled scuba diving experience. Our dive center is committed to providing exceptional service and unforgettable underwater adventures to our guests.

 

**Job Responsibilities:**

As a PADI Dive Master at Adventure Scuba, you will be an essential part of our dive team, ensuring the safety and enjoyment of our diving guests. Your primary responsibilities will include:

 

  1. **Assisting Dive Instructors:** Support PADI instructors during scuba courses, helping with logistics, demonstrating skills, and providing guidance to students.
  2. **Guided Dives:** Lead guided dive tours for certified divers, showcasing the beauty of local dive sites, and pointing out fascinating marine life.
  3. **Safety Oversight:** Ensure all diving activities adhere to PADI standards and safety protocols, and conduct thorough dive briefings.
  4. **Customer Service:** Provide exceptional customer service to divers, addressing inquiries, and ensuring a memorable experience for our guests.
  5. **Equipment Maintenance:** Assist with the maintenance, care, and preparation of diving equipment to ensure its proper functioning.
  6. **Environmental Stewardship:** Promote responsible diving practices and environmental conservation to protect the fragile marine ecosystems.

 

**Requirements:**

To be considered for the PADI Dive Master position, applicants must meet the following criteria:

 

  1. **PADI Dive Master Certification:** Must hold a current and valid PADI Dive Master certification.
  2. **Experience:** Minimum of 1 year of experience as a certified PADI Dive Master, leading dives and assisting with scuba courses.
  3. **First Aid/CPR:** Current First Aid and CPR certifications.
  4. **Passion for Diving:** A genuine passion for scuba diving and a desire to share the underwater world with others.
  5. **Communication Skills:** Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to engage with guests and create a positive experience.
  6. **Team Player:** Ability to work collaboratively with other dive professionals and staff.
  7. **Language:** Proficiency in English (additional languages, especially Spanish, is a plus).

 

**Perks:**

This is a fantastic opportunity to work in a stunning location with a team that shares your love for diving and the ocean. Benefits of this position include:

  1. **Competitive Compensation:** A competitive salary commensurate with experience and qualifications.
  2. **Accommodation:** Accommodation assistance can be provided for those relocating to the island.
  3. **Diving Benefits:** Regular opportunities to dive in some of the Caribbean’s most captivating dive sites.
  4. **Professional Growth:** Opportunities for professional development and advancement within Adventure Scuba.
  5. **Explore St. Thomas:** Enjoy exploring the beauty of St. Thomas during your time off, with its white sandy beaches, lush landscapes, and vibrant local culture.

 

**How to Apply:**

If you are a passionate and certified PADI Dive Master ready for an exciting adventure in St. Thomas, US Virgin Islands, please submit your resume, a cover letter, and any relevant certifications to hr@adventurescuba.com.

 

Join us at Adventure Scuba and be part of creating unforgettable diving experiences for our guests while immersing yourself in the wonders of St. Thomas’ underwater world!
